title: Against Fear and Anxiety
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I denounce and renounce every doubt, every fear that is within me.
The fear of tomorrow, anxiety, I reject it in the name of Jesus.
Any agreement with fear, any agreement with anxiety, any agreement with doubt, Father, I renounce it today.
Father, remove fear consciousness from me.
Lord, remove the spirit of fear from me, remove fear consciousness from me in Jesus' name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce the fear that has been consuming my mind.
Uncertainty, I renounce it now, worry, I renounce it now.
Lord Jesus, I come and cast all my fears, all anxiety, all doctors' reports; Father, I cast it before you, I release it at your feet.
You spirit of anxiety, you spirit of confusion, I command you to leave my life.
Spirit of worry, leave my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spirit that has been tormenting me, giving me sleepless nights, giving me anxiety of the future, in the mighty name of Jesus, today I destroy your power.
Seeds of fear, come out from me now in the name of Jesus.
Every seed of fear, I command you out now in the name of Jesus.
I return torment to the cross, I return anxiety to the cross.
I return the fear of tomorrow to the cross, for I am delivered from all these things.
The spirit of fear is not my portion.
The fear of tomorrow, the fear of the future, all those things are not my portion, anxiety is not my portion.
For I am clothed in Christ Jesus, I have the full armor of God upon me.
Father, give me the spirit of boldness.
Father, I want to know your ways, give me a sound mind, a mind that is full of love, a mind that has no fear.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am coming out of fear, I am coming out of despair.
My assurance is in you, God, my confidence is in you, God, my rest is in you, God, my peace is in you, God.
I will not fear, I will not fear, I will not fear, Father.
Father, I have no reason to fear.
My days of anxiety are over.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I receive what the Lord has prepared for me. Amen.

title: Against Depression and Heaviness
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I am before you, because Lord Jesus, you are the curse breaker, you are the God who delivers.
Lord Jesus, Son of God, have mercy upon me.
Deliver me, oh Lord, from every demonic oppression.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I rebuke the spirit of heaviness.
Father, I pull down depression, I pull down oppression.
Every mental blockage, every oppression and depression, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Whatever has made me to be heavy, whatever has made me to be sad and depressed, whatever has made my mind to be clouded.
Father, let your light pierce through.
Every dark cloud dissipate, every dark cloud be scattered, every dark cloud be removed in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every chain of oppression, every chain of depression, every chain of stagnation, every chain of limitation, Father, I break it in the name of Jesus.
No chain will keep me in depression, no chain will keep me in sorrow.
I renounce depression, anxiety, whatever it is, oh God, on my father's side, my mother's side, I renounce it.
Patterns of misfortune, patterns of anxiety, patterns of depression, patterns of chronic illness be broken now in the mighty name of Jesus.
I end sorrow in my life, I end pain in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, what reduced me to ashes, I am rising out of it.
I am rising out of shame, I am rising out of depression.
Depression and oppression has no place in my life.
Today I receive joy from on high, I receive the garment of praise from on high.
I have the garment of praise, I have the spirit of joy.
My spirit, my soul and my body is receiving strength from God.
Father, I receive joy from heaven, I receive gladness from heaven.
Thank you, Lord, for lifting every depressive spirit.
Thank you, Jesus, that all depression has been lifted.
Thank you, Lord, thank you that the heaviness that was once there, now it's lightness.
Thank you, God, that my mind is clear again.
I am coming out of heaviness, I am coming out of confusion, I am coming out of depression, I am coming out of demonic oppression.
Father, I thank you because I know your name, I am delivered, I am free, I am secure. Amen.

title: For a Sound Mind and Peace
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I call on your name.
Father, I want to know your ways, give me a sound mind.
Give me a sound mind, a mind that is full of love, a mind that has no fear.
Lord, cleanse my conscience, purify my mind, sanctify my thoughts.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today renew my mind.
Remove every program of the enemy within my mind.

Every thought that is not of God, thoughts of defeat, thoughts of death, thoughts of confusion, thoughts of shortcomings, thoughts of weakness, thoughts of limitation, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I pull down every stronghold in the mind.
Everything that is trying to control me, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let it be brought down.
Every stronghold in my mind, may it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every prison of my memories, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every evil spirit that has deceived me that I should not live in rest, today in the name of Jesus, I command that tormenting spirit to come out of my life.
You spirit of anxiety, you spirit of confusion, I command you to leave my life.
Every demonic pattern in my thoughts, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be broken, let it be destroyed.
I silence every voice that came from my fathers, that came from my mothers, on both sides of my bloodline.
Every intrusive thought that affected my fathers, that is now affecting me, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Whatever confusion of the devil, let it be pushed out now.
Let the sound of heaven begin to resound in my mind.
Father, in the name of Jesus, fortify my mind and fortify my spirit.
Cause for every heaviness and every cloud that is over my mind to be lifted now in the name of Jesus.
Let clarity come, oh God, let all condemnation be broken from me in the mighty name of Jesus.
God, regulate my mind and cause for me to be stable in you.
God, give me a sound mind so when circumstances begin to speak, I am not shaken.
Holy Spirit, regulate my emotions, Holy Spirit, regulate my thoughts.
Father, cause my mind to be stayed on you, oh Lord, to be stayed on you, so that I may maintain perfect peace in my life.
I no longer want to be shifty, I no longer want to be double-minded, I want to be grounded in you.
Father, be merciful with me today, help me to remove distractions from my life, that my mind will stay on you.
For I have the mind of Christ.
I have a pure mind, I have a sound mind in the mighty name of Jesus.
My Lord and my God, I pray that I will enter into your rest. Amen.

title: When I Am Weary and Discouraged
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you and I wait on you.
You are my strength, you are my salvation, you are my hope.
Father, I am tired, I am weary, I have carried so many burdens, but only you can give me rest.
Father, I call on you, you who is the giver of rest, may I receive rest today for my soul in the name of Jesus.
Father, I thank you for strength.
Take away all manner of discouragement.
Strengthen me, oh Lord, like you strengthened your son, Jesus; give me strength, Father, give me strength, oh Lord, to be able to persevere.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every voice of discouragement, be thou cancelled in the name of Jesus.
That voice that says it is not working, that voice that says I'm not advancing, that voice that says it doesn't matter, that voice that says I should just quit.
Every voice of discouragement, I cancel you in the name of Jesus.
Every place that discouragement occupied, I replace it with the hope of the spirit.
Every discouragement that wants to quench my zeal and my passion for life, no more after today.
Holy Spirit, give me the words to encourage myself with.
Holy Spirit, awaken the parts of me that have forgotten who you are.
Remind me of the victories that you have already given unto me.
Father, heal the parts of me that are broken.
Lord, today renew my strength in the areas of my life that I am weary.
Father, renew my spirit, renew my heart, renew my mind.
Strengthen me, not only spiritually, but also mentally, that I may be able to push through.
Cause me not to quit, God, cause me not to give up.
May the spirit of depression be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let new strength arise in me, let fresh grace arise in me.
Your joy will truly be my strength.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I receive new strength.
My God, you do not get weary, my Lord, you do not slumber.
I can do all things through Christ Jesus who strengthens me.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Rejection and Shame
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, deliver me from self-righteousness, open my eyes to see the cross.
Jesus, you took upon yourself all the shame that I am experiencing today.
It is already on the cross, I do not need to be ashamed, because I am redeemed by you.
Lord, change my subconscious never to walk in condemnation.
Even if my heart condemns me, Lord God, you are greater than my heart.
Father, erase every lie, Father, remove every word that is perverted in me.
Words of defeat, words of failure, words of shame, words of humiliation, words of stagnancy, words that have made me feel worthless, Father, today by your spirit, erase it from me.
Help me today not to walk in any title that a man has given me.
The voices that said I cannot make it, the voices that said I am a failure, the voices that said I am nobody, the voices that said I am poor, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
Every mentality of defeat, every thought of failure, every thought of rejection from you, Father, I cast it down in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of shame, today I divorce you, I separate myself from you.
I separate myself from every voice bringing up my past in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every curse of rejection, every curse of death, every curse of poverty, every curse of oppression, break in the name of Jesus.
Every scent that brings rejection, every scent that brings opposition, every scent that brings trouble, let it be removed now in the name of Jesus.
Let the spirit of shame be broken, let the spirit of defeat be broken in me and my family.
Father, rescue me from shame, the shame of the family, the shame of my own shortcomings.
Today turn me into a vessel of honor, Father, transform me into a vessel of honor, a vessel that will bring you glory.
I am accepted by you, I am not rejected.
I am accepted by you, I am not rejected, I am redeemed by you.
I am not my past, I have been delivered from my old nature, I have been delivered from my past.
I come out of shame.
In the name of Jesus, shame is not my portion, the blessing of God is my portion.
My days of being resisted, my days of being rejected, my days of being slandered, the days of my name being spoiled, have come to an end.
I am valuable, I am needed, there will be a need for me.
As honey is sweet, and as honey is loved by many, I shall be loved by many, for God has approved of me.
I am not alone, I am not forsaken, I am not abandoned.
Father, I thank you that my days of shame are over.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Peace
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes are set on you.
Lord, today I move my heart from worry.
I move my heart from anxiety.
Lord Jesus, you said that I should cast my burdens to you, that you will give me rest.
Lord, forgive me for taking my eyes off you, putting it on situations, for putting it on things.
Father, recalibrate my mind today, oh Lord, recalibrate my mind to focus on you.
Cause my mind to be stayed on you, oh Lord, to be stayed on you, so that I may maintain perfect peace in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, cause me to know your peace all around, just like Solomon.
Let me cease from every battle.
Let me cease from every trouble.
Let my mind know peace.
Father, as I keep my eyes on you, let me be kept in perfect peace.
Father, give me the strength to keep my peace.
I don't wrestle against flesh and blood.
Father, restore my soul.
May my soul return to the place of rest.
May I find peace again.
Cause me to rest today, may I rest in you today, may worry be a thing of the past, may doubt be a thing of the past.
Every form of destruction, every form of life that is contrary to the word of God, every fear, every form of anxiety, I cancel in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I cancel every conflict, every division, confusion in my life, every attack, every lie of the enemy.
Lord Jesus, help me to build in your peace, let your presence be the foundation of my life, of my home and my family.
Guide me in wisdom and strengthen me to walk in peace daily.
Let me be anchored in peace, let me be kept in peace, let me be sustained in peace, let my atmosphere be peace.
Father, this is your blessing for me, that you will keep me in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you.
You are my peace, you are my rest.
I am in peace because Jesus is in my tomorrow.
In the name of Jesus, I decree and declare peace.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Comfort in Grief and Loss
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes look to you, my heart looks to you.
Lord God Almighty, have mercy on me, have pity on me.
Father, I don't understand what is happening, I don't understand it all.
I don't know why things happen, but you know everything.
Help me to understand your ways through this season of difficulty.
Through this fire, I pray for the spirit of comfort, I pray for peace through this whole storm.
Father, even in the valley of the shadow of death, Lord, be with me.
Let your presence not depart from me, let your spirit not depart from me.
Lord, don't leave me, no matter what I do, remember your mercy concerning me.
Father, you said you will not leave me, but you will send your comforter.
Father, in the name of Jesus, send your angels to strengthen me, like you strengthened your son Jesus.
Send your angels to comfort me.
Lord Jesus, I pray, strengthen me, build me up, strengthen me, fortify me through this difficult season.
Father, take away tears from my family, Father, take away pain from my family.
Take away mourning from my family, take away heartbreak from my family.
Father, may every burden be lifted today, may every tear be taken away.
May every sorrow be removed from the memories of my mind, that, Lord, all comfort comes from you.
Restore my soul to know the peace that only comes from you.
Cause my soul to rejoice again and wipe away my tears.
Father, bring closure where it needs to be, bring restoration and healing to my soul where it is broken.
Let torment be taken away from me in the name of Jesus.

I cancel every agenda of death, every agenda of premature death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I will have no mourning in my family before the appointed time.
Holy Spirit, you are my comforter, help me today.
Thank you for the losses, thank you for the difficult times, Lord, you are working through all things and all things work for my good.
I will not be afraid, Jesus will help me, and Jesus is my help.
In Jesus' name, Amen.

title: When I Feel Alone
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes look to you, you are my help and my salvation.
If you don't rescue me, nobody can rescue me.
My neighbors, my brothers and sisters can forsake me, my children can forsake me, my spouse can forsake me, but you, O Lord Jesus, will never forsake me.
I have neglected you, O Lord, when I have looked at others to be my solutions, to be my help, Lord, forgive me.
Lord Jesus, have mercy upon me, for too long I have carried these burdens by myself.
Remember me today, oh Lord, rescue me from where I am.
Father, I look to you, because you have my answers.
My father and my God, I want to be in your presence, your presence is my home.
Embrace me today, cover me under your wings today, keep me under your shadow today.
Father, I don't want to leave your presence unless you go with me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the grace to understand your ways, to know your love, to experience that love.
So in times of uncertainty, in times of battles, in times of danger, in times of loneliness, I will remember that love.
I thought these troubles were because you have forsaken me, but now I know it is the opposite.
I know for sure that you love me, because your love has been revealed unto me.
I know what I am going through, it is because you love me, I receive your love today.
Father, I even understand now, I am not far from you, it is my thoughts that have kept me far from you.
You said you will never leave me nor forsake me, even if my mind goes away from you, you are still there with me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I fix my eyes on you, I place my eyes on you, I look only to you.
I now understand that nothing can separate me from your love, not my mistake, not death, no demon, no witchcraft, none of these things have power to keep me from you.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I welcome angelic visitation.
From today, I am not alone, I am not alone.
I have legions upon legions of angels overseeing my life, keeping me in all my ways.
Father, I prophesy my days of trouble are over, my days of suffering are over.
I am not alone, I am not forsaken, I am not abandoned.
Thank you that you remember me, Father, thank you that you remember my family.
As the Lord has declared, so shall it be.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For Healing of My Body
segments: Lord Jesus, you are my healer.
Oh Lord, save me from this sickness, rescue me from these infirmities.
Father, I need mercy today, so that I may come out of this situation.
It is your great desire that I may be healed, that I may be made whole.
Lord Jesus, heal me, and I shall be healed.
Lord Jesus, restore me, and I shall be restored.
Forgive me for confessing that it is my sickness.
In the name of Jesus, I renounce every sickness, I renounce every suffering.
I renounce every covenant that has joined me to this pain, that has joined me to this evil spirit.
Father, today I make a distinction between me and sickness.
Anything that is independent of the Lord Jesus does not belong to me, it has no place in me.
In the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, by reason of the Lord Jesus, by the authority of the Father, I bring every sickness into subjection.
Every disease in my body, every sickness in my body, whatever the name is, it does not matter, listen to the voice of God, your hour has expired, and I command you out of my body now.
This is not your temple, this is not your home, this is not your shelter, this is the temple of the Lord Jesus Christ, and I shall live and I shall not die.
Holy Spirit, purify my blood.
Every genetic disease, every genetic sickness shall be broken today in the mighty name of Jesus.
Light be in my soul, light be in my body, light be in my spirit.
Let every darkness be removed in the name of Jesus.
Whatever sickness I am facing, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, may I be healed.
Lord Jesus, heal my body, restore my soul.
I will no longer be sick, I will no longer suffer with allergies, I will no longer suffer with diseases, no matter what the name is.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am made whole.
Today I receive healing, I also receive wholeness.
Healing is my portion.
I am healed, I am restored, I am delivered, and I am made free today in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Nightmares and Night Attacks
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that your word is true.
Father, I accept your word today, your word that declares you never sleep nor slumber.
You are the God that watches over Israel.
Father, I desire that your angels be around me, I desire that your host be around me, I desire that your son Jesus be with me, I desire that your presence be with me.
Father, cover me today under your wings.
Father, I possess the night, I take control of the night.
Night and light are the same to you, light and darkness are equal to you.
I take charge of the darkness the same way I reign in the light.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever the enemy is trying to do, even at night when I sleep, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Everything the enemy is trying to do over my life, over my family, every night while I sleep, I cancel it.
Father, every witch fighting against my life, every sorcerer arising against my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let their charms be broken, let their altars be broken.
In the name of Jesus, every spirit that has been tormenting me, giving me sleepless nights, giving me anxiety of the future, in the mighty name of Jesus, today I destroy your power.
Today I remove you from my family, I remove you from my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, by reason of the blood of Jesus, out of my life, out of my family.
Every vision that is from darkness, that is from the evil one, I arrest it.
I receive discernment to distinguish between that which is of God and that which is of darkness.
Every spiritual husband or spiritual wife that has been coming to me, may it be removed in the mighty name of Jesus.
Lord Jesus, have mercy on me, if there is anything hiding in me, Lord Jesus, deliver me.
There will be no hiding place for demons.
Father, may I see the pillar of fire tonight, that all works of darkness be consumed and destroyed.
God gives sleep to his beloved.
I receive sleep, I receive rest in the name of Jesus.
From today, let there be no struggle, let there be no thoughts that will consume me, keep me up.
Let deep sleep fall over me, that it becomes my nature to just sleep.
I am under the shadow of the Almighty, I am under the rock, the Lord is my high tower.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
No arrow by day or by night will harm me or my family.
I take my sleep in Jesus' name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For the Fruit of the Womb
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, your eyes can see me.
Today I receive your mercy and your love, I receive your compassion.
Lord Jesus, may your spirit overshadow me that I may conceive all that you have destined for me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, everything that is causing barrenness in my life, I reject it and I rebuke it.
Any area of barrenness in my life, from today I reject you and I rebuke you.
You will no longer take refuge in my life.
My life will be fruitful.
In the name of Jesus, barrenness is cursed.
I condemn unfruitfulness, I condemn stagnancy, I completely condemn barrenness, this is not my portion today.
Every negative word that has come out of me, by the power of the Holy Spirit I undo those words, words of barrenness, words of failure.
You spirit that has been tormenting me in the night, causing me oppression, abnormal barrenness, I regulate my cycle, I remove barrenness from me in the mighty name of Jesus.
That abnormal hormonal balance in me, I correct it in the name of Jesus.
Every time I get pregnant I miscarry, today it is over in the name of Jesus.
By the spirit of God, I will carry that child to full term.
It does not matter my age, it does not matter what the doctor said, even if they removed my womb, even if they said it was impossible, nothing is impossible with the Lord Jesus.
I restore my womb, I restore my eggs.
May I carry as many children as I desire.
Father, from today, let fruitfulness manifest in every area of my life.
Father, I call forth fruitfulness, the fruitfulness you ordained from the beginning, Father, fruitfulness in my womb, fruitfulness in my body.
Remove every barrenness, remove every dryness, remove every wilderness.
Every drought ends from today, fruitfulness come forth.
That spirit that has tied my womb, in the mighty name of Jesus, come out.
Thank you that that spirit of barrenness is broken.
God is giving me descendants upon descendants.
Lord Jesus, I receive what I have been waiting to birth.
I receive an open womb.
I am fruitful in my body.
Barrenness has no place in my life, for the Lord has made me fruitful.
No more dryness, no more barrenness, no more dryness, no more barrenness in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Generational Sickness
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive what is mine.
Healing is my portion, healing for my body, healing for my children.
Healing is my portion because I am an heir of Jesus Christ.
Redeem me, Lord, and I shall be redeemed.
Save me, Father, and I shall be saved from every sickness, from every infirmity, from every pain, from every generational disease.
I separate myself from every devil, from every sickness, from every condition.
In the name of Jesus, I cancel every chronic disease that is in my life, that is in my children, that is in my family.
Every chronic condition, be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Father, whether it's immediate family, whether it is distant family, nieces, nephews, uncles, aunts, in the mighty name of Jesus, I wipe out every chronic disease.
You demon, I arrest you in the name of Jesus and I pull you out of my family.
You have no place in my family; I evict you from my bloodline, I evict you from my children.
Every sickness that has been in my family from generation to generation to generation, today I end it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I wipe out every chronic disease from my family name, I wipe out every chronic disease from my bloodline, I wipe out every chronic disease from my generations.
I break every generational curse over my life, what came from my father's side, my mother's side, I eliminate it in the name of Jesus.
No more generational curses, no more generational curses, no more generational curses.
I have seen the sicknesses, I have seen the barrenness, I have seen the limitations, I have seen the confusions, but today, oh Lord, it ends with me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the spirit of the living God, I separate myself from every generational curse, every calamity of my family.
I decree and declare I am separated from it.
By the power of the Holy Ghost, and in the mighty name of Jesus, those cycles end with me.
Go back to the pit and never touch my family again, never touch my loved ones again.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am no longer under a curse.
Today I am under the blessing of Jehovah.
Father, I begin a new chapter of wholeness and healing in the name of Jesus.
I open a chapter of long life.
From today let there be wholeness, from today let there be health.
Father, thank you for freedom, thank you for liberty, thank you for healing, thank you for wholeness, thank you for recovery in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against the Spirit of Infirmity
segments: Father, you are greater than my sickness, you are greater than my shortcomings, you are greater than my limitations.
Father, you can do all things, and you have power over all things.
All authority and power are all yours, so there is no authority above you.
Father, I look to you, I look to you, my Lord and my God, I look to you, Father, without you I can do nothing.
You created my body; you created everything to do with me.
Forgive me for confessing that it is my sickness.
You never created anybody sick; you surely did not create me with sickness.
In the name of Jesus, I renounce every sickness, I renounce every suffering.
I renounce every covenant that has joined me to this pain, that has joined me to this evil spirit.
Whatever is in me that did not come from you, any power that is working against me that is not of God, Father, in the name of Jesus, may it be broken over my life.
You unclean spirit that is working in my life, causing me sicknesses, causing infirmities, in the mighty name of Jesus, I command you by the power of the Holy Spirit.
Come out of my life, come out of my body.
Let that spirit of infirmity, no matter where it is located, come out of me now in the mighty name of Jesus.
Your time has expired in me.
You sickness in my body, I divorce myself from you.
Set me free, oh Lord, from every infirmity, from every sickness, from every single infirmity that they claim is incurable.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every entity living in me, I command them to leave me, I command them to be evicted out of my body, my body is the temple of the living God.
Every spirit that has entered into my life, wherever it came from, it cannot afflict me.
Today, I bind you spirit, you evil spirit, you demonic spirit, you spirit from witchcraft, you spirit of oppression, wherever you came from, I bind you today.
I evict you from my life, go back to the pit.
Whatever damage was done, God, may there be healing, may there be healing.
I break every hold in the name of Jesus, I break every hold, every hold is broken.
Today I renounce you, today I separate myself from you; you have no place in my life.
You will not touch me again, you will not visit me again, and you will never afflict me again.
I am healed, I am restored, I am delivered, and I am made free today in the name of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am made whole.
I receive all that God has for me in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Cancelling Words I Spoke over My Body
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I switch directions.
Lord, have mercy upon my weak vessel.
Lord, purify my mouth.
Forgive me for confessing that it is my sickness.
You never created anybody sick.
You surely did not create me with sickness.
Father, I renounce even my own negative words today.
I separate myself from this sickness.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life.
Words of sickness, words of calamity, words of complaining, I reverse those words.
I reverse those words and I make those words of no effect.
I renounce every single curse that I have spoken over myself in the name of Jesus.
I cancel every negative word I have spoken over myself.
Every word that I spoke against myself, God, I reverse it.
Every time that I spoke doubt, I reverse it.
Every time I spoke fear, I reverse it.
Every time I gave up on myself and I spoke those words, I reverse it, Lord Jesus.
Words I spoke as a child, words I have spoken as an adult, words I have spoken in pain, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
I cancel every word that I have spoken, every negative word, I cancel it.
Every negative word that has come out of me, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I undo those words.
Everywhere where my confession agreed with the enemy, today, Father, I neutralize, I cancel, and I erase by reason of the blood of Jesus.
May every word that I spoke contrary, may it be reversed and cancelled now in Jesus' name.
Concerning my health, God, let it be established now.
I reverse them now in the name of Jesus, and I declare blessing over myself.
Lord Jesus, I wait on you, renew my strength today.
My soul is restored.
I reverse everything that came out of my lips, every negative word, every negative imagination, I reverse it in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against Untimely Death
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, no premature death shall come close to my door.
I am under the shadow of the Almighty.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
Every untimely death, I draw the line by reason of the blood of Jesus.
You have no access to my life.
I arrest the spirit of death, I arrest the assignment of death, I abort the assignment of death in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever my name has been written for an untimely death, I wipe it out with the blood of Jesus.
Every pattern of premature death, every pattern of untimely death, I cancel it now.
Wherever you found a place in my family, wherever you found a place in my bloodline, wherever you found a place in my life, every pattern of premature death, I cancel you in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will not touch me, you will not afflict me, you will not visit my home, you will not visit my family, you will not visit my health, you will not visit my body.
You spirit of death, I command you in the name of Jesus, come out of my life.
Every spirit of death hiding in me, everything that will produce death, every root of death, every root of destruction, every root of calamity.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I command you now, your time has expired, come out of me.
Every accident that has been prepared for me or my family, every arrow that is targeting me or my family in order to kill us before our time, I send you back to sender.
Every power of premature death is destroyed today.

In the name of Jesus, I cancel every assignment of death, every assignment of premature death, every assignment to cut my purpose short, any assignment to cut assignments short, every assignment to cut destiny short.

I cancel every agenda of death, every agenda of premature death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
I scatter you by fire in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spirit of death, I arrest you, I bind you, and I command you back to the pit.
Every spirit of death will be bound, every spirit of calamity will be bound, every spirit of tragedy will be bound.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I cancel the spirit of death, I cancel appointments with the spirit of death.
Every appointment with death that has been arranged by the powers of darkness, by the powers of witchcraft, by any demonic altar, that death is eradicated today.
That death is diverted today, that death is destroyed today, that death is cancelled in the name of Jesus.
There will be no death before the fulfillment of purpose.
Premature death is not my portion.
I will not die prematurely.
I shall not die, I shall live to see the goodness of God in the land of the living.
I have a powerful destiny to fulfill in Christ.
Long life is my portion.
Father, I thank you for life and life more abundantly. Amen.

title: For a Safe Pregnancy and Delivery
segments: Father, as I call on your name right now, in the mighty name of Jesus, hear from heaven and answer my prayer.
Holy Spirit, fill me today, lead me and show me the way.
Lord, help me.
Restore your daughter, restore every part of my body.
Let this infirmity depart from my family beginning with me.
Whatever this pregnancy complication is, I fix it in Jesus' name.
Let the baby be positioned the right way in the name of Jesus.
Every intention of the enemy against this child, let it be reversed now.
I decree and declare by the spirit of the living God, whatsoever the condition is, I reverse it in the name of Jesus.
Whatever they told me concerning my baby will not be so.
Every unclean spirit will not touch me or my child in Jesus' name.
You unclean wicked spirit, your time in my life has expired, take everything you brought, every sickness, every curse, every shortcoming, every nightmare, every torment.
From today you have no place in me and my baby, in Jesus' name.
No demon in any form will appear to me or my child ever again.
I reverse every curse, every situation that has been difficult is broken in the name of Jesus.
No more anxiety, no more nightmares, in Jesus' name.
I will not be afraid, Jesus will help me, and Jesus is my help.
Father, rescue my child, secure my child, hide my child's life in Christ and in you.
May my child forever stand in your presence, may my child forever be secure, may my child forever be preserved.
May angels ascend and descend upon my children.
My pregnancy will be safe.
I will have my baby and I will be safe.
There shall be a beautiful delivery.
I will have a safe delivery.
May restoration come to me and the baby.
Whatever was dry, springs of living water shall begin to flow, beginning now.
Father, let it be so, let it be accomplished, let it be established in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Healing of My Mind and Emotions
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, give me a sound mind.
God, regulate my mind and cause for me to be stable in you.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that you will give me the ability to manage my emotions.
Emotions have made me see the wrong way.
Father, help me, have mercy on me.
Lord, cleanse my conscience, purify my mind, sanctify my thoughts.
Every thought of doubt, every thought of fear, every thought of self-sabotage, God, renew my mind.
Every mental blockage, every oppression and depression, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Mentally, whatever is holding me back, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.

Father, every dullness of thinking, every memory loss, whatever sort of mental confusion, whatever sort of mental hindrance, whatever sort of mental blockage that has been affecting me today, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, let your light pierce every darkness that has clouded my mind, every darkness that has clouded my thinking.
Today I break every struggle in my mind, I break every worry that has afflicted my mind, I break every anxiety that has afflicted my mind.
Every spirit taking a hold of my mind, be broken, break, break, break, break.
Let every abandonment, fear and torment be removed from me in the name of Jesus.
Wherever my soul is wounded, I command it healed now.
Cause for every heaviness and every cloud that is over my mind to be lifted now in the name of Jesus.
Purify my mind, God, that where I have experienced trauma, experienced pain, let my mind be delivered from the bondage that comes with it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me a clear conscience, remove every sort of guilt that is in me.
Today I forgive those who have been consuming my mind.
Today I let go of whatever was troubling me, I set my mind on you.
I will no longer be led by my emotions, but I will be led by your spirit.
Father, fortify my mind and fortify my spirit.
Today, by reason of the blood of Jesus, Father, I declare I have a sound mind.
Father, I declare freedom over my mind, I declare liberty over my mind in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am unbreakable, I am unbroken in the name of Jesus.
The Lord has kept my mind.
I have the mind of Christ.
Let my mind be sure today, let my mind be safe today, in Jesus' name. Amen.

title: For Strength and Renewed Energy
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I call upon your name, because you are the Lord who can renew my youth.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my strength is not enough.
My abilities are not enough to rescue me from the hand of the wicked, but your strength, your power is eternal, it is limitless.
I give you my strength in exchange for your strength.
Father, my strength is only weakness, but your strength perfects me.
Your word clearly says those who wait upon the Lord, he shall renew their strength.
Father, may I receive new strength.

Father, in the name of Jesus, as your angels ministered unto your son Jesus and they strengthened him in order for him to go through with the cross, which was his destiny, Father, you have ordained a destiny for me.
Father, I pray for supernatural energy, I pray for supernatural strength, that strength that will carry me, that strength that will drive me.
I will have the strength to run and never be tired, I will have the strength to run and never faint.
Give me the ability to fulfill my purpose, to fulfill my destiny, and to crush the spirit of slumber and to crush the spirit of delay.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I draw strength from you today, because you are my strength.
I am weak, oh Lord, strengthen me by your spirit.
Father, renew my youth today, restore the ability that was once within, the ability to create, the ability to chase after the dreams you have given me.
Bring back life into my spirit, by your spirit, oh Lord, sustain me today and give me strength.
Father, strengthen me, send your angels to strengthen me, even as they did Christ Jesus, your son.
Father, let your angels minister unto me.
Father, let my spirit be strengthened, let my soul be strengthened, even my physical body be strengthened.
Any fatigue, any tiredness in me that has crept in today, Father, let strength arise in me, let new strength arise in me, let fresh grace arise in me.
Sicknesses that have crippled my energy, crippled my ability to go and do things that God has given me to do.
By the authority of the Lord Jesus that is upon my life, I command that medical condition to be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Everything that is used to shut me down today is broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, today in the name of Jesus, I receive renewed strength.
You who never slumber, you who never faint, you who never get weary, Lord God, transform me today, renew my strength today.
I will not be weary, I will not faint, I will not fall, I will not fail.
Father, in the name of Jesus, your strength is made perfect in my weakness, my Lord and my God.
I receive new strength, I receive boldness.
Today my strength is renewed in the truth of who you are.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For My Marriage
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for grace, Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for mercy.
Oh God, have mercy on my family, Lord, have mercy on my home.
Look beyond my faults, God, and have mercy.
May your grace be upon me, upon my home, upon my marriage, upon my children.
I lay my marriage at your feet, Father.
I cannot change anyone, I have understood, I can't change anyone, but you can change people, your spirit can change people.
Lord, I deliver them in your hands, I deliver my spouse in your hands.
The desire to be right in me, today I forfeit it, I let go of it.
That which I said concerning my spouse, that which I said because I was angry, those vain things, Lord, I renounce that.
Teach me to guide my mouth.
Father, whatever is causing division in my family, whatever is bringing strife in my home, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every root of contention, be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Any power trying to divide my family, any power trying to separate my family, by reason of the blood of Jesus, I scatter you now, I scatter you now, I scatter you now, I scatter you by fire.
Leave my marriage, leave my relationship.
You will not destroy my spouse, you will not destroy our destiny in the mighty name of Jesus.

Every spirit turning wife against husband, turning husband against wife, turning children against parent, turning parents against children, every spirit that is trying to cause division in my home, in the mighty name of Jesus, I pull you down today.
I evict you from my marriage.
I bring my home under the rulership of Christ.
I separate myself from every secret marriage, every demonic agreement, every demonic association, every demonic tie that is holding me.
Lord Jesus, secure my family today, that the enemy will have no way to destroy my family.
Every access point that the enemy has used before, today I shut every access.
Father, in the name of Jesus, light up the fire of passion in my marriage.
Let it never be quenched, for your glory.
I speak resurrection to my marriage.
I speak wholeness, peace, joy in my marriage.
My marriage is revived, my destiny is restored.
Let my joy be full in my marriage, in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: For a Godly Spouse
segments: Thank you, Father, for the sacrifice of your son Jesus upon the cross for my restoration into relationship with you.
Every divine relationship that you have ordained for my life, I pray that you restore it.
Father, give me spiritual perception, oh God, of the things that you desire me to look, Father, the people that you have placed around me.
Father, that I will know them by the spirit, I will know no man by the flesh.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my eyes to see your people, give me discernment to know those who are sent for me.
Open my eyes to understand who you sent for me.
To not see the physical appearance, but to be able to recognize the spiritual grace, Father, that you have manifested in them.
Show me, Father, what relationship to engage in.
Father, in the name of Jesus, visit my family, visit my marriage, visit my relationship, visit my house, visit my people, visit everything that has to do with me today.
Oh Lord, every demonic entanglement that has caused delays in my marriage, Father, by your spirit reverse it now.
Every spiritual husband, I bind you and I remove you out of me, spiritual husband, spiritual wife, in the mighty name of Jesus.
You spiritual husband, I arrest you, I bind you, I cause the ground that you are standing on to be on fire now.
I command you to begin to be consumed, be consumed, be consumed, be consumed, be consumed.
May every wicked relationship be scattered in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every wicked relationship designed to delay my life, designed to confuse my life, designed to empty me, designed to dry me, designed to pull me back, designed to cause me to fall.
I separate myself from wrong relationships.
Every wrong relationship that is causing me to dwell in sin, to fall in sin, to live in sin, I scatter you in the name of Jesus.
Father God, I will live in the divine purposes of God, even my relationships be sanctified, even my relationship be with purpose.
Let all divine relationships, every divine partner, let them be put in alignment now, that I will fulfill my destiny.
I will not miss the divine appointment.
I will not miss the divine relationship.
Every divine relationship will come to pass, every divine relationship will flourish.
Every divine partner has been restored unto me.
Father, I thank you that restoration has come.
From today I pray, oh God, restoration is my portion, fullness is my portion.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Children and Family
segments: Lord Jesus, I pray for my family, I pray for my children, I pray for my seed.
Oh God, Father, that my family will be found in you, my family will never be found outside of your purpose, my family will never be found outside of your will.
Let my family be secure in you, Father, in the place of salvation.
Every family member that has gone astray, Father, I bring them into an encounter with you, that their souls will be saved in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may my children return unto you.
Father, give them a deep love for you, give them a deep devotion for you, give them a deep hunger for you.
Every addiction that has tried to rise, every distraction, every bad influence, I separate it from my children.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I war for my children, and I war for my seed to come.
I destroy every agenda of the enemy, I destroy every plan of the enemy concerning my children, concerning my seed.
In the name of Jesus, Satan, you will not have my children.
Devils will not have my family.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
Every demonic power that has been influencing my family, that has been influencing my children, that has been influencing my spouse, that has been influencing anything in my family.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let that demonic power be destroyed.
Every spirit of addiction, every spirit of affliction, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of division in my family, in my children, with my spouse, may it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every curse connected to my name, connected to my family, connected to my children, connected to my bloodline, let it break, break, break.
In the name of Jesus, I dip my family into the blood of Jesus.
All my children are in the blood of Jesus.
Their bodies, their spirits, and their souls are dipped into the blood of Jesus.
No premature death will find me or my children.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak divine protection over my family.
Wherever they go, they are protected, wherever they set foot, they are protected.
Let the fire be around my household, let the fire be around my children, let the fire be around my home in the name of Jesus.
Father, let there be divine order in my family, in my children, in everything we do.
My family is free, my children are free.
It is well with my family, it is well with my children, it is well with my seed.
Lord, let my joy be full concerning my children, concerning my family.
Thank you, Father, for the grace that flows to my seed, thank you, Father, for the grace that flows through my children.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: To Forgive and Release Bitterness
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, thank you for your love, thank you for your mercy.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I have been walking the wrong way before you.
My heart has been distorted, it has been very distorted because of all that has been happening around me.
Forgive me, Father, as I forgive those who also have offended me.
Father, help me to let go of all those who have offended me, of all those who have injured me.
Father, I choose to forgive.
Father, I choose to forgive.
Remove any hurt inside of me, remove the pain from within me, and reestablish me, oh Lord.
Remove every hardness of the heart, remove unforgiveness from my heart.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every impurity in me, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let it be washed out of me.
Help me to forgive those who have offended me, those who lied to me, those who betrayed, who turned against me.
Father, from today let forgiveness be my nature.
Father, whoever it is that offended me, maybe my mother, my father, whoever betrayed me, Father, I forgive them and I let go of it.
I will not carry it anymore, I'd rather have you than carry weight that will destroy my life.

Any kind of demonic spirit that was holding me because of unforgiveness, that was holding me because of bitterness, that has caused me sickness, in the mighty name of Jesus, I command it to be broken.
Today I release everything that has been holding me back.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today, every root of evil within me, Father, uproot it by your spirit.
In the name of Jesus, I lift up my family, where there is any separation, where there is unforgiveness, Father, let there be reconciliation now.
Let there be restoration now, in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today, my Lord and my God, let every work of the enemy in my life be broken.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I forgive my brother, my sister, Father, forgive me also, I forgive my parents, I forgive my workmates, I forgive anyone that has offended me.
I forgive and let go.
I let go of every single bitterness, I let go of every pain.
Father, I don't even want to remember it, I just want to take the lessons from it.
But today, Father, give me a heart to embrace my enemies, in the mighty name of Jesus, because I want to be like you, Lord Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Covering My Home
segments: Lord Jesus, you are my everything, you are my desire, you are my focus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, remember me, remember my house, let deliverance come, let salvation come.
As for me and my house, we shall serve the Lord.
Father, in the name of Jesus, visit my children, visit my house, visit my family.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may my family be secure.
I pray the prayer of protection for me and my entire house.
May we be covered, may generations to come after me be covered in the mighty name of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I secure my entire family, I secure those who I love.
Father, release me and my house.
Whatever has been unleashed against me and my house, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let that gate be closed.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every spirit that wants to destroy my home, my family, in the mighty name of Jesus, I scatter the plan of the enemy.
No demon shall hide in my house, no demon shall hide in my children.
Every spirit bringing division and separation in my house, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I cancel whatever spirit was following my household.
No premature death shall come close to my door.
All that was going to bring a funeral into my house, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
There shall be no sickness in my house.
Father, let there be no tears in my house.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I cleanse my environment today from all kinds of chaos.
From all kinds of noise, from all kinds of sounds and signals that are demonic, in the name of Jesus.
Father, I pray that my house will know the sustenance of God and the overflow blessing of God.
God's hand is upon my house, God's hand is upon my family.
I am divinely protected, me and my house, because of the covenant.
Today me and my house, we shall be free.
Me and my house, we are preserved.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Spirit Spouses Fighting My Marriage
segments: Father, deliver me.
Deliver me, Lord Jesus.
Remember me, Lord Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself.
I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant.
Whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let that covenant catch fire by reason of the blood of Jesus.
I am disconnected from witchcraft, from sorcery, I am disconnected from occultic powers, from marine kingdoms.
That spiritual husband, that spiritual wife, that cancer, that tumor, that confusion, whatever it is, I disconnect myself.
Every demonic spouse, I divorce myself from you.
Everything married to me, I separate myself from it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic spirit hiding in my life, I command you in the name of Jesus, who is King and Lord and God.
Come out of me, come out of my family, come out of my children.
You evil spirit, you spiritual husband, you who has caused death in my house, come out of me in the name of Jesus.
You spiritual husband, I arrest you, I bind you, I cause the ground that you're standing on to be on fire now.
Every wicked power, release me now in Jesus' name.
You will not torment me anymore, you will not plague me anymore, you will not visit me anymore, you spiritual husband, depart from my life.
Let every spirit of witchcraft and sorcery be broken in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Take everything you have put in me, everything you have used to marry yourself to me.
Every damage that you have caused, every issue that you have caused, take everything back and never touch my life.
Your work has expired, your work has expired in Jesus' name.
You spiritual husband, I divorce you from me by reason of the blood of Jesus, you spiritual husband, go, you are divorced from me.
You will never be with me again, return to the pit where you come from, where you belong.
Every one of you, out in Jesus' name, you have no place inside of me.
Every spirit fighting against me in my marriage that I don't even know, in the mighty name of Jesus, may that spirit be scattered today.
When it comes to my marriage, let my joy be full.
Father, I am set free today.
My home will be better than ever.
I belong to King Jesus, I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Breaking Patterns of Broken Marriages
segments: In the name of Jesus, every secret covenant holding my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be broken.
Wherever there are covenants, I divorce myself from them.
Broken relationships, broken marriages, let it be finished today in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Every satanic network over my life, I break it and I pull it down.
Where there are occultic powers, where there are occultic covenants, let them be burned, let them be destroyed.
Every blood, every altar connected to me, let it be scattered where it came from, let it catch fire and be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
The powers of witchcraft and sorcery that have held me from my father's side, from my mother's side, you evil and bad spirits, you are arrested, you are bound.
Every altar, if my name is on it, let it catch fire.
If my children's name is on it, let it catch fire.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, there will be a separation between me and every evil spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic pattern following me, because of my connection, because of my association, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit bringing division and separation in my house, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, any spirit dividing my house, every spirit turning us against each other, in the mighty name of Jesus, I pull that spirit down today.
You spirit from the water, I destroy your connection to my family.
I divorce you from my children, I divorce you from everyone that you have connected yourself to.
I strip you of your power, I weaken you, you evil diabolical spirit, by the power the King of glory has given me, I send you to the pit.
You will never touch me, you will never enter again, never come back in Jesus' name.
Let the cord be severed today between every demonic tie and my life.
Let there be a distinction and let there be a separation.
I divorce every lie of the enemy, I divorce myself from it.
Everything that denies me what God has promised me, I divorce myself from it.
I divorce myself from the past, I divorce myself from past memories.
I receive everything new that you have for me.
Father, restore my family now, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Me and my family will be free.
I am divorced from every occultic power, I am divorced from everything that is of the kingdom of darkness.
I belong to Jesus, I declare this in the presence of demons, in the presence of angels and in the presence of the Holy Spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, amen.

title: Against Witchcraft in My Home
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, because of the blood of Jesus, I am free.
Every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of sorcery, may it be cancelled now in the name of Jesus upon my children, upon my family, upon my future.
Spirit of witchcraft, in the mighty name of Jesus, be thou broken.
That witchcraft in my family, I destroy it in the name of Jesus.
Whosoever is releasing witchcraft against the family, against the children, against the destiny, against the purpose, whosoever that witch, in the name of Jesus, today I terminate your assignment.
No witchcraft will prevail in my family, no witchcraft will remain in my home, no witchcraft will remain over my children.

Every witchcraft that has been behind the afflictions in my home, every witchcraft that has been behind the rejection, every witchcraft that has been behind the suffering, you witch, be arrested, be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
Every witchcraft enchantment be broken, every witchcraft incantation be broken, every witchcraft spell be broken, every witchcraft bondage be broken, every witchcraft decree be broken.
Father, let the blood of Jesus begin to speak, by reason of the blood of Jesus, over my home in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, wherever it started, even in generations past, let your power locate the root of that witchcraft and completely annihilate it from my family in the name of Jesus.
Every altar that was raised where demonic sacrifices were made, today I tear every altar down.

Whatsoever was done in darkness, whatsoever was done in secret, whatsoever was agreed in darkness, whatsoever was agreed in secret, I expose every witchcraft against my family, I expose every witchcraft against my marriage.
Every power of witchcraft, every power of sorcery, you are under my feet and I am above you, and I trample on you today in the name of Jesus.
You will not manipulate my mind, you will not manipulate my home, you will not manipulate my children in the mighty name of Jesus.

I disconnect my family, I disconnect my loved ones, I disconnect my children, I disconnect them in the name of Jesus from every witchcraft, from every power of darkness, from every design of the enemy.
Every witchcraft power that is operating from behind darkness, today I expose you, I arrest you and I break you in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every enchantment set up against me, let every plan of the enemy against me and my family, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Every evil spirit over my family, I terminate your agenda, I break you in the name of Jesus.
Spirit of witchcraft, I scatter you now from my home, I scatter you now from my marriage.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from curses, I am separated from witchcraft, I am separated from sorcery.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Demons have no place around my family.
My children are free, my home is free, my loved ones are free.
Because of the blood of Jesus, my family is covered.
Because of the blood of Jesus, victory is mine, in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: For Restoration of My Marriage
segments: Lord Jesus, you are in this house, touch my family, heal my family, deliver my family.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the strength today to understand how to let go.
Father, whoever it is that offended me, whoever betrayed me, I forgive them and I let go of it.
I will not carry it anymore, I'd rather have you than carry weight that will destroy my life.
Lord, I deliver them in your hands, I deliver my spouse in your hands.
Father, let there be healing in my family today.
Every spirit affecting my marriage, I break your hold in the name of Jesus Christ.
You will not torment my home, you will not torment me.
Lord Jesus, every agenda of the enemy happening in the background, every agenda of Satan in the dark, let it not only be uncovered, but let it be destroyed.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every enchantment against me and my family, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Whatever is trying to remove the answer of God from my life, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I send the word of God into my life.
May every area that is broken in my life be restored today.
Put my home back together, put my marriage back together.
Lord, let there be a completed restoration in my home.
Restore my heart strength, restore my vision, restore my joy, restore purpose.
I declare restoration in my marriage.
I declare restoration in my home.
I declare restoration in my family.
I declare restoration in every area of my life in the name of Jesus.
Restoration of the mind, restoration of the heart, restoration of the soul.
My marriage is revived.
My home is aligned with the promises of God concerning me.
Today is a new beginning in my marriage.
Today is a new beginning in my home.
Lord, thank you for restoring every broken area in my life today, thank you for restoring marriages.
Restoration is my portion in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Love and Unity in My Marriage
segments: Father, let me know peace.
Father, as I keep my eyes on you, let me be kept in perfect peace.
Let my family know peace, let my children know peace, let my career know peace, let my marriage know peace.
Father, in the name of Jesus, encounter my family today.
Undo everything that the enemy desired to do, and give us a new beginning now.
Every spirit of confusion, every spirit of division in my family, in my children, with my spouse, may it be broken in the name of Jesus.
May the power of witchcraft against my marriage be broken.
May every scheme of the enemy be broken.
Every plan, every trap, every witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let every spirit of witchcraft and sorcery be broken in the name of the Lord Jesus.
May your will be done for the family.
The spirit of death be canceled, the spirit of anti-marriage be canceled, spirit of witchcraft be canceled.
Every trouble that has plagued my family, Father, from today, because of me, let peace mark my family.
Every trouble be stilled, every trouble be stilled, every trouble be ceased by your peace.
Let my atmosphere be peace.
Show me your favor and your goodness, show me your kindness.
My home will be better than ever.
The blessing that God has ordained for me, no one will ever take it from me.
Today, Father, let your will be done in my life, in my body, in my heart, in my mind, in my spirit.
Lord Jesus, thank you for helping me, my home is restored.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Delay in Marriage
segments: Jesus, my God and my Lord, answer my prayer.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today solve my situation.
Remember your word to me, oh God, and today solve that situation.
God, bring everything about me, my life, into alignment with your promise.
Remember me, oh God.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every spirit fighting against me that I don't even know, in the mighty name of Jesus, may that spirit be scattered today.
I scatter it in the name of Jesus, I scatter it in the name of Jesus, I break his power.
May the power of witchcraft be broken.
May every scheme of the enemy against my marriage be broken.
Every plan, every trap, every witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I am separated from every spirit of darkness.
Every wicked spirit that would try to lay claim upon me, I am separated now by the blood of Jesus.
I am divorced from every demon, from every agenda of every spirit.
I break his hold from me now in the name of Jesus.
Father, let every curse be broken, every misfortune be removed.
That cloud of darkness, Lord, that has caused death, chaos, havoc, lack, stagnancy, Father, today it ends in the name of Jesus.
Let there be a mighty turn around from today.
Because of the blessing, every curse is broken.
Because of the blessing, every agreement with the dark is broken.
I'm opening doors that have been closed, doors of marriage, of business, because I feel delayed in that area, I expedite it in Jesus' name.
May God send me somebody.
From today, my future is bright, my doors have been opened.
The blessing of the Lord will follow me, and I am disconnected from my past in the mighty name of Jesus Christ.
Father, fulfill your word in Jesus' name.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Breaking Spirit Spouse Bondage
segments: Father, deliver me.
Deliver me, Lord Jesus.
Remember me, Lord Jesus.
Father, because of the blood of Jesus, I am coming out of this cage.
Because of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from spiritual husbands, I am separated from curses.

By the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself, I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant, whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously.
Let that covenant catch fire by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Let it lose its power in the name of Jesus.
I am disconnected from witchcraft, from sorcery, I am disconnected from occultic powers, from marine kingdoms.
That spiritual husband, that spiritual wife, that cancer, that tumor, that confusion, whatever it is, I disconnect myself.
Every demonic spirit hiding in my life, I command you in the name of Jesus, who is King and Lord and God, come out of me.
Every spirit that is not of God, spiritual husbands, spiritual wives, demonic children, I command you, come out of my body, come out of my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
You unclean spirit, spiritual wife, in the mighty name of Jesus, your time in me has expired.
In the name of Jesus, your time is up.
You spiritual husband, go, you are divorced from me, I tie you up, I bind you, I return you to the pit where you came from in the mighty name of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus I am free, you no longer have a place in me, you no longer can do anything with me.
Take everything that you came with, take whatever you put inside of me out in the name of Jesus.
You spiritual husband, your time has expired, I remove your jurisdiction from my body and from my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, because of the blood of Jesus, let everything that I was fed by evil be flushed out in the name of Jesus.
Whatever was holding me back, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I revoke it, by reason of the blood of Jesus, I erase it.
In the name of Jesus, I belong to Jesus, I belong to King Jesus.
I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon.
I enter into my rest in Jesus' name, it is finished.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Breaking Ungodly Soul Ties
segments: Father, today I give my life to you.
Father, I renounce where my feet stepped in that I was not supposed to be.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever I am joined to that does not come from you, every spirit that is not of God, may that hold be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
May every wicked relationship be scattered in the mighty name of Jesus.

Every wicked relationship designed to delay my life, designed to confuse my life, designed to empty me, designed to dry me, designed to pull me back, designed to cause me to fall, in the name of Jesus.
Father, I separate from wrong relationships.
Every relationship in my life that is derailing the purpose of God, every relationship in my life that is derailing the call of God on my life, Father, I scatter it in the name of Jesus.
Every wrong relationship that is causing me to dwell in sin, to fall in sin, to live in sin, I scatter you in the name of Jesus.
That spiritual husband, that spiritual wife, that cancer, that tumor, that confusion, whatever it is, I disconnect myself.
You wicked spirit, you demon, in the mighty name of Jesus, I disconnect you from my soul.
I disconnect you from my spirit, I disconnect you from everything that has to do with me.
Wherever there is covenants, I divorce myself from it.
Where I have been tied for ages, for years, where my destiny has been kept, which caused broken relationships, broken marriages, let it be finished today in the name of the Lord Jesus.
I disconnect myself from every chain of the past, I disconnect myself from every agreement from the past that has followed me into the present.
I break every attachment of evil, I break every satanic connection, I break every occultic connection.
I break every attachment of the past, I break every link from the past in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, where there is every satanic network over my life, demonic communications, let it be disconnected, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Even my relationships be sanctified, even my relationship be with purpose.
I will not be drawn into darkness.
I declare freedom over my home, I declare freedom over my family by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Freedom comes today, freedom comes now.
I belong to King Jesus, I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am disconnected, I am disconnected.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Have Been Betrayed
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, make me an instrument of love.
Teach me to love those who are coming for me, teach me to love those who falsely accuse me, teach me to forgive those who fabricate things against me.
Teach me to love those who have forsaken me, even though I was there for them in their time of need, even though I gave my last dime to make sure they had everything.
Lord Jesus, heal my heart today.
Father, whoever it is that offended me, may be my mother, my father, whoever betrayed me, whatever, Father, I forgive them and I let go of it.
I will not carry it anymore, I rather have you than carry weight that will destroy my life.
I release them from my heart, Lord, I release them, Father, I release them to you.
Purify me and sanctify me, cleanse me completely.
Father, you have forgiven me, teach me to also forgive, that, Lord, I may become an expression of your love.
Father, I pray, give me the capacity to forgive.
Help me to accept what happened and to acknowledge that broken people break things.
Father, I feel everything that they have said, but I forgive them.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today, every root of evil within me, Father, uproot it by your spirit.
Cause me to recognize, God, that where they hurt me, you were just stretching me.
When they betrayed me, God, you were purifying me.
That thing that has held me, whatever the name is, that thing that has held my family, no matter what the name is, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I am free from it.
What they did was not my fault, it was their own fault, I did nothing to deserve this.
They have no idea what they are saying, they don't know any better, Lord, have mercy on them and have mercy on me also, because once upon a time I was like that.
May my eyes be opened, may my discernment be activated, that I will know who is for me and who is against me.
May I never be betrayed by a kiss.
Let the prophetic word that is declared over my life by you be fulfilled in my life.
Lord, I trust you to fulfill your will in my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Household Enemies
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for this hour.
Today I understand that you have anointed me, and you anointed me to destroy the foundations of the enemy.
Every single thing that Satan did in my family, his desire was to continue the pattern in my children.
Because of the anointing, let every wrong be corrected.
Every evil spirit with an intention against my family, I cancel you in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of wickedness that has tried to infiltrate my family, infiltrate my home, I command, catch fire now.
Every evil spirit that will try to divide my household, catch fire in the name of Jesus.
I sever your connection, I sever my agreement with you, I break you now.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I draw a line around my family.
You cannot enter!

Every demonic power that has been influencing my family, that has been influencing my children, that has been influencing my spouse, that has been influencing anything in my family, let that demonic power be destroyed.
Every spirit of addiction, every spirit of affliction, every spirit of confusion, every spirit of division in my family, in my children, with my spouse, may it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Everything the enemy is trying to do over my life, over my family, every night while I sleep, I cancel it, I cancel it, I cancel it, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Every plan of the enemy against me and my children, every plan of the enemy against me and my family, every plan of the enemy against everything that you have given me, I pull it down.
That witchcraft in my family, I destroy it in the name of Jesus.
No witchcraft will prevail in my family.
No witchcraft will remain in my home, no witchcraft will remain over my children.
Today I stop every demonic agent in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every agent that will come against my assignment, that will come against my destiny, I scatter in the mighty name of Jesus.
I remove you from everything that has to do with me.
Come out in the name of Jesus, you demon behind the issues of my life, you behind the issues in my family, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Today you have set your seal upon me, and today you have defended me against all enemies.
I make every one of my enemies powerless in the mighty name of Jesus.
The angels of God are activated in my life, they are activated in my family.
I am secure in Jesus Christ.
I become freedom for my children, I become freedom for my household.
I am free in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: For My Children's Destiny
segments: Father, my family is useful to you.
Father, I give my children to you.
Father, use my children, Father, use my seed, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Your name will be glorified through my children, your name will be glorified through my seed.
Father, make them carriers of your virtue, make them carriers of your word, make them carriers of your spirit.
Those that are born and my children unborn, my seed born, and even the children to come, Father, use them for your glory.
Use them for your divine purpose, Father, establish your kingdom through their hands, establish your kingdom through their life.
Father, my children are yours.
My sons, my daughters shall be the instruments of heaven in their generation.
God, may my children produce after your kind, may my family reflect your kind.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may my children return unto you.
Give them a deep love for you, give them a deep devotion for you, give them a deep hunger for you.
Every addiction that has tried to rise, every distraction, every bad influence, I separate it from my children.
Make my children men and women of fire, make my children men and women of the presence of God.
In the name of Jesus, Satan, you will not have my children.
Every power of darkness targeting my children, targeting my family, targeting my home, you will not have them in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
Every plan of demonic patterns to be established in my bloodline, today I arrest you in the name of Jesus.
Every curse that has come down the bloodline pursuing my life, the life of my children, the life of my family, today I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
No assignment to cut my life short will succeed today.
I neutralize every plan of the enemy, I destroy and frustrate every agenda of darkness.
My children will not be held by any curse.
My seed will not be bound by any curse.
My children are covered, my children are secured.
Father, I thank you for my children, Father, I thank you for my children's children, Father, I thank you for the children to come after, Amen.

title: For Protection over My Children
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, divine protection for my family, divine protection for my children.
In the name of Jesus, I dip my family into the blood of Jesus.
All my children are in the blood of Jesus.
Today I dip all my children in the blood of Jesus, their bodies, their spirits, and their souls.
No premature death will find me or my children.
In the name of Jesus, Satan, you will not have my children.
Devils will not have my family.
Every assignment of demons, every power of darkness targeting my children, targeting my family, targeting my home, you will not have them in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
Every plan of satanic destruction, every plan of demonic patterns to be established in my bloodline, today I arrest you in the name of Jesus.
I declare you will not touch me, you will not see that son, you will not see that daughter, you will not see that family member in the mighty name of Jesus.
Everyone that is coming from me to generations after, in the name of Jesus, Father, I secure them now.
My children are covered, my children are secured.
I establish a law of protection over my family, Father, that calamities will not befall my family.
Father, arrows that are intended for people will not catch them by mistake.
Wherever they go, they are protected, wherever they set foot, they are protected.
No accidents, no evil in the name of Jesus.
Father, you will keep me and my children from the arrow that flies by day.
There is no claim over my life, no claim over my children, no claim over my bloodline.
I have life, my children shall live.
Protect their days, protect their lives.
Their lives are preserved, they will never ever be cut short in Jesus' name.
Father, I thank you for preservation, I thank you for preservation.
Thank you, Father, thank you for protection, thank you for your protection, Lord, Amen.
