title: For My Wayward Child
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, may my children return unto you.
Father, give them a deep love for you, give them a deep devotion for you, give them a deep hunger for you.
That son, that daughter, Father, let that seed in their spirit, Father, let it begin to draw them back, back to the presence of God, back to the house of the Lord.
Father, I redirect their affection, I redirect their attention, I redirect their devotion.
I redirect their love, I redirect their focus, Father.
Father, I give them a heart of flesh.
Every addiction that has tried to rise, every distraction, every bad influence, I separate it from my children.
Every wicked spirit attacking my children, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
Wherever confusion has entered into the minds of my children, let it be uprooted now.
Whatever seed of darkness has been planted into my children, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
You wicked spirits, I command you now in the name of Jesus, come out from their hearts, come out from their minds.
Let their minds be released from the spirit of confusion, oh God, and let clarity come.
I disconnect them from every work of darkness in the name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, you spirit from the water, I destroy your connection to my family, you will no longer steal children from my family.
Father, let your Spirit arise in my children, let boldness arise in my children, let faith arise in my children.
Let their identity be rooted in Christ.
Everyone in my family shall be born again in the name of Jesus.
My sons, my daughters shall be the instruments of heaven in their generation.
My sons and my daughters from the north, the south, the east, and the west, wherever they are, Father, I call my children back to you.
I call them back to your house, I call them back to your home, I call them back to your temple, Father.
I draw my children back, I call my children back.
I decree and declare that my children will walk in alignment with the word.
My children shall live and not die.
May my children return back to you, oh God, may my children return back to you, Lord, Amen.

title: Breaking Curses off My Children
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, every curse that has been declared over my life, over my children, over my home, my destiny, my purpose, Father, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse over my family be broken, every curse over my children be broken.
Every carryover curse, every carryover debt, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse that has come down the bloodline pursuing my life, the life of my children, the life of my family, today I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse spoken over my bloodline, break, every curse pronounced over my name, break in the name of Jesus.
Every word that was spoken to release the curse, break in the name of Jesus.

Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was signed on my behalf, that was entered into on the behalf of my bloodline, on the behalf of my generations, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.
No curse will stand over my children, no curse will operate in my bloodline.
My children's head will not hold any curse.
Wherever a curse was released, Father, let your power go to the root.
Let it go through the source to the origin of any curse that has afflicted my family, any curse that has afflicted my stability, any curse that has afflicted my children.
Every pattern of premature death, every pattern of untimely death, I cancel it now.
It will not touch me, it will not touch my children, it will not touch my parents, it will not touch my bloodline.
A new pattern has been established from today for my children, for my family, for my home.
Father, I redeem my family from every curse, I redeem my children from every curse.
Every curse was nailed to your cross, so every curse that was operating, Father, I strip every legality by reason of the blood of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, generational curses are broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, no curse shall be perpetuated.
I become freedom for my children, I become freedom for my household, I become freedom for my bloodline.
As you set me free, Father, freedom shall go from me to my children, to my children's children.
I draw the bloodline, Father, a new beginning, free of curse, that the blessing of God will abound in my life, in my children, in my home, in my destiny, from today.
Father, wherever the curse has been operating, Father, let your blessing, let your blessing, let your blessing rest on my family in the name of Jesus.
No curse will speak over my children.
Every curse is destroyed, every curse is neutralized, every curse is broken.
Father, I thank you, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Dedicating My Children to God
segments: Father, I give you my children.
Lord, today I genuinely give my child to you, as Samuel's mother gave up Samuel.
I am giving up my children to you.
Watch over them, lead them, guide them, that everything to do with their life, Lord, be centered by you.
Lord, I have given their life to you, because you gave them to me, I give them to you.
Father, use my children, Father, use my seed, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, my children belong to you.
My children are yours, my children are yours.
I offer them to you as a living sacrifice, Father.
Your name will be glorified through my children, your name will be glorified through my seed.
Father, make them carriers of your virtue, make them carriers of your word, make them carriers of your spirit.
Lord, today as I present my children before you, may they never be able to escape your presence.
When they err you will bring them back, when they lose their way you will send your angels to guide them back.
May they forever stand in your presence, may they forever be secure, may they forever be preserved.
Father, rescue them, secure them, hide their lives in Christ and in you.
May your covenant be with them, may your covering be with them.
Father, as I give my children to you, may no work of the enemy ever touch them.
Whatever intention of Satan to shorten their life, to destroy their life, to disrupt their life, may it never come to pass in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I declare long life, I declare long life, prosperity, divine protection over my children.
Premature death will never be their portion.
There will be no generational curses or patterns upon my children.
Father, I pray that their lives are secure today, give me the wisdom and the understanding to be able to raise my children in a way that is pleasing unto you.
May they always know how to hear your voice and they always know how to return to you, Lord.
Lord, as I touch them, they are secure, they are protected, they will fulfill their destinies.
Father, I thank you that you have done it and your word is fulfilled in their lives in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Parents
segments: My father, my father, in the name of Jesus.
Father, today I rely on you.
Any chain that got me before, any chain that I fell into before, by the power of the Holy Spirit, may that chain be broken.
The chain that was upon my mother, the chain that was upon my father, the chain that was upon my family, the chain that is upon my children, in the mighty name of Jesus, break.
Wherever you tied my family, wherever you tied my mother, wherever you tied my father, wherever you tied my children, wherever you tied my seed, in the name of Jesus, break today.
Your power is broken from today, your hold is destroyed from today, your influence is neutralized from today.
Any chain that held my family, no more.
The chain of sin, the chain of iniquity, be broken from my parents in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let every agent of the devil sent against my family, may they be scattered.
Your assignment over my parents is terminated today.
My father, my maker, as I begin to pray, any altar raised against my family, raised against my life, raised against my destiny, raised against my future, from today it shall be broken.
Every wicked altar, every wicked enchantment, wherever you are located, catch fire, catch fire, catch fire of the Holy Ghost.
If that strong man was in the time of my father, or my fathers before my father, I arrest the strong man, him and his host.
I cast them into the pit in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every spiritual contention in my life, every spiritual challenge in my life, in the name of Jesus, I silence those demons.
I silence those spirits, I silence those challenges in the name of Jesus.
From my generations before me, Father, my father's side, my mother's side, every blessing that was stolen, every blessing that was stripped, every blessing that was taken, Father, I take it back.
Whatever was taken from my fathers, may it be restored unto me now, may it be restored unto me in the mighty name of Jesus.
I receive what is for my family, I receive what is for my bloodline, I receive what is for my generation, I receive what is for my parents, I receive what is for my household in the name of Jesus.
May my joy be full when I see their doors open in the name of Jesus.
Let there be overflowing joy now in the name of Jesus.
Father, I am free from every chain.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Poverty and Financial Lack
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your grace.
I thank you that all that I desire and all that I need, Lord, you have made provision available for my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, cleanse my heart today, purify my heart today.
Deliver me from attachments, financial attachments.
Father, remove unbelief from my heart.
Everything assigned to destroy my finances, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be scattered and let it be destroyed.
Every assignment of dryness, every assignment of penury, every assignment of struggle, every assignment of poverty, be arrested in the name of Jesus.
Patterns of poverty, patterns of limitation, patterns of confusion, patterns of difficulty, in the mighty name of Jesus, let every evil pattern be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I break the power of debt over my life.
I will not serve mammon.
Money will serve me as I serve you.
Father, I break every chain of debt, I break every chain of debt, I break every chain of debt.
Father, whatever has hung on my neck as a weight, whatever has hung on my shoulders as a weight, Father, that chain today, I break it by fire.
I break the chains of working like an elephant and reaping like an ant.
I break every chain of hard labor without results.
I seal every hole that has been draining my finances.
In the mighty name of Jesus, may my finances be activated, may my life flourish again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my capacity to manage wealth.
A poverty mentality, a struggling mentality, a paycheck to paycheck mentality, a working hard mentality and not working smart mentality, Father, in the name of Jesus, today I remove that mindset.
My days of poverty have expired, my days of struggle have expired.
Lack is a thing of the past, poverty is a thing of the past, from today in the name of Jesus.
I declare myself completely liberated from debt.
I shall never borrow, I will be a lender, I will be a giver.
Debt is not my portion this year, I am delivered from debt.
My basket will never be empty, my well will never run dry.
Poverty is no longer my portion, lack is not my portion.
The blessing of the Lord rests upon everything I touch.
Lord, I will always have more than enough because you have said it to be so.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Prosperity in My Work and Business
segments: Father, I thank you that prosperity comes from you, increase comes from you.
Whatever you will ever give me, Lord, material things, spiritual things, wealth of all kinds, be assured, Lord, it is already yours.
I am simply going to use it as you want.
Father, help me not to forget, let me not be like the children of Israel that when you prosper me, I forget you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today I receive the ability to make wealth, I receive power to make wealth.
Increase my capacity to receive every single bit of increase that you have.
That demon that has been holding my breakthroughs, that demon that has been stealing my jobs and opportunities, today in the name of Jesus, the fire of the Holy Spirit shall destroy them.
In the mighty name of Jesus, today I break the iron bow.
Whatever I touch will prosper, nothing will contend with what God has put in my hands.
Father, I wage war with my hands against every poverty, every sickness, whatsoever has been a limitation for my family.
Nothing shall contend with my fruitfulness from today, nothing shall contend with my productivity from today.
I shall no longer labor in vain, whatever I do shall bear the fruits, in the mighty name of Jesus.
As Elijah commanded rain to fall, I command rain to fall on my business, on the work of my hands.
Father, today may the windows of heaven be open over me.

Father, open up the windows of heaven over my business, open up the windows of heaven over my career, open up the windows of heaven over my job, open up the windows of heaven over the works of my hands.
Father, in the work and the labor you have given me to do, I will see result, I will see the harvest, I will see increase, I will see expansion.
Father, let there be manifestations, that contracts will begin to come, that connections will begin to come.
Whatsoever I shall lay my hands on, whatever I will venture out to do, it shall succeed in the name of Jesus.
There will be a quickening in everything that I do.
I receive the oil to prosper, I receive the unction to prosper, I receive the unction to increase.
I decree and declare that every business that you have given me produces solutions and is successful throughout the earth.
I decree clients and customers coming from the north, the south, the east, and the west.
I command favor in the marketplace, in the city and in the countryside.
My business will prosper, my career will prosper.
I will prosper in my business, I will prosper in my health, I will prosper in the projects God has given me, I will prosper in my job, in my career, I will prosper in my finances.
From this hour, everything I touch will prosper, prosperity is my portion.
My Lord and my God, I thank you for wisdom that will maintain prosperity.
Father, I thank you that it is done, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Open Doors and Opportunities
segments: Father, I thank you in the name of your son Jesus for your grace and your mercy.
Thank you for opening doors that no man can open.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every door in my life, may it be open now.
I speak to every door, I remove every gatekeeper.
I remove every gatekeeper that is contending, I remove every gatekeeper.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every iron gate, every bronze door standing in my way, let that gate be broken.
Everything that is holding me behind, that human that has put limitation on me, that spirit that has put limitation on me, let that work be broken.
You stubborn gates, today in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I shatter you into pieces.
Whatever my hand touches shall not be delayed, it shall not be denied.
Those who held the opportunities God gave to me, I command them now to deliver it unto me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I take back every opportunity, I take back every opportunity.
Today I open doors that were shut.
Today I reactivate opportunities that were lost.

Father, today I unlock every door that was shut against me, every door that was shut against my opportunities, every door that was shut against my promotion, every door that was shut against my advancement.
Every resistance and opposition, give way by the decree of the Lord.
Father, I open doors in my life, I open opportunities in my life now.
I open doors of prosperity, I open doors of wealth into my life.
Open doors for my business, open doors for my career.
Father, from today I will not miss my opportunities.
I will not miss the doors that you open before me.
I thank you for your angels preceding me, your angels are going ahead of me that are opening doors in the mighty name of Jesus.
Doors of opportunity, of increase, in the name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, I receive my blessing, I receive my open doors, I receive my elevation.
Doors are opening for me in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Divine Favor
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor, I thank you for grace, and I thank you for mercy.
My Father and my Lord, I thank you for your mercy, I thank you for your love.
As you found David, as you found Esther, as you found Moses, as you favored them, so have you also favored me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the capacity to carry favor.
Give me the capacity to face everything that comes with favor.
Father, cleanse my heart, Father, purify my heart.
Father, give me the grace to sustain the atmosphere of favor.
Anything that wants to contaminate this atmosphere, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I clothe myself with divine favor.
Not just favor, divine favor.
In every negotiation, whatever I say, it shall be favored, for God has favored me.
I receive favor for expansion.
I receive uncommon favor today, I receive uncommon access today, I receive uncommon keys today.
Favor marks my business, favor marks my career, favor marks the work of my hands, favor marks my health, favor marks my strength, favor marks my finances.
Wherever there was struggle and resistance, it gives way.
I was ignored in the past, I was overlooked in the past, I was undermined in the past.
My era of favor has come.
Favor in those opportunities, favor in that career, favor in that profession, favor with man and with God.
I thank you that favor precedes me, that it goes into rooms that I have not arrived in yet, that it hunts down opportunities that I have not even put my name in for.
What my efforts cannot produce for me, the favor of God will produce for me.
I am favored to own homes, I am favored to own businesses, I am favored for increase.
I am favored by God, I am favored by man.
I am not favored because of who is around me, I am favored because you made me to be.
Everything about me is favor, everything about me is favor because of your grace, I overflow with your favor.
Favor is my portion in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Give to God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for what you have given unto me.
Father, thank you, what you have given me is more than I could ever give to you.
Lord Jesus, I honor you with my giving.
I express my love with my giving from today, oh Lord.
I remember this truth, that everything I put in your hands, I am just returning what you gave me.
No one can buy a blessing from you, but I can be obedient with my sacrifice to you.
Lord, today as I give, heighten my spirit.
Let my sacrifice speak for me.
Father, I join my prayer with this sacrifice.
Father, cleanse my heart, let my sacrifice before you be a sign of humility, to be a sign of love.
And as I do this, Lord, cleanse my heart in the name of Jesus, that anything that is of the devil in my walk with you, let it be removed.
May my seed always speak for me, may it stand as a memorial before you.
Where I cannot speak, let my offering speak, let my sacrifice speak.
Father, remember my seed today.
Remember every toil that I have done in your kingdom.
Every seed that the fowls devoured, every seed that was cursed, every harvest that was destroyed, Father, I say no more.
My harvest will be destroyed no more.
As I give unto your work, expand my borders, expand my territory.
For your name's sake, increase me and prosper me.
Let my giving become a net that will catch many souls and bring it unto your kingdom.
May the devourer be far from what God has given me.
As I give to you, I will never lack, because there are no losses in you.
There is only increase in Jesus' name.
I know that you have already increased me, I know that you have multiplied me.
As I lay this in your hands, Father, multiply me in every good thing unto your own glory.
I am fruitful in the mighty name of Jesus.
Receive my sacrifice today, receive my offering, and may your name be glorified.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Success in Studies and Exams
segments: Father, in the name of your son Jesus, I thank you for your goodness.
I need your wisdom, I need the spirit of revelation in order to acquire your knowledge.
Of my own self I can do nothing, I am powerless, Lord, but because of you I can do all things, all things through your son Jesus.
Father, give me a teachable spirit.
Make me a student again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I pray that you will give me the keys to allow me to understand.
Give me the spirit of understanding, that as I study and read the scriptures and listen to the words you have given me, Father, draw me closer to your heart.
Father, work with me beyond my mental capacity.
Father, your word says your spirit will teach me all things.
Father, I pray that your Holy Spirit will work in me that I will become all you have destined for me to be.
Father, increase my discernment.
Father, help me today to regain my focus.
Holy Spirit, visit me, instruct me, help me to redeem time.
Your strength is made perfect in my weakness.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I give you my strength because it is weakness, and I receive your strength.
Father, today I have learned, help me to apply it.
Give me the grace by your Holy Spirit for me to carry out what I have learned today.
Father, may I remain in what I have learned today.
May it be a place I stand in, may it be a place I walk in.
Lead my footsteps, direct my path, that I may arrive where you want me to go.
Lord, go with me.
Father, may your grace travel with me in every endeavor that I will ever have.
Father, may your grace work for me.
Father, I want to go beyond where I am.
Thank you for increasing me and making me better in your presence.
What I have learned has matured me, has changed me, has transformed me.
Glorify yourself now and eternally in the name of your only son Jesus Christ. Amen.

title: Breaking Generational Poverty
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my capacity to manage wealth.

The limitations of my family that was passed on to me, a poverty mentality, a struggling mentality, a paycheck to paycheck mentality, a working hard mentality and not working smart mentality, today I remove that mindset.
Every mindset of poverty, every mindset that has caused me not to be a good steward, be removed in the mighty name of Jesus.
I will not struggle with what my father struggled with.
I will not struggle with what my mother struggled with.
Father, I will not repeat the mistakes of my parents.
I will not repeat the patterns that they lived.
That spirit that held my family, those situations that held my fathers before me, those situations that held my mothers before me, by the Spirit of God, I rebuke it, I bind it.
Those situations that held my family, I rebuke it now.
Those situations that held my career, I rebuke it now.

Patterns of poverty, patterns of confusion, patterns of lack, patterns of instability, anything that was introduced in the lives of my fathers before me, the lives of my mothers before me, today I loose it in the name of Jesus.
I loose myself from every cycle and every pattern that is generated from the bloodline.
I will not conform to any pattern of trouble, any pattern of poverty.
Every negative pattern that followed my father, that followed my mother, that followed my grandfather, that followed my grandmother, Father, I break out of evil patterns.
Father, do a new thing with me.
Establish something new for the generations to come after me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from every satanic covenant, I am free from witchcraft, I am free from generational curses.
Every generational poverty, every generational struggle is no longer mine.
I remove it from my life.
And I am living in a different future, the future Jesus Christ ordained for me.
My days of poverty have expired.
My days of struggle have expired.
The days of living paycheck to paycheck are gone.
Father, your blessing is here, may it rest upon me, may it rest upon my family.
That blessing will be received from generation to generation today.
May my family never know poverty because of what you are doing with me.
Poverty is a thing of the past, struggle is a thing of the past.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Cancelling Words I Spoke over My Finances
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I switch directions.
I cancel every word that I have spoken over my finances.
Every negative word, I cancel it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I cancel every negative word I have spoken.
Words I spoke as a child, words I have spoken as an adult, words I have spoken in pain, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
What I did out of pain, let it be undone now, what I spoke out of fear, let it be undone now.
Father, remove every word that is perverted in me, words of defeat, words of failure, words of shame, words of humiliation, words of stagnancy, words that have made me feel worthless.
Father, today by your spirit, erase it from me.
May my lips be redeemed from the past, and may I have the ability to undo the past.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life.
Words of failure, words of complaining that has created an atmosphere of demons, every negative word that has come out of me, by the power of the Holy Spirit I undo those words.
I reverse those words and I make those words of no effect.
Every word of delay, I cancel it.
Every word of failure, I cancel it.
Every word of lack, I cancel it.
Every negative word that I have spoken concerning myself, I break it and tear it down in the mighty name of Jesus.
My truth is the truth that God has spoken over my life.
Father, reverse every negative word from me.
Every word of failure, may it lose its power because of the blood of Jesus.
Father, you have already said yes to my finances.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for victory, I thank you that it is done for me.
By my words today I have been justified.
I declare victory over my finances, over my children, over my career, over my business, over everything that has to do with me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I receive the oil of prosperity.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Evil Altars over My Finances
segments: In the exalted name of King Jesus, I speak to every demonic power, I speak to every satanic altar, I speak to every sorcery.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I pull your devices down, I pull your voices down, I pull your altars down, I pull your powers down in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let fire fall on every altar, every demonic altar, every demonic gathering in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let every evil altar raised against me and my family be broken in the name of Jesus.
That pit you dug for me, that pit you dug for my children, that pit you dug for my family, that pit you dug for my business, you will fall in it in the name of Jesus.
Family ties that are demonic, marital ties that are demonic, employment ties that are demonic, by the blood of Jesus, let them be dissolved, let them be cancelled.
Every demonic altar raised against me, by the power of the Holy Spirit, in the mighty name of Jesus, I bring that altar down.
I speak to every demonic attack, every kind of containment that is maintained by a demonic altar, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I bring it down, I bring it down, I bring it down.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, let every satanic covenant, let every demonic attachment, let every demonic covenant, let every demonic union, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let it lose its power.
Let it be nullified, let it be cancelled, let it be dissolved in the name of Jesus.

Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic altar in my family that has caused me to be useless in life, Father, I understand there is an altar, that altar has stood against me, that altar was erected against me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let that altar, wherever it is, in the mighty name of Jesus, let that altar be destroyed today.
Let that altar be consumed by fire today, that altar that has been fighting me not to get to my portion.
May the angel of the Lord, as Psalm thirty-five says, let him pursue that altar, let him draw out his sword, let him destroy that altar and all that are involved in it.
My life must be free, I must receive my portion.
Father, let my name be erased from that altar, let my name be removed from that altar, let my picture disappear from that altar.
Let whatever enchantment that was released against me, let that altar be pulled down in the name of Jesus.
Every demonic altar that has my name, every demonic altar that has the name of my children, every demonic altar that has the name of my family, by fire, I scatter you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I dismantle every altar, I dismantle every spirit that is robbing my life of God's blessing in the mighty name of Jesus.
Over every curse, over every altar, over every demonic force, be thou broken in the name of Jesus.
Demonic powers are broken, demonic attacks are broken, satanic resistance is broken, misfortune is broken.
Curses are broken, prosperity is mine.
I release acceleration, I release speed in every area of my life, in everything that has to do with me.
I declare restoration in my finances.
I declare restoration in my career, I declare restoration in my business.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Witchcraft over My Finances
segments: Father, I thank you, for you have commanded the blessing upon me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, all those who have done rituals against me in order to destroy my future, let every spirit of witchcraft catch fire.
That witchcraft in my family, I destroy it in the name of Jesus.

Father, every poverty, every barrenness, every stagnancy, every limitation, every sickness, every disease, every affliction, every oppression in my family that is linked to witchcraft, today I destroy that witchcraft in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every witchcraft enchantment be broken.
Every witchcraft incantation be broken.
Every witchcraft spell be broken.
Every witchcraft decree be broken.
Wherever you are hiding, by the light of God, I expose you.
Father, let your power locate the root of that witchcraft and completely annihilate it from my family in the name of Jesus.
Father, I draw the bloodline against every power of witchcraft by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Every altar that was raised where they were calling my name, every altar that was raised where demonic sacrifices were made, today I tear every altar down.
That chain that has held me, let it be broken, that spell that has held me, let it be broken.
That witchcraft, that sorcery that has held me, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
You spirit of poverty, come out in the name of Jesus.
Spirit of witchcraft, I scatter you now from my home.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I break your hold and I break your influence.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I overcome poverty.
I overcome debt.
No more will I suffer setbacks, no more will I suffer struggle.
Every satanic influence that was operating even through debt, through curses, through bondage, today it is broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, you have given me dominion and possession of my territory, you have given me dominion and possession over my finances.
Let every evil thing done against me and my family, let it be destroyed now in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am above witchcraft in Jesus' name.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive wealth, I receive riches because of the spirit of wisdom.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against the Devourer and Wasters
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus.
Because of your blood I am redeemed, and because of your blood redemption is my portion.
I thank you that I am not under a curse, but I am under the blessing, the blessing of multiplication, the blessing of increase.
Whatever spirit, be it whatever, that is coming against my prosperity, in the name of Jesus I remove it, I silence it, I abort it.
Whatever medium that is coming against me, in the mighty name of Jesus I decree and I declare, I abort your plans.
I seal every hole that has been draining my finances, I seal every gap that has been draining my finances.
Close every access point in the name of Jesus.
May the devourer be far from what God has given me.
I declare freedom from every loss and every waste that the spirits have caused in my family.
Every declaration that has been made on altars that are not of God over my finances, in the mighty name of Jesus, it is broken, it is broken, it is broken.
Every form of limitation is cancelled, it's cancelled, it's cancelled in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let every excuse in my life, reasons why I am sick, reasons why there is poverty, reasons why there is hardship, be broken in Jesus' name.
Let every error in my life be corrected.
The error of struggle, the error of poverty, the error of difficulty, the error of sickness, the error of backwardness, let it be corrected now in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today I arrest the plan of the enemy in the mighty name of Jesus.
Remove the evil scent from me, so that things in my life may move forward for your glory.
Every area of my life has been recovered of you and has been recovered by you.
I am made whole, my finances are made whole.
No more lack, no more struggle, no more penury, no more hard labor.
In the name of Jesus, from today, everything I touch will turn to gold, everything I touch will multiply.
Everything I touch will increase in the name of Jesus.
It is well with my business, it is well with all that concerns me.
From today I will live a life of abundance.
Father, multiply me in every good thing unto your own glory.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Freedom from Debt
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, these bills have been a chain upon my life.
But by reason of the blood of Jesus, today this chain shall be broken.
Father, you are able to take care of my bills, my daily needs.
Today I break the power of debt over my life.
I declare that you are the only one who will rule over me, not my boss, not the superiors of the land, but you, oh Lord.
I will not serve mammon, mammon will serve me as I serve you.
Whatever is leading me to debt, whatever is leading me to borrow, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of bondage, everything that has bound my family, everything that has bound my life, and has put me in the place of debt, in the mighty name of Jesus, may that chain be broken.
Father, I break every chain of debt, I break every chain of debt, I break every chain of debt.
Father, whatever has hung on my neck as a weight, whatever has hung on my shoulders as a weight, that chain today, I break it by fire.
I break the chains of financial struggle, I break the chains of penury.
I break the chains of working like an elephant and reaping like an ant.

Father, every effort is always going towards debt, every increase is always going towards debt, every paycheck is always going towards debt, every investment is always going towards debt, today it ends.
Father, freedom from every chain of debt, inherited debt, generational debt, ancestral debt.
Father, I break the chains of debt, wherever they came from, wherever they originated from.
Father, today may every debt in my life receive provision to erase it, whether it is natural or whether it is supernatural.
May that debt be cancelled, may school loans be cancelled, may that stubborn mortgage be cancelled, may that car note be cancelled, may that rent be cancelled.
Every debt that has been presented before you, let it be paid off now in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, you called me not to owe anyone anything, you called me to be free.
Father, the borrower is slave to the lender, I break that hold now in the name of Jesus.
Father, you have given me power to trample over serpents and scorpions and every power of the enemy.
Today I trample over debt, I trample over this debt, I trample over this debt in the name of Jesus.
The devil will not use any debt to keep me stagnant, the devil will not use any debt to keep me in limitation.
From today I am above debt, I am above poverty, I am above financial complications, I am above financial difficulty.
I declare myself completely liberated from debt.
I am entering into financial rest in the mighty name of Jesus.
I shall never owe, I shall never borrow, I will be a lender, I will be a giver, me and my house.
Father, every debt, every debt, every debt is removed from me, from my children, from my family.
Father, I receive the power to make wealth.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Daily Provision
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your grace and your mercy.
I thank you that I am your child, I thank you that you have the best for me.
I thank you that you are my provider, and you provide for me unconditionally because you simply love me.
My provision and sustenance comes from you, not from my job, not from my career.
All these things come from you.
Lord, you have made provision available for me, you have made all good things available for me.
Father, I ought not to walk in the realm of struggle.
Your word said I should not worry about what I am going to eat, I should not worry about what I am going to wear, because you will provide for all my needs.
So, Father, in the name of Jesus, my eyes are set on you, my burdens are given to you.
Because I now understand, my need is not a curse, it's simply prophetic memory of what you have already provided.
So Father, I receive what you have provided for me.
Today, oh Lord, open the storehouse on my behalf.
Oh Father, in the name of Jesus, open the storehouse of heaven for your child.
Let the season of lack in my life end, let the season of struggle in my life end.
Let the season of asking and begging end in my life, let the season of borrowing in my life end.
Every thought of the enemy, every plan of the enemy that has enslaved me to this reality, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, the provision that you have ordained for me, I receive it in the name of Jesus.
Father, the blessing that you have set for me, I receive it in the name of Jesus.
I receive the finances for my home.
I receive peace, I receive provision, I receive abundance, I receive strength, I receive wealth, I receive instruction.
Whatsoever has to do with me must increase in the name of Jesus.
Father, this month, yes, this month, let it be the month of manna, the month of heavenly provision.
Father, I pray for wisdom and understanding, that I may manage that which you have released for me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that the storehouse has been open.
Today I receive my inheritance, as your child, oh God, I receive all that you have for me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Overflow and Abundance
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that the storehouse has been open.
Today, oh Lord, the floodgates of heaven open, that blessings will come down in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my capacity to manage wealth.
Father, you cannot bless me if I am not a good steward.
A poverty mentality, a struggling mentality, a paycheck to paycheck mentality, a working hard mentality and not working smart mentality, Father, in the name of Jesus, today I remove that mindset.
Remove every poverty mindset from me, remove every poverty struggle mindset, remove every mindset of penury, remove every mindset of struggle, and give me the mindset of abundance.
Father, you have broken the yoke of poverty, you have broken the yoke of struggle.
Let poverty be a thing of the past, let debt be a thing of the past, let financial struggle be a thing of the past.
My days of poverty have expired, my days of struggle have expired.
The days of just making it are gone, the days of living paycheck to paycheck are gone.
Father, I go from survival to thriving, I go from survival to abundance.
Father, I will no longer be barely making it, but I step into the place of the overflow.
Financial overflow, financial overflow, financial overflow.
Wherever finances were dry, just as oil flows, just as oil shines, my finances begin to flow, my finances begin to increase, my finances begin to multiply in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today, I receive the ability to make wealth, I receive power to make wealth.
Everything I touch from today, in the name of Jesus, I will know prosperity, I will know increase.
Whatsoever I lay my hands on, let it not only prosper, let it also multiply.
God, increase me in capacity, God, increase me in substance, God, increase me in wisdom, God, increase me in revelation, God, increase me in every way.
I receive wealth, I receive riches.
I understand that wealth is my portion, I understand that increase is my portion.
The blessing of God is my portion, spiritual and material.
Father, your blessing is here, may it rest upon me, may it rest upon my family.
That it will cause me to have increase, that it will cause me to have abundance, that it will cause me to prosper in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I establish a new pattern of wealth, I establish a new pattern of abundance.
I shall not lack after today.
Father, the overflow will be my portion in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Am Looking for a Job
segments: My Father and my God, position me for your glory, position me for breakthrough.
Lord, what you have ordained for me, let it come to pass now.
Father, every year that was wasted and delayed, every year that was wasted by shut doors, every year that was wasted through cases of whatever form.
Every battle that wasted my time, every battle that stole years from my life, stole years from my children, stole years from my family, today I recover every lost time.
Whatever was lost is recovered, whatever was wasted is recovered in the name of Jesus.
Opportunities that were wasted, access that was wasted, Father, as I recover time, I recover access, I recover my position, I recover my blessing.
Employment ties that are demonic, by the blood of Jesus, let them be dissolved, let them be cancelled.
Make my path straight, remove every delay.
Every man that has been obstructing my destiny, that has been delaying my destiny, be removed now in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every door in my life, may it be open now.
That which I have been praying for, may it be opened in the mighty name of Jesus.
I speak to every door, I remove every gatekeeper, I open every door.
I remove every gatekeeper that is contending with my career.
That grace and favor will precede me, that they will go into rooms before I arrive.
I thank you for your angels preceding me, your angels are going ahead of me that are opening doors in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, that the doors have opened that no man can shut, the doors have opened that will never be closed again.
Father, I thank you for your favor and your grace.
I am favored by God, I am favored by man, my days of favor have come.
Father, I thank you that I have entered into my era of favor, my era of grace, my era of acceleration, my era of promotion.
Promotion is coming to me, a new job is coming to me.
Every prayer that I have been praying, every opportunity that is in my heart, Father, I thank you that you are answering me now.
In the mighty name of Jesus, doors are opening for me.
From today my life is changing, from today my life is shifting.
Increase my capacity, Father, that as I walk through these new opportunities that you have given me the gift to stay and to build.
I thank you that you are going ahead of me today, this week, this month, the rest of this year, that new opportunities and new doors will be opened in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Promotion and Elevation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, lift me up today for your name's sake.
Father, even here, even in elevation, Lord, I humble myself.
My time of elevation has come as I humble myself before you.
As I humble myself under your mighty hand, Father, I thank you that you are lifting me, Father, I thank you that you are raising me.
Father, nothing in my life shall remain down, nothing about my life shall remain low, nothing about my life shall remain behind.
Every weight that would hinder my elevation, Father, as I receive it now, every weight is broken, every weight is removed, every weight is lifted.
Everything that kept me back, everything that kept me down, everything that was a limitation, everything that was a hindrance, Father, I thank you for elevation.
The hour has come, promotion is coming to me.
I receive my promotion, I receive my increase now.
My promotion is now, my increase is now.
My doors of promotion are open, I receive that, I receive that, I receive that approval.
Father, I receive elevation in my career, in my business, in my children, in my family, in my marriage, in my finances, in my health, everything that concerns me.
The works of my hands, the businesses, Father, my job, my finances, my relationships begin to prosper as you cause me to elevate.
Father, my time of elevation has come, my hour of elevation is now.
Father, that your strength will be extended to me, that your power will be extended to me.
Father, this is my time of lifting, this is my time of elevation.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the power and the strength to keep my peace as you elevate me, as you promote me.
As you elevate me, O Lord, give me grace towards those who don't like me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor, I thank you for grace, and I thank you for mercy.
As you found David, as you found Esther, as you found Moses, as you favored them, so have you also favored me.
Father, I thank you for every opportunity to be elevated.
As I work, I will see expansion, I will see promotion, I will see elevation, I will see increase.
In the mighty name of Jesus, elevation is for me.
From this day forth my life will never be the same again.
I thank you for my elevation, I praise you for my elevation, I honor you for my elevation, it is for your glory alone, Amen.

title: Against Attacks at My Workplace
segments: Today I soak everything that has to do with me in the blood of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, every accusation against me, every lie that has been spoken against me, Father, today let every accuser be destroyed.
God has decided that every plan of the enemy will not come to pass against me.
God has decided that every arrow targeting me, every weapon fashioned against me shall not prosper, it shall fail in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, save me from temptation, save me from every trap of the enemy.
From this day forward, I curse every plan of the enemy.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from this day forward, may I never fall victim to the plans of the enemy.
Father, give me vision, vision to see what the enemy is planning.
God, open my eyes and give me discernment that I would be able to identify when the enemy has put on a costume to deceive me.
You spirit of confusion, you spirit of distraction, you spirit of destruction, you spirit of continual troubles, in the mighty name of Jesus, I cancel you.
You chain of sickness, you chain of trouble, you chain of poverty, you chain of limitation, break in the name of Jesus.
Every wicked taskmaster, today I break your power in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will no longer reign in my home, you will no longer reign in my work, you will no longer reign in my business, you will no longer reign in my finances.
Every iron gate, every bronze door standing in my way, in the mighty name of Jesus, let that gate be broken, let it be broken, let it be shattered.
Everything that is holding me behind, that human that has put limitation on me, that spirit that has put limitation on me, in the mighty name of Jesus, let that work be broken.
I am favor in my place of work, wherever I go, I am favored.
Lord, I have done nothing, I have been faithful in my place of work, I have been a blessing to the people who are here.
I have done everything that should be right, but they are still trying to fire me.
Father, let confusion come upon them and let them begin to sell each other out, don't allow them to look at me and say, where is your God.
I am above every battle, I am above every sickness, I am above every financial difficulty, I am above scorpions, I am above serpents, I am above every work of the enemy.
Every power of the enemy is under my feet today in the name of Jesus.
God has already decided no evil shall come unto my doorstep.
Every inch of my being is secured in the blood of Jesus.
Whatever my hand touches shall not be delayed, it shall not be denied.
I will labor in the strength of the Lord.
Fruitfulness in whatsoever my hands touch, fruitfulness in my finances, fruitfulness in my business, fruitfulness in my career.
Thank you that you have decided that your goodness and your mercy shall continue to follow me, Amen.

title: Against Labour Without Reward
segments: Father, remember my seed today.
Remember every toil that I have done in your kingdom.
Father, remember my sacrifice, that my labor will not be in vain.
My toiling will not go without reward, Father, you are the rewarder.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every spirit holding my harvest, may it be broken now.
In the name of Jesus, I break every spirit of hardship off of my life, off of my children, off of my seed, off of my household.
I break the hold of hardship in my work, I break the hold of hardship in my finances, I break the hold of hardship in my job, in my career, in everything that the Lord has placed in my hands.
Whatever has been robbing from me, whatever has been stealing from me, whatever has been draining me, from today I destroy that power.
Every wicked taskmaster, today I break your power in the mighty name of Jesus.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I arrest that demon that has been destroying my seed.
You spirit of locust, you spirit of canker, I command you in the name of Jesus, come out of my life, come out of my children, come out of my labor, come out of my hard work.

Father, patterns of toiling and toiling, patterns of hard labor, patterns of sowing and not reaping, patterns of death, patterns of being cheated, patterns of being destroyed, patterns of being robbed.
Patterns of untimely death, patterns of things dying in my hands, Father, whatever that pattern is, wherever it came from, I break it in the name of Jesus.
From today, from today, from today, hard labor is removed from me.
Every yoke of unprofitable labor, break in the name of Jesus.
Every hard labor without result, every unprofitable work, every unprofitable function, it is removed from my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today I will not labor in vain, I will not work in vain.
I refuse to work and not profit, I refuse to plant and not reap, I refuse to labor in vain.
I will not labor for another to profit, I will not labor for another one to benefit, I will not sow for another to harvest.
In all my labor, I will see profit, in all my labor, I will see benefit, in all my labor, I will see results.
I will profit from the work that I do, I will profit from whatsoever my hands touch.
Father, cause me to labor under your blessing.
I will see the fruit of my labor, I will reap the fruit of my labor, I will enjoy the fruit of my labor.
Whatever I touch will increase, whatever I touch will multiply.
Dryness is not my portion, stagnation is not my portion, penury and hard labor is not my portion.
No more unprofitable hard labor in the name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Business
segments: Lord, I make you a partner to my business.
What I earn, you will also have your share.
Whatsoever I touch, let it come in contact with the blood of Jesus.
Whether it is my business partners, be it my clients, let whosoever touches me, let them be purified, for the blood of Jesus flows through me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that everything will happen with speed.
As I enter into what you have prepared for me, there shall be no more delays.
Barrenness in my finances, barrenness in my life, barrenness regarding my career, regarding my business, I rebuke you and I reject you in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every enchantment that is against me, my business, my children, my destiny, in the mighty name of Jesus, that evil spirit is being taken down.
Every plan, every trap, every witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I have power to finish my business.
I have power to accomplish my business.
I decree and declare I have power over my business.
Thank you for restoration and acceleration in the name of Jesus.
I receive the power to establish my business.
From the north, the east, the south and the west, let life enter into my business.
May people come from everywhere.
Whatsoever I do, the angels of God will go ahead of me.
Angels will meet me in my place of work.
I receive the spirit of boldness to start that business, to go after that business, to create that business.
My business will prosper, my career will prosper, my children will prosper, my seed will prosper.
My business shall be expanded.
May my business also explode.
May my bank account speak of your goodness, oh Lord.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I believe it is done.
It is well with my business.
I receive it in Jesus' mighty name. Amen.

title: For Success and Excellence
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I believe today what I touch shall prosper and shall increase.
Everywhere I set my feet, from today, I possess it, from today I will succeed in it, from today that ground will bear fruits for me.
The spirit that has brought stagnancy and poverty in my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let this spirit be broken.
Be broken over my career, be broken over my destiny, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I have decided never to stay in the same place again.
What has been holding me and keeping me stagnant, that the weapons of the enemy are prospering over my life, today that comes to an end.
An excellent spirit I receive in the name of Jesus.
Father, because of the spirit of wisdom, let my productivity increase.
May I become extremely productive, oh Lord my God.
Whatsoever I lay my hands on, let it not only prosper, let it also multiply.
Whatsoever I shall lay my hands on, whatever I will venture out to do, it shall succeed in the name of Jesus.
There will be a quickening in everything that I do.
I receive the oil to prosper, I receive the unction to prosper.
I receive the unction to increase.
May my businesses multiply, may my ventures multiply, whatever I do, increase and multiplication.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today, I receive the ability to make wealth.
I receive the power to succeed.
I will become so resourceful, I will become a source for my family, for those who are around me, and also your work and your kingdom.
Everything I touch from today, in the name of Jesus, I will know prosperity, I will know increase.
In the name of Jesus, I receive grace and favor to prosper.
Poverty stops with me, struggles stop with me.
From today, in the name of Jesus, no matter where I am, I will succeed.
Because of the Lord Jesus, I have elevation.
I am blessed, I am prosperous.
In the name of Jesus, prosperity is my portion. Amen.

title: For Divine Connections and Helpers
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I call those things that are not as if they were.
I engage with my destiny now.
I engage with my destiny helpers in the name of Jesus.
Let every satanic altar begin to crumble.
Those who are connected to me, be delivered from that altar in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, all my destiny helpers, no matter where they are located, I open their doors.
I release the blessing of God upon them.
Let them be strengthened, and come and join what you have given me to do.
Whatever we will do, it will be unto your glory in the name of Jesus.
God is not sending me friends, God is not sending me acquaintances, God is sending me divine helpers.
They will need me and what I carry in me in the name of Jesus.
May God give me opportunities I could never get.
Lord, whenever you want to lift me up, you always use those men and women, some are rejected, some are not even part of the kingdom, to offer me help.
Lord, in my time of need today, remember me, remember that man, remember that woman, remember that child, that, Lord, I may receive help in my time of need.
I need help; the work you have given me for me to fulfill is too much, and without your help, Father, I cannot accomplish the work.
From today, I will open doors, whatever my hand touches shall not be delayed, it shall not be denied.
May God give me divine helpers and connectors that I can work with to develop things that I can do.
There will be a lot of divine connections for me, but they will not come from a brother in Christ, sister in Christ, they will come from unlikely places.
Thank you for the angelic assistance, oh thank you Father that you sent them, you created them just for me to go through this life in ease.
My Lord and my God, today send help, Father, send help in the mighty name of Jesus.
Oh Lord, everything that has to do with my life has been restored unto me.
Every divine connection, every divine partner has been restored unto me.
I am becoming an answer to prayer in the mighty name of Jesus.
It is so and it is established in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Favor with People
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor.
As you found David, as you found Esther, as you found Moses, as you favored them, so have you also favored me.
In the name of Jesus, I clothe myself with divine favor.
Not just favor, divine favor.
When anyone encounters me, they will favor me, because God has favored me, and it shall reflect through them.
I was ignored in the past, I was overlooked in the past, I was undermined in the past.
My era of favor has come.
I am favored by God, I am favored by man.
Everywhere I go, I will carry favor with me.
Wherever I go, whatever I do, favor is my portion.
Father, I thank you for every opportunity to be elevated, Father, I thank you for every opportunity to be lifted.
I invoke favor in everything that I would do.
I am getting favor to acquire properties, to acquire businesses, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I declare favor, I command favor in the marketplace, in the city and in the countryside.
My days of being hidden are over.
In every negotiation, whatever I say, it shall be favored, for God has favored me.
Whatever property I want to buy, I will be favored, I will get the best price, for God has favored me.
Uncommon favor for finances, uncommon favor for reconciliation, uncommon favor for restoration has come upon me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Favor has located me.
I receive uncommon favor.
Let my name be favored, let favor follow me, let grace and mercy follow me wherever I go.
I receive favor in every area of my life.
Through this favor, through this faith, I enter elevation.
May I receive favor, may I receive it in the name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Favor before Authorities
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for favor.
As you found David, as you found Esther, as you found Moses, as you favored them, so have you also favored me.
Father, I pray for unmerited favor; may your grace be my clothing, may your grace be my covering.
Your grace is able to qualify me where I am not qualified.
Your grace is able to take me to places I have never been.
I declare that anyone that sees my face, as they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor me.
As they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor my business, as they set their eyes upon me, they will desire to favor my career.
As they set their eyes upon my name, they will desire to favor me.
I am above competition, I am above intimidation, I am above rejection.
The favor of God speaks on my behalf; the favor of God speaks for my name.
Every door that will shut before me, it will open even as I approach it.
Every place I was denied, because of the favor from on high, I will be accepted.
I have been accepted for promotion in the name of Jesus.
That closed door will be open to me because of mercy.
Where I have been resisted, I shall be resisted no more.
Uncommon favor speaks on my behalf.
Favor marks my business, favor marks my career, favor marks the work of my hands.
Everywhere there was shut down, doors are open.
Where others were denied, I will make headway.
I will not look for men; men will look for me because of favor.
Kings will come to my rising because of favor.
I receive uncommon access today, I receive uncommon keys today.
Whatsoever I touch, God will respond to it; whatsoever I do, God will back me up.
I have God's approval, I have God's direction, I have God's wisdom, I have God's understanding.
Favor all around, favor like a shield from today.
Father, I thank you for uncommon favor from today.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Name and Reputation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, shame has been taken from me.
Your word says you have never seen the righteous forsaken.
Your servant David declared this because you took shame from him; when he was rejected, when they saw him to be nothing, you glorified yourself through him.
Father, in every situation of my life today, don't allow me to be embarrassed; don't allow me to fall into shame.
Father, rescue me from shame, the shame of the family, the shame of my own shortcomings.
Father, transform me into a vessel of honor, a vessel that will bring you glory, a vessel that will bring you honor, a vessel that men will see and see you.
Let the spirit of shame be broken; let the spirit of ridicule be broken over my life.
The devil is put to shame; witchcraft is put to shame.
There shall be no shame in my career; there shall be no shame in anything to do with me.
My seed will know no shame in the mighty name of Jesus.
So Father, in the name of Jesus, I call myself by the name you have called me.
The world may have called me weak, but you have called me strong.
No one will stop the move you have started with me.
In the name of Jesus, my name is established, and I will live up to my name.
Sickness is not my name, poverty is not my name, calamity is not my name.
None of those are my names; in the mighty name of Jesus, I bear a new name.
I release the names of my situation, I release the names of my experiences, and I boldly accept the name that you have given me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I release every blessing attached to my name.
May I be set apart, may I be set apart.
May I be marked for excellence, may I be marked for favor.
The season of disappointment has ended in my life.
I have entered into my season of honor; God shall honor me from today.
He shall lift me up today because I have humbled myself before the Lord.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my days of embarrassment are over; my days of shame are over.
Father, it is my hour, it is my season.
I am in my season of honor.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Delay and Stagnation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, show me your grace and your mercy.
Lord Jesus, have mercy upon me.
Father, today I pray for speed, Father, I pray for acceleration.
Rescue me from where I am, set my feet in a place that they shall not be moved.
Every chain in my life that has kept me stagnant, I cannot depart from where I am.
Father, I can see where you want me to be, but it seems like there is a force keeping me here.
Today in the mighty name of Jesus, may every chain fall the same way it fell off Paul and Silas, the same way chains fell off Peter.
They must break off my business, they must break off my destiny, they must break off my career, they must break off my marriage, they must break off my destiny, they must break off my finances.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I speak to every single thing that has delayed me.
I decree and declare, chains of delay are broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Demonic powers are broken, demonic attacks are broken, satanic resistance is broken, misfortune is broken, curses are broken.
The spirit that has brought stagnancy and poverty in my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let this spirit be broken.
Be broken over my career, be broken over my destiny.
Every demonic entanglement that has caused delays, by your spirit, reverse it now.
I cancel every delay, I cancel it right now.
Father, give me the ability to execute, remove procrastination from me.
Father, may not a single thing be delayed.
I release acceleration, I release speed in every area of my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, today is the last time I will experience stagnancy.
Let there be a turnaround in my life.
My way has been made straight.
Delay is a thing of the past.
Delay in my finances is a thing of the past, delay in my restoration, delay in my elevation is a thing of the past.
Every delay is broken, every struggle is broken.
I receive speed in career, speed in business, speed in elevation, speed in promotion, speed in progress.
Father, in the name of Jesus, thank you that there are no more delays in my life.
Thank you for restoration and acceleration.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For Breakthrough
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, you know my life more than I know.
Nothing is hidden from you, my Lord and my God.
Father, I do not want any breakthrough that is independent of you.
Father, remove the veil from my eyes.
Father, change my mind, that I will see as you see.
I want to walk with your timing.
Lord Jesus, I am looking to you, you are the God of suddenly.

That demon that has been holding my breakthrough, that demon that has been stealing my jobs and opportunities, that demon that has put me under a veil that those who are supposed to elevate me can't see me.
Today in the name of Jesus, the fire of the Holy Spirit shall destroy them.
No demon will block my breakthrough.
No evil spirit will hinder my elevation.
No witchcraft will hold me back.
I cancel every plan of the enemy, every intention of the enemy to hinder, to thwart or to stop your blessing on my life.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, let every agenda of every agent of the enemy be broken in the name of Jesus.
My days of struggle are finished, my days of poverty are done, the blessing of the Lord is my portion in everything that I do.
Father, I thank you now that you are opening doors in the mighty name of Jesus.
My breakthrough, I command it by the authority and power given to me by the Lord Jesus.
Let it come to pass by the mighty hand of the Holy Spirit.
Father, let there be a suddenly this month.
Father, there will be no more lost time in my life.
Today I possess all my possessions.
I receive that breakthrough, I receive my healing, I receive that promotion, I receive the next level.
Breakthrough is my portion, increase is my portion.
I am breaking out on every side, I am breaking forth on every side, I am being shifted on every side, I am being lifted on every side.
Father, I thank you that my turnaround has come.
Nothing about my life shall remain the same after this moment.
Thank you, Father, for breakthrough.
I receive it.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Restoration of What Was Lost
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I understand today there is a realm of restoration.
You are the God of restoration.
Father, in the name of Jesus, look upon me with mercy and remember me today.
Father, do not see my failures, do not see my faults, but let mercy speak on my behalf.
Every demonic power, every demonic force, every diabolical spirit that has been stealing from me, that has been taken from me, in the mighty name of Jesus, I break that power and I recover all.

Everything that the devil stole from me, everything that he has taken from my family, everything that he has taken from my children, everything that he has destroyed in my life today, I recover all in the name of Jesus.
Because of the cross, let everything that was stolen from me be restored now.
Father, your word declares if the thief be caught, he shall restore sevenfold.
Whatsoever was stolen, whatsoever was taken, be returned in Jesus' name.
Father, restore unto me all the years I have lost, all the time I have lost, any opportunity I have lost.
Father, give me a new beginning.
Father, establish me again, set me back on the path.
Father, in the name of Jesus, all the years I have lost, all the wasted time, I reclaim it in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever I should have been, you are causing me to accelerate to the place that you had ordained for me by now.
In the name of Jesus, I recover my destiny.
Every delay that was not designed by God, I recover my destiny.
There will be no more loss, there will be no more derailing.
Father, restore even better, restore even greater, restore much more than what was taken.
Father, let there be restitution, let there be recompense.
I declare restoration in my life, I declare restoration in my home, I declare restoration in my finances, I declare restoration in my career.
I declare restoration in every area of my life.
Oh God, from this day, from this day, from this day, restoration is my portion.
Everything pertaining to my life has been restored to me.
Father, I thank you that you have restored unto me all that was lost, all that was broken, all that was destroyed.
Father, thank you for restoration, thank you for restitution, thank you, Father, for restoration and restitution in every area of my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Direction and Clear Decisions
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I need wisdom today, because I want to know you.
I am tired of leading myself.
Father, I am asking for wisdom, I want to learn how to navigate this in your way, not my own, I want to walk on your path.
Your spirit of wisdom will give me direction, your spirit of wisdom will give me boldness, your spirit of wisdom will give me clarity.
Father, in the name of Jesus, remove every blindness, may I see clearly in everything you have called me to do.
Father, I need your direction, I refuse to rely on my own mind, I refuse to rely on my own understanding.
Father, cause for me to understand the way that I should take.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let the spirit of confusion be broken off my life.
Every power of darkness that has planted evil seeds in me, seeds of doubt, seeds of confusion, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Wherever seeds of confusion were planted, I decree and declare clarity come now in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today renew my mind, remove every program of the enemy within my mind.
Whatever confusion of the devil, let it be pushed out now, let it be pushed out in the name of Jesus.
Today I receive a clear mind, let my decisions be born of your spirit.
I don't want to make hasty decisions, I don't want to make abrupt decisions, I don't want any lying spirit in my ear.
Father, in the name of Jesus, may I make sound decisions from today.
Give me divine direction in every decision I make, so that I may know when to turn left, when to turn right, when to go, when not to go.
Father, redirect my path and set me on the right path.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my spiritual ears, that I may receive direction from you.
Holy Spirit, influence my steps, that I do not waste any time.
Lord, remove me from deception.
Lord, remove me from confusion and place me in your perfect will.
From today, I see clearly, I will see through your eyes.
Because I have a sound mind, I will make good decisions.
I thank you for the direction you are taking me, I thank you that my feet are on solid ground, I thank you that, Lord, you are leading me by your spirit.
Confusion is a thing of the past, struggle is a thing of the past, in the name of Jesus.
I am divinely directed into all things that you have prepared for me, let it be so now, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Wisdom and Understanding
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I need wisdom today, because I want to know you.
I am tired of leading myself.
Your word says clearly, anyone who needs wisdom, let him ask.
Father, I am asking for wisdom.
Reveal your ancient paths to me.
Give me the spirit of wisdom, give me the spirit of understanding, and give me divine knowledge that only comes from your spirit.
Let the spirit of revelation rest on me, that I may know your ways.
Father, remove all manner of blindness.
Enlighten the eyes of my understanding, oh God.
Make me of quick understanding today.
Holy Spirit, teach me.
Holy Spirit, guide me.
Holy Spirit, show me what I ought to do.
I reject depending on my own understanding.
I will no longer lean on my own wisdom, but today I receive the spirit of wisdom.
Father, from today, remove every cloud of confusion.
Father, from today I will not be lost any longer, I will not be in chaos any longer, I will not be in confusion any longer.
Let instruction begin to come, revelation begin to come, wisdom begin to come, direction begin to come, insight begin to come.
Your spirit of wisdom will give me direction, your spirit of wisdom will give me boldness, your spirit of wisdom will give me clarity.
May I know which way you want me to go, oh God, may I know every decision you want me to make.
Open my eyes to see you clearly, the path to know which way to go.
Take me by your right hand.
From today wisdom is in my blood, wisdom is my nature.
By wisdom I will be established, by wisdom I will be sustained.
Father, I thank you that you hear me as always and that even now wisdom is being poured into my spirit in the name of Jesus Christ.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For My Purpose and Destiny
segments: Father of all spirits, creator of the heavens and the earth, maker of all that is visible and invisible, I call upon your name.

All things were created for a purpose, every tree was created for a purpose, every mountain, every valley was created for a purpose, all things were predestined, for you know all things, my Father and my God.
I thought I could lead myself, but I realized I was deceived and walking straight to the pit of hell.
But today, Father, I understand that the only way I can please you is by being in the place of my calling.
Without my calling I am not useful, but with my calling I am complete in you.
Lord, the times that I have wasted, have mercy on me.
The decisions that I have made that have removed me from your purpose, Father, forgive me.
O Lord, today restore me, bring me back to the place of purpose.
Father, in the name of Jesus, reveal your purpose in my life.
Reveal the reason why I was born.
Lord, I pray today, open my eyes, open my heart, that I may understand and know your purpose for my life.
Father, take over my destiny.
Take over everything that concerns my life.
Every spirit that wants to steal my destiny, that wants to confuse my mind, that wants to disrupt my life, that wants to destroy the purpose of God, I destroy you in the name of Jesus.
Let every obstacle that is standing between me and my destiny, every obstacle standing between me and the purpose you have ordained for my life, Father, today, let it be removed in the name of Jesus.
In the name of Jesus, I recover my destiny.

In every place where my destiny was derailed, in every place that my destiny was delayed, in every place that my destiny was corrupted, in every place that my destiny was cut short, Father, today I recover my destiny.
Father, give me the ability to commit, that I will commit to your purpose.
I will not quit on the journey of destiny.
Father, in the name of Jesus, fulfill your work in me.
Cause me to walk in the purpose and the plan that you have predestined for my life.
I will fulfill everything that you have ordained for me.
I ascend into the fulfillment of my destiny.
Nothing shall stand in my way.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my destiny has been unlocked, my future is unlocked.
I am entering into my destiny.
I am entering into my destiny.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For a New Season
segments: Father, I thank you for new beginnings.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I switch directions.
I divorce myself from the past.
I divorce myself from past memories.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I put an end to my past.
The frustrations of the past, the difficulties of the past, they are all behind me.
Father, my season of struggle has come to an end.
Every chain, every bondage, every stronghold, every mindset that has kept me from moving in the capacity that you desire, Father, let it be broken today.
Father, shift my dimension.
Father, take me to another level.
Release my new season in the name of Jesus.
Father, help me in my season of transition.
Father, give me the courage to restart.
Father, expand my capacity for the new beginning.
I receive everything new that you have for me.
Whatever you are doing in this season, please don't do it without me.
Fresh grace, fresh anointing over my life, fresh grace, fresh anointing for this new season.
Father, in the name of Jesus, it is my season for my own shift to come to pass.
It is time for me to break out and walk into what you have declared over me and walk into what you have destined for me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I enter into my season.
I enter into my hour, I enter into my moment.
Father, in the name of Jesus, a new beginning has begun, I thank you that a new beginning has begun for me.
I thank you, Father, that I don't have to hold on to the past.
I shall not be defined by the old things, but I will be refined by the new things.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: While I Wait on God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you and I wait on you.
You are my strength, you are my salvation, you are my hope.
Lord Jesus, I wait on you, renew my strength today.
Renew my strength today in Jesus' mighty name.
Father, I ask for forgiveness for every time I have jumped the gun, I have gone out because of zeal.
Father, have mercy on me, forgive me today, cleanse me today and position me, position me, oh Lord.
Father, give me the grace to be patient, to wait for my time.
Lord, I don't want to go ahead of my time, perfect me according to your will.
Father, give me strength for this time of drought, that I may withstand, that I don't lose the grip of the promise.
Help me to hold on.
Father, strengthen me and perfect patience in me, oh Lord.
Father, every spirit keeping me from the promise that you have for me, let it be broken.
Father, everything that would keep me from the promise, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Let the influence of doubt be broken from me.
Let the influence of fear be broken from me in the name of Jesus.
I accept your process, I accept your timing, oh God.
I want to know your timing, I want to walk with your timing.
Lord, whatever you have prepared for me, I await, and I know I am receiving.
Your word says you make all things beautiful in its time.
Do it your way and do it in your timing.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I am before you, I am before your grace, I humble myself before your mercy.
