I am anointed for the promise, and nothing will keep me from the promise.
Father, I believe that this is my season.
I thank you that today is that day that what I have been waiting for has been released in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Breaking Generational Curses
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, Father, today give me a prophetic understanding of my entire family and the actions of my people.
Whatever was done by my fathers, by my mothers, that was unpleasing to you, the decisions they made that are affecting me right now, Father, I stand as a representative of this bloodline.
Father, I ask you to forgive us, Father, I ask you to cleanse us, Father, I ask you to purify us.
Lord, cleanse me from family curse, from every generational spirit.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by the spirit of the living God, I separate myself from every generational curse, every calamity of my family.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce and denounce every occultic connection, let it be broken over my life.

Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was signed on my behalf, that was entered into on the behalf of my bloodline, on the behalf of my generations, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.

That thing that held my family, that spirit that held my family, those situations that held my fathers before me, those situations that held my mothers before me, by the spirit of God, I rebuke it, I bind it.
Patterns of rejection, patterns of denial, patterns of failure, in the name of Jesus, I disconnect myself.
Every demonic assignment, every demonic agenda, in the name of Jesus, over my bloodline, I destroy you, over my bloodline, I neutralize you, over my bloodline, I terminate your assignment.
Your assignment over my bloodline will never prosper.
Every carryover curse, every carryover debt, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Every curse over my life be broken, every curse over my family be broken, every curse over my children be broken.
Father, use me as a curse breaker in my family.
Use me, Father, to end every demonic pattern, use me to end generational patterns, use me to end every evil pattern that has reigned in my bloodline.
Make me the curse breaker in my family, God, cause me to be the one to break the curse, let it all stop with me, God.
May my bloodline be delivered, may that deliverance begin with me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, generational curses are broken.
Father, I thank you for the victory, I thank you for eternal redemption, I thank you that I am redeemed from the curse.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from every satanic covenant, I am free from witchcraft, I am free from generational curses, I am free from bloodline curses.
I am separated from every curse, I am separated from every witchcraft, I am separated from every generational curse.
No generational curses will flow from me, and no generational curse will flow to me.
Only generational blessing in Jesus' mighty name.
No curse will operate in my bloodline, no curse will operate in my generation from today.
I become freedom for my children, I become freedom for my household.
Today I am made whole, today I am made new, today I am made free, today by reason of the blood of Jesus.
In Jesus' name, Amen.

title: Breaking Evil Cycles and Patterns
segments: In the mighty name of Jesus, in the powerful name of Jesus, Father, you know my life, you know everything that is in my life.
Cause me to see the patterns, oh God, that happen over and over again, God, reveal them to me.
Father, anything from my past, anything from the past of my parents, anything from the past of my forefathers, anything from the past of my great grandparents, Father, reveal every hidden thing.
Reveal every hidden thing and break it.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic pattern in my life, let it be destroyed.
Patterns of poverty, patterns of limitation, patterns of confusion, patterns of difficulty, in the mighty name of Jesus, let every evil pattern be broken in the name of Jesus.
I renounce every evil pattern, I renounce every negative pattern.
Pattern of almost there but never there, pattern of almost making it but never making it, every pattern, every negative pattern, I renounce it from today.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every demonic pattern following me, because of my connection, because of my association, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
I break you, I neutralize you, I nullify you today in the name of Jesus by reason of the blood.
You will not continue in my life, you will not continue in my family, you will not continue in my blood.
Every spirit that has brought patterns into my life, I crush it now.
I will not struggle with what my father struggled with, I will not struggle with what my mother struggled with.
Father, I will not repeat the mistakes of my parents, I will not repeat the patterns that they lived.
From today, I abort every cycle of destruction, I end every cycle of destruction, I come out of every cycle of destruction.
Father, I end every demonic cycle that has been operating in my family.
Every evil cycle break, every evil pattern break, every evil curse break in the name of Jesus.
Father, I have seen the patterns, I have seen the sicknesses, I have seen the barrenness, I have seen the limitations, I have seen the confusion, but today, oh Lord, it ends with me.
By the power of the Holy Ghost and in the mighty name of Jesus, those cycles end with me.
I break out of old ways, old patterns, I break out in the name of Jesus.
Father, do a new thing with me, begin a new pattern with me, begin a new order with me.
I am free from my fathers by the blood of Jesus, I am free from my mothers by the blood of Jesus.
From today in the name of Jesus, I declare a new beginning, I declare a new path.
A new pattern has been written by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Thank you Father for redemption, thank you Father for liberation, thank you Father for freedom.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Freedom from Addiction
segments: Lord Jesus, I come before you genuinely, I come before you honestly.
You know my weaknesses, you know where I am weak, you know what I struggle with.
Lord, I don't want to be part of what is happening to me, the addictions, the hidden behaviors.
Lord Jesus, I don't want them anymore, I bring it before you.
Today, oh Lord, I renounce and deny all those things that I've been doing in secret.
Lord Jesus, forgive me, Lord Jesus, have mercy on me, Lord Jesus, cleanse me.
I have tried to make myself free, it has not worked, but only you can make me free, only you can set me free.
Father, in the name of Jesus, you never created me for bondage, you created me for freedom, I was born to be free.
Father, by reason of the blood of Jesus, may I have a clear conscience before you, may my conscience be purified.
Father, remove this evil program in my mind.

In the mighty name of Jesus, every spirit of addiction, anxiety, pornographic addiction, drug addiction, prescription drug addiction, no matter what kind of addiction it is, in the mighty name of Jesus, may those things begin to fall apart.
Smoking addiction, drinking addiction, drug addiction, alcohol addiction, in the mighty name of Jesus, let it be broken.
Let my blood be purified and cleansed from every wicked addiction.
Desires that are not of God, I break in the mighty name of Jesus.
I arrest that demon of addiction and I command you, go back to the pit, I strip you of your power, I strip you of your strength.
I abort your assignment, I end your influence in the mighty name of Jesus.
I will see every taste of drugs, every taste of evil substances become repulsive to me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Any desire and any addiction, remove it from my subconscious in the mighty name of Jesus.
Thoughts of addiction, out, thoughts of bondage, out, in the name of Jesus.
Father, I declare freedom over my family, freedom from every form of addiction.
Father, don't forsake me, I am your child, I am helpless, without you I am destroyed, without you I am lost.
So today I come before you, deliver me from addictions, from witchcraft, from sorcery, Father, set me free.
Whether it is confusion, whether it is addiction, whether it is limitation, this is the last time.
Because of the blood of Jesus, I am coming out of this cage.
Because of the cross, I am liberated, I am delivered.
The addictions and the chains of sin, because of the cross today, I decree and declare, let it be broken.
I receive the mind of Christ, I receive a new conscience, I receive a new thought pattern.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Divine Protection
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you that your word is true.
I thank you that your word will always come to pass.
Father, you are my shield and defender.
Father, I desire that your angels be around me.
Father, cover me today under your wings, according to your words.
Father, in the name of Jesus, protect your interest today, cover your interest today.
Father, preserve me, Father, watch over me, Father, elevate me, Father, hold me by your right hand.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak divine protection over my family.
Father, wherever they go, they are protected, wherever they set foot, they are protected, wherever they stand, they are protected.
Every trap set against me to kill me on the road, to harm me on the road, me and my family, in the mighty name of Jesus, I cancel it now.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
You will not touch us, you will not see us, you will not locate us in the name of Jesus.
I decree and declare that a wall of fire will separate me from the darkness and from every device of the enemy.
Let there be a separation between me and those who are planning to cause me harm.
In the name of Jesus, I dip my family into the blood of Jesus.
Today I dip myself into the blood of Jesus.
No accident will find me on the road.
No premature death will find me or my children.
I am under the shadow of the Almighty.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
I am heavily defended and heavenly protected from today.
No arrow by day or by night will harm me or my family.
Premature death is not my portion.
I am protected by God, I am covered by God, I am directed by God.
Angels are around me, angels are before me, angels are behind me.
I will not die, I will live to declare the goodness of God.
Father, I thank you for divine protection of my family from today.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Witchcraft and Evil Arrows
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, because of the blood of Jesus, I am free.
I am free from every arrow of Satan, from every evil enchantment.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Demons have no place in me.
Every spirit of witchcraft, every spirit of sorcery, may it be cancelled now in the name of Jesus, upon my children, upon my family, upon my future.
Spirit of witchcraft, in the name of Jesus, be thou broken.
Father, in the name of Jesus, where my name is being mentioned under enchantments and witchcraft, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever my name is being mentioned, on altars, on offerings, wherever witchcraft is taking place, let it be broken now.
Father, every witch fighting against my life, every sorcerer arising against my life, in the mighty name of Jesus, let their charms be broken.
Let their altars be broken.
Every charm against my life, in the name of Jesus, I scatter you.
Every charm that has been invoked against my life, against my family, against my children, in the name of Jesus, let it be destroyed by fire.
Any altar raised against my family, raised against my life, raised against my destiny, raised against my future, from today it shall be broken.
Every wicked altar, every wicked enchantment, wherever you are located, catch fire.

I cancel every agenda of death, every agenda of premature death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
That witchcraft that was planned against me is returning to the one who started it, that spell that was cast upon me is going back to sender.
Every witchcraft enchantment be broken, every witchcraft incantation be broken, every witchcraft spell be broken, every witchcraft bondage be broken, every witchcraft decree be broken.
No witchcraft will prevail in my family, no witchcraft will remain in my home.
Every power of witchcraft, every power of sorcery, you are under my feet.
I crush you to pieces, I crush you to pieces, I crush you to pieces, I burn you to ashes in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will not manipulate my life, you will not manipulate my mind, you will not manipulate my home, you will not manipulate my children.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am separated from curses, I am separated from witchcraft, I am separated from sorcery, by reason of the blood of Jesus, I have no more occultic connections.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
I declare freedom from witchcraft, freedom from witchcraft, freedom from witchcraft today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every curse is broken, every witchcraft is broken, every occultic power is broken, every darkness is removed.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Spiritual Attacks and Oppression
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus, because it was spilled for my sake.
Father, I thank you, I am secured by the blood of Jesus.
Today I forbid every devil access to my soul, because I give my life to you today.
Holy Spirit, establish me in all truths, that there may be no room for devils.
Oh Lord Jesus, help me today, rescue me today from the claws of the evil one.
Deliver me, oh Lord, from every demonic oppression.
Deliver me, oh Lord, from every satanic influence.
Redeem me, oh Lord, from every demonic covenant.
Father, deliver me from every trap of the enemy.
Deliver me, oh God, from every plan of the enemy, deliver me, God, from every attack of the enemy.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every demonic attack upon my family, upon my children, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Every demonic lie in my life, let it be silenced now.
Every intention of the enemy concerning my life, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit of oppression, every spirit of depression, I destroy you in the name of Jesus.
You will not touch my children, you will not touch my home, you will not touch my life.
Whatever your assignment is, it will not prosper.
What I've been going through, this is the last time, what I've been struggling with, this is the last time, what I've been fighting with, this is the last time.
You evil spirit, you demonic power, I call you by your name, right now, your time has expired.
Father, restore my soul, may I find peace again, you are my peace, you are my rest.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, you have no room in my life, you evil spirit.
I revoke your access by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Light be in my soul, light be in my body, light be in my spirit.
I expose every work of darkness.
Everything done in the dark concerning my life, I expose it in the name of Jesus.
I am delivered, I am free, no evil spirit has room in me.
No evil assignment will operate in my life.
Witchcraft is under my feet, in the name of Jesus, sorcery is under my feet, in the mighty name of Jesus, the works of darkness are under my feet.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Evil Altars and Covenants
segments: Father, because of your son Jesus and the amazing sacrifice on the cross, I have been saved.
Father, you know my life, you know everything that is in my life.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
In the name of Jesus, I renounce and I denounce every occultic connection to my life, every occultic connection in my bloodline.

Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was signed on my behalf, that was entered into on the behalf of my bloodline, on the behalf of my generations, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.

In the name of Jesus, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let every satanic covenant, let every demonic attachment, let every demonic covenant, let every demonic union, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let it lose its power.
Let it be nullified, let it be cancelled, let it be dissolved in the name of Jesus.
Family ties that are demonic, marital ties that are demonic, employment ties that are demonic, by the blood of Jesus, let them be dissolved, let them be cancelled.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself, I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant.
Whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let that covenant catch fire.

Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever altar my name has been mentioned, my family has been mentioned, my bloodline has been mentioned, every assignment of the devil upon that, I cancel it now, I destroy it now.
Father, let my name be erased from that altar, let my name be removed from that altar, let my picture disappear from that altar.
Every demonic altar that has my name, every demonic altar that has the name of my children, every demonic altar that has the name of my family, by fire, I scatter you.
Every wicked altar, every wicked enchantment, wherever you are located, catch fire.
Any altar raised against my family, raised against my life, raised against my destiny, raised against my future, from today it shall be broken.
Every demonic altar in my family that has caused me to be useless in life, Father, I understand there is an altar, that altar has stood against me, that altar was erected against me.
Let that altar be destroyed today, let that altar be consumed by fire today, that altar that has been fighting me not to get to my portion.
Altars of discord, altars of confusion, altars of stagnancy, altars of witchcraft, altars of difficulty, altars of limitations, today in the name of Jesus, catch fire.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I dismantle every altar, I dismantle every spirit that is robbing my life of God's blessing.
You unclean spirit, I send you to the pit where you belong.
Today, by the altar of heaven that is covered in the blood of Jesus, I crush your altar wherever it is.
Whatever altar was contending with my family, with my children, with my business, with my career has been destroyed by the heavenly altar.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from every satanic covenant.
I am free from witchcraft, I am free from generational curses, I am free from bloodline curses.
I belong to King Jesus, I am secured by the Holy Spirit.
Every satanic altar has been destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When Enemies Rise Against Me
segments: Lord Jesus, you are my hope, you are the only one who can stand up for me.
Many have risen against me, many have risen against your people, Father, reveal yourself, Father, show yourself.
Father, fight for me, Father, defend me.
Jesus, you are my salvation, Jesus, you are my high tower.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my spiritual eyes, that nothing the enemy does will be unnoticed.
I decree and declare my eyes have been opened, nothing will happen without my knowledge.
Every plan of the enemy against me and my family, every plan of the enemy against everything that you have given me, in the mighty name of Jesus, I pull it down.
Every device of the enemy, every meeting in the dark realm, I scatter it now in the name of Jesus.
Everywhere where enemies have gathered around my name and my family's name, in the mighty name of Jesus, may the angel of the Lord scatter them.
Every agenda from the pit of hell, every assignment from the hell today, I arrest it, I neutralize it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I escape every plan of darkness.
Whatever your assignment is, it will not prosper, whatever your assignment is, it will not be fulfilled.
Every demonic intention in my life, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Whatever plans the enemy have for me, let them be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Every spirit fighting against me that I don't even know, in the mighty name of Jesus, may that spirit be scattered today.
Father, every word spoken against me, let them be of no effect today.
Whether they were spoken in secret, whether they were spoken publicly, I cancel them in the name of Jesus.
Father, I bind every single thing that the enemy has intended against my family.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Demons have no place in me, demons have no place around my family.
In the mighty name of Jesus, everything that is standing against me, by reason of the blood of Jesus, it is under my feet.
Every work of the enemy that is targeting me, it is under my feet.
I speak confusion in the camp of the enemy.
What the enemy wanted to use for evil, let it be used for good today.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I have the final word in every battle.
The enemies will be disappointed, I will continue to win, I will continue to prosper.
Because of the blood of Jesus, victory is mine, in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: For Safe Travel
segments: Father God, thank you for the divine atmosphere of favor that surrounds me.
Because you have favored me, my steps are ordered by you.
Your hand guides my every move and your wisdom lights the path before me.
I am protected because you are my shield, my defense, and my ever present help in time of need.
I have no fear because I know that you are holding me.
I know that I am kept, I know that I am covered, I know that I am sheltered.
Continue to strengthen me for the work ahead, for the walk ahead, for the journey ahead.
Keep me from the evil one.
Father, strengthen my body for the journey.
Father, may your grace travel with me today.
Father, redirect my path and set me on the right path.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every trap set against me to kill me on the road, to harm me on the road, me and my family, in the mighty name of Jesus, I cancel it now.
Let those who dug the trap, let those who dug the pit fall into it themselves in the mighty name of Jesus.
There is no roadblock of the devil that would say slow down.
No demon will be a speed bump for me.
I escape every trap of the enemy.
I escape every wrong journey in the name of Jesus.
There shall be no accident on the road for me.
A thousand may fall on my right, ten thousand on my right, it shall not harm me.
Even if the whole highway collapses, I will walk out of it.
I am blessed coming in and going out.
The same way I left, I am coming back.
No bone in my body shall be broken.
My life will not be cut short in the mighty name of Jesus.
Angels will meet me when I drive, angels will meet me when I travel, let it be established.
Whatsoever I do, the angels of God will go ahead of me.
In you, I dwell secure in Jesus' name. Amen.

title: Renouncing Ancestral Covenants
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of your son that has reconciled me unto yourself.
I thank you for the new covenant that establishes me in you.
Father, I renounce every covenant that I have with the dark world, unknowingly and knowingly.
Father, I renounce any covenant that my fathers before me and my mothers before me, on both sides of my family, had with anything demonic.
Father, I renounce it, Father, I reject it in the mighty name of Jesus.
I separate myself, I disconnect myself in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I disconnect myself, anything from my father's house, anything from my mother's, any agreement, I disconnect myself.
Anything that was passed through my blood, anything that was passed through where I was born, anything that was passed through where I grew up, I disconnect myself.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I disconnect myself, I disconnect my family, I disconnect my children from every old covenant.
Whether it was done by my ancestors, whether it was done by me, consciously or unconsciously, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let that covenant catch fire.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, let it catch fire, let it lose its power.

Every occultic covenant, every occultic vow that was signed on my behalf, that was entered into on the behalf of my bloodline, on the behalf of my generations, Father, let the blood of Jesus come to the root today.
Every power of darkness, every ancestral spirit, every ancestral covenant, by reason of the blood of Jesus, may it begin to break.
Covenants of the spirit, let them be broken because of the blood of Jesus, because of the pure blood of Jesus, because of the holy blood of Jesus.
Every generational covenant to evil spirits, to unclean spirits, to demonic spirits, oh Lord, today, total deliverance.
I silence every voice in my bloodline.
There will be no trace of my past, no traces of my ancestors that will follow me.
The only ancestor I recognize is Abraham, and the promises you have established with him that are fulfilled in Christ Jesus.
Because of your blood, I will not have generational curses.
Because of your blood, there is no covenant that will hold me.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every evil covenant is broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free from every satanic covenant.
I am secure by the covenant of the blood of Jesus.
No generational curses will flow from me, and no generational curse will flow to me.
I am a covenant child, my family are sealed by the covenant of the blood of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Renouncing Family Idols and Dedications
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus, because it was spilled for my sake.
I announce it before heaven, the earth, the visible and the invisible, I am bought by Jesus, I belong to Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, in the powerful name of Jesus, in this hour I renounce witchcraft, sorcery, any affiliation with the occult.
Whatever my family did before me, even the ways that I was conceived, I denounce it.
Serving other gods in my family, I denounce it.
Oh Lord, may you rise up that every idol will be crushed.
Whatever is of the enemy, whether I know it or not, Lord my God, you know it all, in the name of Jesus, I denounce it.
In every place on the earth where they have raised an idol to afflict me and my family and my seed, let it be the day of the Lord's judgment.
My faith is only on you, Lord Jesus, and you alone.
That demonic dedication, unknowingly, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Spirit of sorcery, black magic, white magic, spells of all kinds, occultic covenants, I command you out.
Whatever demonic substance, whatever demonic connection I have, I renounce it and denounce it in the name of Jesus.
I renounce every evil pact, every evil covenant.
The devil cannot have a claim to my bloodline because my bloodline is now in Christ.
Remove my name from the altar of the wicked ones, remove me from every sorcery and witchcraft.
Let every evil thing done against me and my family, let it be destroyed now in the mighty name of Jesus.
From today, whatever defiled me is cancelled by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Whatever altar was contending with my family, with my children, with my business, with my career has been destroyed by the heavenly altar.
Father, empower me to release my life to you.
I renounce and denounce everything that is not of God, every impurity, every covenant with any spirit, every demonic spirit, every evil spirit, every unclean spirit, I reject it and I renounce it.
Today I forbid every devil access to my soul, because I give my life to you today.
Lord Jesus, lead me, Lord Jesus, guide me.
Father, I thank you, I am secured by the blood of Jesus.
Lord Jesus, thank you for liberation, I belong to you, may I follow you all the days of my life.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Familiar Spirits in My Family
segments: Lord Jesus, Son of David, purify me by your blood.
Sanctify me by your blood.
Help me, you are my only help, I look to you, Lord Jesus, help me.
In the name of Jesus, every ancestral spirit, every wicked spirit, come out of my life.
Every power of darkness, every ancestral spirit, every ancestral covenant, by reason of the blood of Jesus, may it begin to break.
Whatever is not of God that has been holding my life, today in the name of Jesus, I make you powerless.
You ancestral spirit, you have been talking to me, I remove you from my ears in the name of Jesus.
You are silenced, I take power from you, I take strength from you in the name of Jesus.
Whatever was intended for me to send me to an early grave has been cancelled in the name of Jesus.
You ancestral spirit from the waters and from the forest, I disconnect myself from you by reason of the blood of Jesus.
From today, you will no longer see me, you will no longer find me, I will be out of your reach in the name of Jesus Christ.
I am hidden under the wings of the Holy Spirit.
This is not your body, this has never been your body and it will not be your body again in the name of Jesus.
Ancestral spirits, unclean spirit, you violent spirit, your time has expired, leave my body and never return again in the name of Jesus.
Those things that followed my family will not follow me.
No bondage shall be on me, no bondage will follow me, no bondage will be part of my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Take away every curse, take away every limitation.
Break the power of witchcraft, break the power of sorcery.
Son of David, deliver me, Son of David, set me free.
Whatever is not from God in my family, may it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
No failure is my portion, miracles are my portion, testimonies are my portion.
Thank you, Holy Spirit, now it is finished, Amen.

title: Repenting for My Bloodline
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, Father, today give me a prophetic understanding of my entire family and the actions of my people.
Father, have mercy upon me.
Whatever was done by my fathers, by my mothers, that was unpleasing to you, the decisions they made that are affecting me right now.
Father, I stand as a representative of this bloodline.
Father, I ask you to forgive us, Father, I ask you to cleanse us, Father, I ask you to purify us.
Lord, I have done things that are despicable that my fathers did that I did not stop.
Every pattern of sin that came from my fathers, from my mothers, that I have in my life, Father, I ask you for mercy and I ask you to remove this from me.
Lord, I pray, forgive the sin of my fathers, forgive the sin of my fathers.
Rescue me from the patterns that I have maintained from them.
Generational patterns that are still upon me, let them be broken, let them be broken.
Every error before I was born, every error I was born in, I correct it in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every demonic pattern following me, because of my connection, because of my association, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
You will not continue in my life, you will not continue in my family, you will not continue in my blood.
As the blood of Jesus cleanses my conscience from every dead works, every dead works in me will die, every dead work that came from my forefathers will die.
Every dead act from my forefathers that is manifesting in me, it shall end with me.
My whole family story will be rewritten.
In the name of Jesus, may my bloodline be delivered, may that deliverance begin with me.
Let freedom come to my bloodline, oh God, and let it begin with me.
May my bloodline be purified, God.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, may I be delivered.
Father, use me as a curse breaker in my family.
Every bad spirit from my mother's side, from my father's side, let it be dismantled in the name of Jesus.
From today I will not suffer the sins of my forefathers.
Father, I thank you that because of the blood of Jesus I am no longer under a curse.
I will no longer suffer for what I did not do, I am a new creation, I am a new creature in Christ Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Breaking Self-Curses
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, by your altar that stands before you, by the power of the Holy Spirit, purify my lips.
Lord, forgive me for speaking against my identity.
Father, forgive me, oh Lord, for every word that I spoke against myself.
Forgive me, Father, for speaking against my destiny.
Father, I renounce everything that I might have spoken against my friend, my family, my children, I renounce it.
The things that I might have uttered when I was angry, I renounce it.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I cancel every negative word I have spoken.
Words I spoke as a child, words I have spoken as an adult, words I have spoken in pain, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Father, every idle word that I spoke out of woundedness, out of unforgiveness, out of anger, out of disappointment, I cancel it now in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I renounce every single curse that I have spoken over myself.
I reverse it, and I speak blessings over myself.
Today I undo every negative word that I have spoken concerning my own life, that I have spoken concerning my own family.
Words of failure, words of complaining that has created an atmosphere of demons, every negative word that has come out of me, by the power of the Holy Spirit I undo those words.
Every negative word that I have spoken concerning myself, I break it and tear it down in the mighty name of Jesus.
It shall not have a hold on me.
Every word of delay, I cancel it, every word of failure, I cancel it, every word of lack, I cancel it.
Every time I gave up on myself and I spoke those words, oh God, I reverse it.
Every word of failure, may it lose its power because of the blood of Jesus.
Every evil confession from my lips, let it be cancelled now.
I renounce those words today.
I am not defeated, I am not broken, I am not confused, I am not stagnant.
Everywhere where my confession agreed with the enemy, today, Father, I neutralize, I cancel, and I erase by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Father, all that I speak from this day, let it be words of life, let it be words of hope, let it be words of truth.
I declare blessing over myself, the blessing of the Lord over myself.
My truth is the truth that God has spoken over my life.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Breaking Word Curses Spoken against Me
segments: Father, every word spoken against me, let them be of no effect today.
Whether they were spoken in secret, whether they were spoken publicly, I cancel them in the name of Jesus.
Today in the name of Jesus, every negative word spoken against me, I am sending it back to the sender.
In the name of Jesus, every word spoken against me, I return it to the sender, may those intentions in those words manifest in their own lives.
Let every evil ordinance ordained against me be broken in the name of Jesus, and let it be blotted out now.
Father, every evil spoken against me, let it be blotted out right now, may it be broken, may it be broken, may it be blotted out as if it was never there.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I silence every word of the accuser.
Every word of slander to destroy my future, I make it powerless.
Nobody will hear those words, nobody will be moved by those words.
Every word that is resisting me in the atmosphere, words of sorcery, words of witchcraft, spells, in the mighty name of Jesus I pull them down.
Wherever my name was spoken and it was released contrary to what God has said about me, I pull it down now in the name of Jesus.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I condemn every voice, every demonic voice, every satanic voice.
Every whisper of defeat, every whisper of death, every whisper of failure, every whisper of sickness, every whisper of poverty, be broken in the name of Jesus.
I condemn every word, I condemn every voice, according to the word of God, as it says, I shall condemn every tongue.
As it says, I shall condemn everything that raises itself above the knowledge of God.
I condemn every voice that is speaking against my destiny in God.
No other word, no other tongue, no other judgment shall be established over my life contrary to what God has said.
Because of the blood of Jesus, let every curse be broken, let every enchantment be broken.
Father, let deliverance come, let every enchantment set up against me, let every plan of the enemy against me and my family, let it be scattered now in the name of Jesus.
Today I come out of agreement with the voice of the enemy.
Every word from the enemy, through men, through women, through children, through my elders, through my friends, whatever means the enemy used, I disagree with that word, I disconnect from that word.
Today I disagree with every word that says I will not make it.
Every lie of the enemy that is in my ears, that I have allowed to settle in my life, Father, by your spirit, may it be taken away.
Wherever there was a word spoken against me, I cancel that word now in the name of Jesus.
Father, your word alone shall be established over me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Deliverance from Demonic Oppression
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you, you are my help, you are my salvation, Lord Jesus, I look to you, you are my hope, you are my strength.
Father, remember me today, save me, oh Lord, redeem me, oh Lord, with a mighty deliverance.
Any chain, any oppression, any demonic influence in my life, Father, deliver me with a mighty hand.
Set me free from this demonic oppression.
Lord Jesus, have mercy on me, if there is anything hiding in me, Lord Jesus, deliver me.
Anything that is in me that did not come from you, I command it now to leave me and never return.
Every evil spirit that has deceived me that I should not live in rest, I command that tormenting spirit to come out of my life.
You spirit of anxiety, you spirit of confusion, I command you to leave my life, spirit of worry, leave my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every demonic pattern in my thoughts, let it be broken, let it be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
Every entity living in me, I command them to leave me, I command them to be evicted out of my body.
My body is the temple of the living God.
You demon tormenting my mind, you demon tormenting my family, come out in the name of Jesus.
There is no agreement with you and I, there is no fellowship with you, I come out of every union with you.
I speak to every demonic power, I speak to every satanic power, I speak to the spirit of witchcraft, I speak to sorcery, I speak to every craft of the enemy, I denounce you and I renounce you.
I have nothing to do with you, I belong to Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever is hidden in my life that is of demonic origin, let it be broken now.
What has been controlling my mind, what has been controlling my decisions, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Light be in every hidden place in my life, light be in every hidden place in my heart.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, you have no room in my life, you have no place in my life.
I revoke your access by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Every yoke on me, I break it in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, the days of struggling with evil spirits has come to an end.
I am free of every demonic power, I am free of every demonic oppression, I am free of every stronghold.
Darkness, you have no room in me, darkness, you have no place in me.
From today, the power of the Holy Spirit shall flow through me, and I shall fulfill my destiny.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against the Devices of the Devil
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, open my eyes to understand.
Father, give me spiritual understanding in Jesus' mighty name.
Father, I thank you in the name of your son Jesus, my precious father, my good God, my eternal father, my redeemer, my deliverer, and my savior.
Father, I pray that you wash me, cleanse me of every unclean work.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I acknowledge you today that you are the author of my life.
I have realized that all the detours in my life is because I failed to acknowledge you.
I did pray, but I acknowledged the devil.
I decree and declare that every accusation of Satan to turn God against me, to turn me against God, may that plan be destroyed right now in the name of Jesus.
May the knowledge of the Spirit be inside of me.
Every lie and deception of the devil will be destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus.
The devices of the enemy, the greatest weapon of Satan, will be made of no effect in my life.
Every lie of the devil must be submitted to the word of God, must be arrested by the word of God.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pull down every demonic lie, I pull down every satanic lie, I pull down every distortion of the enemy in my life in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every stronghold in my mind, may it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I pull down every stronghold in the mind.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I command you, take everything you have put inside of me and never return again.
Whatever you have joined yourself with me with, may it be broken in the name of Jesus Christ.
The devil is under my feet.
Jesus has given me victory, victory over sickness, victory over diseases, victory over infirmities, victory over poverty, victory over curses, victory over limitation.
I have overcome in the name of Jesus.
Lord Jesus, thank you for setting me free.
Thank you, Father, for freedom in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: Against Evil Arrows
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I speak divine protection over my family.
I establish a law of protection over my family.
Father, every arrow that has been shot out of the darkness against my life today, I disconnect it in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow that has been shot against my children, every arrow that has been shot against my family, I command you reverse back to sender.
You will not touch me, you will not see me, you will not locate me in the name of Jesus.
Every arrow shot against me, shot against my family, shot against my children, shot against my bloodline in order to bring death, today I reverse every arrow back to sender.
Every assignment of death will not touch me, every assignment of death will not touch my family.
I will not die, I will not be destroyed, I will not be derailed by the plan of wickedness.
Every arrow of premature death, every agenda, you are broken in Jesus' name.
I break you in the name of Jesus.
Every accident that is targeting me or my family, every arrow that is targeting me or my family in order to kill us before our time, I reverse you back to sender.
Your assignment is broken, today your assignment is neutralized, your assignment is nullified.

I cancel every agenda of death, every agenda of premature death, every arrow of death that has been shot against my home, my household, my family, my children, my loved ones in the mighty name of Jesus.
You will never find your target, you will never land, you will never accomplish your mission.
I arrest you in the name of Jesus and I divert you back to sender.
Every assignment of death is neutralized, it is nullified by reason of the blood of Jesus today.
Father, I cover my family today in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, every arrow of destruction, every arrow of affliction, every arrow of sickness will not come near them in the name of Jesus.
Father, arrows that are intended for people will not catch them by mistake.
Father, you will keep me from the arrow that flies by day.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I am under the shadow of the Almighty.
My life is hidden in Christ and in God, out of the reach of every demon, out of the reach of every sorcery, out of the reach of every spell.
I am heavily defended and heavenly protected.
From today, no arrow by day or by night will harm me or my family.
My family is protected, my family is heavenly guarded, my family is defended in the mighty name of Jesus.
I shall live and not die.
Thank you, Father, for divine protection from today, Amen.

title: Uprooting Evil Plantings
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, you know my life and nothing is hidden from you, my father and my Lord.
Whatever Satan has planted in my heart and planted in my mind to prevent me from seeing your goodness, Father, I command it out of me in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every power of darkness that has planted evil seeds in me, seeds of doubt, seeds of confusion, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Seeds of doubt, I break you.
Seeds of fear, come out from me now in the name of Jesus.
Everything that is in me that was not born of the Spirit of God, may it be removed from me now in the name of Jesus.
Lord, remove the seeds that came from the wrong tree.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every wicked seed within me, let it be removed now.
Today, by the Spirit of God, every wicked seed must be destroyed.
May the Lord work the ground of my heart and remove every wicked seed that has been planted in me.
I pray today that every lie of the enemy that is in my ears, that I have allowed to settle in my life, Father, by your spirit, may it be taken away.

Father, erase every lie, Father, remove every word that is perverted in me, words of defeat, words of failure, words of shame, words of humiliation, words of stagnancy, words that have made me feel worthless.
Let every seed that was trying to strangle your word be uprooted from me now in the name of Jesus.
Whatever seed of darkness has been planted into my children, let it be uprooted now in the name of Jesus.
Everything that you did, everything that you have left, everything that you have planted, I command it out in the name of Jesus.
Every residue, every residue, be purged now in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from today every root of evil within me, Father, uproot it by your spirit.
Every unfruitfulness within me, let it dry from the roots.
Uproot the tree that is in me, it has only produced bitterness, it has produced brokenness, it has not benefited anybody.
Oh Lord Jesus, plant a new seed in me that will reverse all the past bad fruits that have been in me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, water what you have planted in me.
I am planted in the mission of God.
Lord Jesus, thank you for deepening my roots, that I would not shipwreck, that my life will be preserved.
May my roots go deep in God, may my roots go deep into the Spirit of God, that despite the season, I am the same.
I am free today in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: Pulling Down Strongholds
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I call on your name.
You have given me authority and power to pull down every stronghold, to pull down every satanic force, to pull down every demonic power that is fighting against where you have sent me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, every stronghold in my mind, may it be broken.
Oh God, let every stronghold in my mind be broken.
God, let every thought that contends with your truth, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Let every prison of my memories, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let every thought that is not of God, thoughts of defeat, thoughts of death, thoughts of confusion, thoughts of shortcomings, thoughts of weakness, thoughts of limitation, thoughts of confusion.
By the power of the Holy Spirit, I pull down every stronghold in the mind.
Everything that is trying to control my mind, by the power of the Holy Spirit, let it be brought down.
Every confusion, every chaos, every wicked seed planting in my mind, let it be brought down.
The voices that said I cannot make it, the voices that said I am a failure, the voices that said I am nobody, the voices that said I am poor, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
Father, I pull down depression, I pull down oppression, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pull down every demonic lie.
I pull down every distortion of the enemy in my life, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Every chain, every bondage, every stronghold, every mindset that has kept me from moving in the capacity that you desire, Father, let it be broken today.
Everything in my life that has made me to conform to this world, in the mighty name of Jesus, may it be broken.
Every mental stronghold, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Wherever there are old thought processes that would stand in the way of revelation, let it be broken now in the name of Jesus.
Whatever mindsets are in me that are keeping me from your promise, let it be broken.
That spirit that has been holding my destiny, that spirit that has been holding my family, that spirit that has been hindering my doors, that spirit that has been blocking my ways.
That spirit that has kept my family in bondage from my father's side to my mother's side, in the mighty name of Jesus, may those powers be broken.
Every stronghold, let it be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Let this mind be in me which was also in Christ Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I secure my mind.
My mind is protected.
My mindset is transformed, my thinking is transformed, trauma no longer will hold me, the past no longer will hold me.
I am free of every demonic oppression, I am free of every stronghold, I am free of every witchcraft, I am free in Jesus' name.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Closing Every Open Door to the Enemy
segments: Lord Jesus, secure my family today.
Father, that the enemy will have no way, no entrance, no access to destroy my family.
In the name of Jesus, search me and know me.
Scan me, oh God, and whatsoever is unlike you, uproot it now.
Anything that is unlike you, oh God, dwelling on the inside of me, uproot it now.
Every access point that the enemy has used before, today, Father, I shut every access, I shut every entryway.
Break every hold, break every hold, close every access point in the name of Jesus.
Because I am a descendant of David through Christ Jesus, I make a decree.
You will not touch my family, you will not touch my finances.
I lock the door that gave you access.
Father, in the name of Jesus, no premature death shall come close to my door.
Every untimely death, I draw the line by reason of the blood of Jesus.
You have no access to my life, you have no access to my children, you have no access to my loved ones.
You will not come near my house, you will not come near my family.
Whatever agenda of the enemy is against me and my family to cut my life short, let it be scattered in the name of Jesus.
Let whatever they attempted to do to me, let it return to sender.
Every pattern of the past, every destruction of the past, every struggle of the past, Father, I eliminate it from my family.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, no cycle shall be perpetuated.
No curse shall be perpetuated by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Father, today I speak security, Father, I speak a defense of God, Father, a wall of fire.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, there is no claim over my life, no claim over my children, no claim over my bloodline.
I have been redeemed by the blood of Jesus.
My family is secured, my family is kept, my family is preserved in you in the name of Jesus.
No harm shall befall my family, no death shall befall my family.
Father, every enemy of my life has been scattered.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free, I am redeemed.
In the name of Jesus, I declare I am free today.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Against Territorial Spirits
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, everywhere any principality is planted in the territory you are sending me to, before I even get there, I pull down every principality and power.
For I am seated in heavenly places, higher than those principalities.
Today, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I step off my throne and I walk on those principalities and powers, I pull them down.
In that sphere, Father, any principality has been ruling, Father, that is the place you are setting me.
Before I get there, I pull down every power with them.
That wicked assignment, Father, they will not ruin that territory, they will not ruin anymore.
Father, I set a perimeter.
That is the domain that will never again have access, that is the domain that will never again have influence in the name of Jesus.
Father, by legal right, by reason of the blood, by the authority of Christ, Father, I take over that territory.
I pull down that dominion, I pull down the influence, I pull down the reign in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, let every territorial demon be pulled down.
Every enchantment on any altar with my name, with my family's names, let those altars be consumed, let that altar be destroyed.
In the mighty name of Jesus, my feet are walking on a higher ground.
I am seated in higher ground, far above principalities and powers.
I am walking in a different place, far above principalities and powers, far above every work of the enemy.
Nothing can hold me back, nothing can hold me down, nothing can chain me down.
Today I have all authority and power.
Father, in the name of Jesus, anoint my feet for a new territory.
That whenever I set my feet there, I will possess it.
Your word says wherever the soles of my feet shall touch, I shall possess it.
Every territory I ever visited, every territory that I will visit, I will possess it.
I possess that neighborhood, I possess that community, I possess that nation, I possess it now in the name of Jesus.
The anointing to possess territories is mine.
In the mighty name of Jesus, in the powerful name of Jesus, I expand my borders, I expand my territory.
I receive the spirit of boldness, like Joshua received boldness.
Father, I will be established with no contention, with no opposition, to establish your will, to establish your agenda, to fulfill your mission.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: Against the Spirit of Rejection
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I surrender myself in your capable hands, oh Lord.
Do not forsake the works of your hands.
I am your child.
Without you, I can accomplish nothing.
And I thank you, oh Father, because you have made me a conqueror.
You have made me victorious.
Today, oh Lord, I reject the image of men.
I reject every voice, every voice that has silenced your voice in the name of Jesus.
Every wicked seed of rejection, let it be consumed by fire.
Every wicked seed of being overlooked, let it be removed now.
Every wicked seed of embarrassment, let it be broken.
Every wicked seed of comparison, let it be destroyed.
Rejection, come out of me.
Every curse of rejection, every curse of death, every curse of poverty, every curse of oppression, break in the name of Jesus.
Every curse over my destiny be broken.
I break it by fire.
Every cycle of disgrace, every cycle of rejection, every cycle of pain in the name of Jesus.
Every evil cycle break, every evil pattern break, every evil curse break in the name of Jesus.
Father, wherever it came from, wherever it started, Father, I declare I bring a stop to it today.
That cycle break in the name of Jesus.
I am accepted by you, I am not rejected.
I will no longer compromise my identity in you.
I declare this day that everything I put my hand to is blessed.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Failure at the Edge of Success
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I welcome your work within me.
Holy Spirit, I welcome your work within me.
Father, from today these things shall not be part of my family.
I renounce every evil pattern, I renounce every negative pattern.
Pattern of almost there but never there, pattern of almost making it but never making it, every pattern, every negative pattern, I renounce it from today.
I renounce you in the name of Jesus.
Every pattern of starting and not finishing, every pattern of beginning and failing at the finish line, I break every evil, I renounce every evil in the name of Jesus.
I am tired of being almost there but never there.
You will not continue in my life.
You will not continue in my family.
You will not continue in my blood.
The voices that said I cannot make it, the voices that said I am a failure, the voices that said I am nobody, the voices that said I am poor, I silence them in the name of Jesus.
Today, I condemn failure.
I condemn the thoughts of failure.

Every tongue that resists the manifestation of your will for my life, every tongue that resists the establishment of the purpose of God for my life, every tongue that resists that which God has ordained, I condemn you.
No failure shall touch my life.
Father, lift me beyond this place.
I will not remain at this level.
I will not remain at this stage.
I decree and declare, everything that was not working will begin to work.
Everything that was broken will be mended today.
I decree and declare upon my life, it shall be well with me.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Victory in Legal Battles
segments: Father, let my case come before you today.
Visit me, oh Lord, and show me mercy.
Father, you know my case, you know my situation.
God, I need your intervention.
Let not the day go by without you speaking a word, without you turning the case in my favor.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let every court case that is set against me come to an end today.
Let every accusation against me come to an end today.
God, wherever there has been a case raised against me, let today it be cancelled.
Wherever there is a court case, wherever there is a court judgment that has been raised against me, that is in litigation against me, let it come to an end today.
Let it be turned over today.
Let it end in my favor today.
I cancel any kind of prison or jail in the mighty name of Jesus.
Whatever is planned against me, whatever is planned against my children, let it be exposed.
Let every demonic thing be exposed.
Every device of the enemy, every meeting in the dark realm, I scatter it now in the name of Jesus.
Everywhere where enemies have gathered around my name and my family's name, in the mighty name of Jesus, may the angel of the Lord scatter them.
I scatter every court case.
God, every agenda in dark realms, God, every agenda with my father's name, with my name, I scatter it.
Father, any link, any attention, any connection that is calling my name for evil, that is calling my name for injustice, that is calling my name for oppression, I disconnect in the name of Jesus.
Give me the wisdom to navigate, give me the wisdom to move, give me the wisdom to flow.
Let that court case be under my feet.
Whatever that battle is, it is under my feet.
Every situation I am facing, every battle I am in, I have overcome in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Strength in Trials
segments: Lord Jesus, I trust you in the midst of the fire, I trust you in the midst of the storm.
I trust you in the wilderness, I trust you in all situations, Lord.
Father, I understand that your people are empowered in the wilderness.
It is in that place that I receive strength, it is in that place that I learn intimacy.
Father, today by your spirit, I surrender myself to your process.
I understand that it will end in praise, I understand that it will end in glory.
Father, I am ready, give me endurance, give me strength to walk through storms.
I thought these troubles were because you have forsaken me, but now I know it is the opposite.
Strengthen my faith today, that my faith should not fail.
Strengthen me today, that I may be able to walk through the fire, that I may be able to persevere when everything seems lost.
Father, give me endurance, give me the ability to endure, that I may receive what you have for me.
Remove the ability to quit from me.
My suffering is not in vain, my lack is not in vain, you are using it to perfect me.
Holy Spirit, I know that you are with me.
Strengthen me, fortify me against every storm, against every desire of the enemy, against every weapon of the enemy.
Today I know that no weapon will prosper against me in the name of Jesus.
Give me the strength to stand, give me the ability to stand, that when the storms come, the spirit of God will raise a standard.
Father, show me your greatness in the midst of this storm, in the midst of this calamity, show me your strength, show me your power, show me your majesty.
Give me the ability to persevere, cause me to persevere, cause me to know where you're taking me, so that when the fires increase, my vision can be sharper and better.
Father, I receive strength, no matter what turbulence will come, whatever storms will rise.
I am anchored in you, I shall not be moved, I am planted in you, I shall not be moved, I shall not be shaken.
Holy Spirit, hold me up, sustain me, O Lord, that my feet will remain on solid ground.
Father, I will testify, even in this situation I already have a testimony.
Father, I will not drown here, I will not end here, this is not my end, this is my elevation.
In Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For My Identity in Christ
segments: In the name of Jesus, in the mighty name of Jesus, Father, I thank you for the gift, the gift of sonship, that I belong to you.
Not by my own declaration, not by my own decision, but by your own divine word, by your own divine counsel, you chose me to belong to you.
Lord Jesus, I want to know you so that I may know me.
I have walked for so long with the wrong identity, I have walked for so long with the wrong name.
Lord, forgive me for taking on the wrong identity.
Father, forgive me, oh Lord, for every word that I spoke against myself.
Father, in the name of Jesus, help me, open my eyes by your spirit that I may indeed know who I am.
Today I refuse, but today I will look at myself through your eyes and I will know myself through your word.
Father, renew my mind, renew my mind, oh God, so that I would not see myself through circumstance, but I would see myself through your word.
Father, I reject a carnal mind, today by the spirit of God I receive the mind of Christ.
Every mentality of defeat, every thought of failure, every thought of rejection from you, Father, I cast it down.
Every insecurity I pull down, every fear I pull down, every limiting belief I pull down.
Every voice that will come against my sonship, I silence it now.
Every fear, every intimidation, Father, every low self-esteem, be broken off of me in the name of Jesus.
Father, I return to self, God, I receive my sonship as you have put your seal upon me.
I am not confused about who I am.
I know I am crucified with Christ, and I know that it is Christ that lives through me.
I am not only a child of God, I am also a son of God.
I am a coheir with Christ, what you have given to him, you have also given to me.
Father, today I believe and I receive what the Lord Jesus has done for me.
Father, because of him, Lord, I am accepted, I am forgiven, I am righteous, I am holy.
I am seated with Christ Jesus in heavenly places, above principalities and powers.
The old has passed away, I am a new creation in Jesus.
Father, today I know I am blessed, today I know I am favored, today I know I am yours.
Father, thank you that I know who I am.
Father, never allow me, Lord, to ever forget who I am.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Prayer of Repentance
segments: Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I humble myself before you.
I come before the throne of grace, that I may receive mercy.
Father, be merciful unto me, I am struggling, you are my only help.
Today, oh Lord, this evening, oh Lord, this second, this minute, forgive me of all my sins.
I have sinned against you with my actions, with my heart, with my words.
I have sinned against you consciously, I have also sinned against you unconsciously.
All my ways before you have been wrong, oh my Lord and my God.
Please forgive me for my disobedience, for my stubbornness, and every immoral act and impurity.
I repent of every iniquity, I repent of every sin, everything that I have done.
You know all the secret things, nothing is hidden before you, my life is naked before you.
Lord, I am sorry for hurting you, for grieving you, for grieving your spirit.
Oh Lord Jesus, have mercy on my soul.
Lord Jesus, have pity on me, I am a sinner, I have walked the wrong way.
Father, I thank you that no sin is greater than the cross.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray that you forgive me of every sin, you will cleanse me and purify me.
Take all iniquity from me by reason of the blood of Jesus.
Let every trace of sin, let the root of sin's power in my life, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Let it be dismantled in the name of Jesus.
Separate my sin from me, like the east to the west.
Father, cleanse me now according to your tender mercies and your loving kindness.
I repent of those ways; I do not desire to go back to them.
Help me to stand upright; save me, O Lord, rescue me, O Lord.
Lord Jesus, sanctify me, purify me.
Father, I thank you that by your words my conscience is purified.
I am even divorced from iniquity.
The guilt of sin will no longer follow me.
The effects of sin are out of me, because of your grace, because of your mercy.
Thank you for forgiving me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Purity and Victory over Temptation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I cry for purity today.
Sanctify me, O Lord, purify me, O Lord.
Mold me and shape me into the image of your son Jesus.
Remove all impurities from me.
Every thought that is controlling my actions, Father, take it away from me today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, purify my mind, purify my soul, purify my body.
Father, in the name of Jesus, save me from temptation.
Save me from every trap of the enemy.
Father, from this day forward, I curse every plan of the enemy, I curse every plan of the enemy, I curse every plan of the enemy in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, from this day forward, may I never fall victim to the plans of the enemy.
Father, I don't want to lose anymore, I want to win for your glory, an overcomer of the flesh, an overcomer of the ways of the world, an overcomer of fleshly mentalities.
Father, by your spirit, help me to overcome the flesh.
Father, deliver me from evil, visible evil, hidden evil.
No demon, no spirit, no principality, no devil will be able to resist me because of the spirit of the living God.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I desire to be purified, I desire to be sanctified.
May the root of any sin within me, may it be uprooted.
May sin's power lose its power in the mighty name of Jesus.
Today I receive power to resist every devil, to resist every demon, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am immune to falling.
I am immune to temptation in the mighty name of Jesus.
When I stumble I will not fall, when tempted I will not succumb.
In the mighty name of Jesus, I bind all that is evil, I bind all that is unclean, I bind all that is unrighteous.
I ascend into total holiness.
Holy Spirit, purify me, sanctify me, that everywhere I go, everywhere that I am, may every impurity be removed in the name of Jesus, that devils and demons will not have a place.
Give me the ability to remain in your holiness, to walk in holiness.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Prayer of Salvation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the gift of salvation that you have given to all men.
Whoever will confess the Lord Jesus, whoever will call on the name of the Lord, they shall be saved.
Lord, I want you; I choose you.
I am not choosing you because I'm afraid of hell, I'm not choosing you because I don't want to be in hell, I am choosing you because I love you.
And you loved me first.
I have sinned against you, I have disgraced your law, I have gone against your will.
But your love is greater than my mistake.
You provided the cross to restore me.
Lord Jesus, forgive my sins, cleanse me, purify me.
Father, I pray, may you come into my heart.
Fill me with your spirit and lead me from today.
Give me a repentant heart, give me a heart that is ready to turn away from sin.
Holy Spirit, I invite you to walk with me and to change me.
Grant me eternal life today, that I may be with you forever.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I give you my life, Father, my life belongs to you.
You are my Lord, and you are my Savior, you are my Redeemer.
Lord Jesus, I depend on you today, I recommit my life to you.
Father, I thank you that at the feet of your cross I am redeemed.
Because of the cross, I have a guarantee of salvation.
Father, today in the name of Jesus, I receive my portion in you, I receive the forgiveness of sin.
I belong to Jesus.
I belong to the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
Lord Jesus, thank you for saving me, thank you for forgiving me, thank you for rescuing me.
I will follow you for the rest of my life, even into eternity.
Sustain me by your grace, because on my own I cannot.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For the Fire of the Holy Spirit
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I know by your spirit there is a greater place I should operate from.
Lord, I want your spirit to be upon me.
Forgive me for putting out my flame.
Lord Jesus, I want to burn again.
Oh my Father, baptize me with fire.
Baptize me in the fire that cannot be quenched.
Holy Spirit, I need you.
Father, as an open vessel, fill me with your spirit, fill me to the overflow.
Holy Spirit, come upon me, Holy Spirit, rest upon me, Holy Spirit, move within me.
I don't want to be a seasonal Holy Spirit person.
I want to be an everyday, every minute Holy Ghost person.
Consuming fire, consuming fire, consume me today.
Let every work that is not of the spirit be consumed by your fire.
Whatever is in me that is not from you, may it be destroyed now.
Father, let your fire burn in my soul, let your fire burn over me from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet.
Father, set me on fire.
Father, clothe me with your fire.
Make me a flame of fire.
May I burn for you, Jesus.
Cause me to burn with a desire and a hunger that can never be quenched.
By your spirit, set me ablaze, cause me to burn in the realms of prayer.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive the power of the Holy Spirit.
I want to walk with the power of the Holy Spirit.
In the mighty name of Jesus, nothing will quench the fire of the Holy Spirit in me.
No matter what the situation, the fire of the spirit shall burn.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Hunger and Intimacy with God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your grace, I thank you for your mercy.
Thank you for your love, your love that has drawn me close, your love that has given me access to you.
Thank you for drawing me closer to you.
Forgive me for being okay with just being regular, with being okay with just salvation.
Lord, I am praying, forgive me first for stopping to hunger.
Reignite my hunger for you, remove me from my comfort zone.
Father, I thirst for you.
Father, I hunger for you.
May my hunger today and my thirst be quenched, but let me not be satisfied; may I continue to chase after you.
Holy Spirit, cause me to thirst for you like I have never before.
Nothing can satisfy me except your presence.
Father, give me a hunger for your presence.
Father, I just want to be where you are.
Draw me by your spirit.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that my intimacy with you will go deeper and will become greater.
I want to walk with you close, like the Lord Jesus did while he was on the earth.
Father, I want more of you.
I want less of me, but more of you.
Lord Jesus, I want an encounter; Father, I need an encounter; I want to see you.
Lord, I receive a new encounter.
I want to hunger for you, I want to thirst for you; Lord Jesus, stir up my spirit today.
Father, I want your presence.
May I become a house of worship, that your presence remains upon me.
Oh Lord my God, baptize me in your presence again.
Don't send me from your presence without your presence.
In Jesus' mighty name, amen.

title: For a Strong Prayer Life
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I come back to you.
Father, I come back to you and I ask you, restore me within yourself.
Holy Spirit, hold my hand, I depend on you.
In the name of Jesus, that thing that took my prayer life, that thing that has dried up my prayer life, in the name of Jesus Christ, I strip it now.
My spiritual life shall be strong again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, ignite my spirit, baptize me by fire.
Remove procrastination of prayer, remove laziness in prayer.
Baptize me with a spirit of prayer.
Holy Spirit, stir up my spirit, that I may become a person of prayer.
My body is your temple; if you dwell in me, then I ought to pray.
Oh Lord Jesus, cause the spirit of prayer to be upon me, cause the hunger of prayer to be in me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my fire to pray.
Increase my capacity to tarry in your presence.
Lord, today, revive my inner man.
Lord, when you push me to pray, I will pray.
By your spirit, set me ablaze, cause me to burn in the realms of prayer.
That when I pray, it will be like a burning furnace, that demons will flee.
Holy Spirit, cause me to enter into the realms of prayer.
May my prayer be heard in heaven.
My tongue has been empowered, my tongue has been fortified, whatsoever I shall speak shall not fall to the ground.
Lord Jesus, by your spirit, teach me how to pray, reveal to me the mysteries of prayer.
May the spirit of prayer be established in me.
Nothing will quench the fire of the Holy Spirit in me; no matter what the situation, the fire of the spirit shall burn.
In Jesus' mighty name, amen.

title: For Spiritual Sight and Discernment
segments: Father, I pray in the name of Jesus.
Father, touch my spirit today, and make me alive once more.
Renew a right spirit within me, that I may walk after you.
Remove the heart of stone, give me a heart of flesh, in the name of Jesus.
Father, give me a seeing heart, Father, give me a hearing heart, Father, give me an understanding heart.
Let me hear according to your spirit, let my own opinion be put out of the way.
Father, open my eyes that I may see as you see.
I refuse to see as men see.
Holy Spirit, help me to know the hearts of those around me, both evil and good.
Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the spirit of discernment, that I may know what is of the soul and what is of the spirit.
Father, I don't want what seems right; I want to know what is right.
Let the spirit of discernment, the spirit of wisdom and revelation, be manifest within me, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Open my eyes that I may see the devices of the enemy.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my spiritual eyes, that nothing the enemy does will be unnoticed.
Father, in the name of Jesus, open my eyes to see your people.
Give me discernment to know those who are sent for me.
It is your voice that directs me, it is your voice that leads me.
Father, open my ears to hear your voice.
Lord, reveal what you have for me by your spirit; I have not received the spirit of this world, I have your spirit living in me.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that you will reveal the hidden secrets of my life.
Every kind of blindness, spiritual blindness, soulish blindness, physical blindness, in the mighty name of Jesus, I bind it and I rebuke it.
Father, give me a hearing heart, and give me an obedient heart, a heart that will obey you.
Your word says it this way, a spiritual man knows the things that God has given, a spiritual man can discern spiritual things.
Today, by the spirit of discernment, I know what is mine.
Today, by the spirit of discernment, I know the blessings you have ordained for me.
I shall no longer be blind, but I will know and discern your will.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Dreams and Visions from God
segments: Father, give me the ability to dream.
Give me the ability to see visions with the inner eye again.
Where there was times that were difficult, O Lord, and I lost my vision and I lost my dream, restore it again unto me, O Lord.
Let the inner eye be lightened, O God.
I redeem every lost dream.
May I dream dreams, may I see visions opened and closed.
Give me the ability to dream, that I may receive your instruction.
Every spirit that has hindered me from dreaming or stealing my dreams where I cannot remember, I cancel it in the name of Jesus.
Lord, let your instructions that are hidden within me be revealed to me in a dream or a vision of the night.
I know you have already spoken today by your spirit.
Make me aware of what you already spoke.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that my ability to remember your instructions, my ability to remember your direction, will be so activated in me that I will not miss what you have for me.
Lord, strengthen me and revive the realm of dreams for me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let me be elevated, that the skill of dream interpretation will indeed be in me.
The Lord will give me the grace to understand my dreams and to receive interpretation for them.
Help me to understand what you are saying.
Father, you are the God who reveals; give me revelation with details, and give me the ability to comprehend it.
Every vision that is from darkness, that is from the evil one, I arrest it.
I receive discernment to distinguish between that which is of God and that which is of darkness.
In the name of Jesus, I will see visions of God.
My visions will be born of the spirit.
What I shall see shall come to pass.
May I see visions of the spirit; may I see visions of God.
Every dead vision is being revived in the name of Jesus.
The dreams and the visions that you placed on the inside of me, they will not die, but they will live and come to fruition.
I will dream again.
I will dream again.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For a Fresh Anointing
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, thank you for the anointing.
Father, I failed to recognize the anointing that has been on my head.
But today I recognize it, today I am reminded of it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, have mercy on me.
Let the blood of Jesus speak on my behalf today.
Father, I make room for the oil that will descend upon me.
Father, I empty myself.
Father, I desire fresh oil.
Replenish the oil upon my head.
Where my oil dried up, Father, refill it.
Let it run from the crown of my head even unto my feet.
Fresh oil upon my head, fresh grace upon my head, fresh anointing upon my head.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I am ready for fresh oil, I am ready for a fresh anointing for the next dimension of my life that begins right now.
Father, in the name of Jesus, anoint me today for your own glory.
For I no longer want to do things in my strength, God, but by your anointing.
May your anointing unlock my understanding.
God, increase my capacity so I will carry your presence.
Father, in the name of Jesus, let your power rest on me and let it be permanent.
Let it never lift again.
My father and my God, let yokes in my life be broken because of the anointing.
Because of the anointing, let every limitation be broken.
Because of the anointing, let every stagnancy be broken.
Father, let your oil activate who you made me to be before the foundations of the world.
Father, let your oil rest on me, let your oil come on me, let your oil remain with me.
I receive fresh oil.
From today, my life will never be the same.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Church and Nation
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, your word says the earth is the Lord's and all those who are in it.
