Your word says the meek shall inherit the earth, I know this land is my inheritance.
As long as I am here, Lord, bless this nation, bless our nation.
Forgive my sins, forgive me where I have turned away from you.
I pray for mercy and forgiveness for even those who have walked away from you.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus that you by your own spirit will bring peace, you will stabilize the country that I am in for your own sake.
I pray for wisdom and understanding for our leaders, I pray for wisdom and understanding for all those who are in power.
Father, I pray that unity will come into this country and that people will know that we agree on more than we disagree on.
Father, I pray for the future of the nation, Satan is after our children.
But today, as I represent everyone in this nation, every family in this nation, I secure the children.
No plan of the wicked one shall prosper upon them.
I cover them under the protection of the blood of Jesus.
I come against any form of calamity, I destroy every work of the enemy in the mighty name of Jesus.
I build the hedge of protection around the cities in the mighty name of Jesus.
I decree and declare that the spirits that control my nation will bow when I mention Jesus.
Principalities and powers, evil and wicked spirits, submit to the authority of God in the name of Jesus.
I lift your church as well, that your word, as it comes forth, will come and accomplish what you have sent it to do.
Lord, let your light be a beacon in this city, in this state.
My father and my God, may this church be the preservation, the salt and the light of this city and this nation.
May this house cause souls to come from everywhere in the world to be saved, to be restored, to be delivered and to be prophetically directed.
Preserve this nation even unto your coming, protect your people within this nation.
As long as your people are in this nation, may the economy never fail, for the sake of your people.
Father, for the sake of your children that are in this nation, I decree and declare souls will come to Jesus.
The nation will know Jesus, the nation will submit to Jesus, the nation will chase after Jesus.
By the spirit of Jesus, I speak into the womb of my nation.
You will come back to God, you will find Jesus again.
There will be a great harvest of souls unto the kingdom of God.
Our nation is blessed in the name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My Words and Confession
segments: My father and my God, only you possess life-giving words.
Father, I desire to speak spiritual words that give life.
I repent, Father, for speaking the things that I felt like and not by faith speaking your word.
Wherever I have spoken untrue words, wherever I have been a false witness, Lord, today I come before you in repentance, have mercy on me.

Where my mouth has been caught in gossip, where I have entertained the wrong conversation, where I have entertained the wrong things, Father, purify me, sanctify me, cleanse me from every contamination in the name of Jesus.
I let go of every single bitterness, I let go of every pain, I let go of every bitterness, I let go of every pain, that positive words and life-giving words will proceed from me.
Father, purify my lips, that power may proceed undefiled from my mouth.
Father, I cancel every negative word that proceeded from me.
Let it be erased from the spirit and also in the physical.
May there be no trace to those words any longer.
Every word of delay, I cancel it, every word of failure, I cancel it, every word of lack, I cancel it.
Every word of failure, may it lose its power because of the blood of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, touch my lips with a coal from your altar.
Oh Holy Spirit, as you did it for Isaiah, do it also for me.
May my lips be redeemed from the past.
Father, I pray, by your fire, purify my lips, that life may proceed from it.
Father, anoint my lips, anoint my tongue.
Father, give me new words today.
Remove the evil words that were within me, put new words within me.
Help me today to respond to your word and never to the enemy's word.
Father, establish my words.
May my mouth be filled with your words and your decrees.
I decree and declare oil upon my lips, anointing upon my lips, the power of God upon my tongue.
I will speak words of life.
Truth will be found on my lips.
From today, not one word that I speak shall fall to the ground.
Every word I speak is a sword that establishes me in the purpose of God for my life.
Every word that I speak shall come to pass, in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: When I Am Spiritually Dry
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive grace.
Lord, ignite me again, fire me up again.
Father, forgive me for letting my devotion to die out, my dedication to die out.
By your spirit, revive me.
May the spirit of Jehovah enter me.
In the name of Jesus, I will not dry up, in the name of Jesus, whatever I touch is blessed.
May the spirit of death, the spirit of dryness be broken over me and my family in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I refocus myself today, but I know I cannot do it of my own strength.
Anything in me that is not of God, come out now in the name of Jesus.
Father, let your fire consume whatsoever is not of you.
Father, I set my life ablaze.
Every place that was comfortable, let my heart begin to burn with fire.
So, Father, I ask you now, reignite me.
Restore your spirit in me, restore the hunger for your presence in me.
I want to hunger for you, I want to thirst for you.
Lord Jesus, stir up my spirit today.
Father, I am ready, reveal yourself, show yourself, express yourself.
Holy Spirit, rest upon me, Holy Spirit, overshadow me.
Make me alive today, fill me with your spirit, fill me with your strength.
May my hunger today and my thirst be quenched, but let me not be satisfied, may I continue to chase after you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my days of dryness are gone.
Father, no more dryness today.
Father, as oil never dries, I will never dry in the name of Jesus.
I will not dry up in this season.
Dryness is eradicated from my life.
Father, I am empowered by the spirit of the living God.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Consecrating Myself to God
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, today I surrender to you.
By the precious blood of Jesus, you have given me a way to purity.
Father, today I surrender my heart.
Whatever I am still holding on to, Lord Jesus, I release it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I desire to be purified, I desire to be sanctified.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, may I be purified, may I be sanctified from every stain of sin.
May that root that makes me to fall, Father, may it be removed from me.
Father, help me today, Lord, let sin lose its power on me.
May the patterns of sin be broken in me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, purify me today, sanctify me today, that I may be useful in your hands.
May my hands be clean today.
Sanctify my heart, purify my heart, that I may see as you see, that I may walk as you walk.
Purify my mind, purify my soul, purify my body.
Father, sanctify me for your use.
Father, purify me for your use.
Make me a vessel of honor today.
Mold me and shape me into the image of your son Jesus.
Do with me what you desire, oh Lord my God.
I want to be all you want me to be.
Lord my God, I want to see you, I want to walk with you.
Finish your work in me in the mighty name of Jesus.
Because your oil is upon me, I am consecrated.
God has separated me for himself.
I am set apart from the foundations of the earth.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am not my sin, I am not a sinner, I am not ashamed, I am redeemed, I am sanctified, I am purified.
No sin will hinder me from what God has for me.
May I start afresh with you in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Take Communion
segments: Father, I thank you in the name of Jesus that your body was given for me.
Lord Jesus, I thank you for your body that was broken for my sake.
Father, I thank you for your blood, the blood of your son Jesus, that was shed for me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I am a member of your body.
In you there is no sickness, in you there is no death.
Father, in the name of Jesus, as I partake of your body, I see myself restored.
Healing is my portion, restoration is my portion.
As I partake of your body, may I break out of every grave, may I break out of every coffin, may I break out of every limitation.
Because I am a member of your body, I cannot remain in the grave.
As I am joined to your body, let everything of self die, but let the life of Christ also manifest in my flesh.
The body of Jesus was broken for me, let my body be put together.
Let there be no sickness in my body, let there be a purification, let there be a sanctification from every evil.
Father, I am not partaking of symbols of your body, I am partaking of your body, that your life may be in me.
May your life be in me, Lord Jesus.
My Father and my God, as I partake of this cup, your word says life is in the blood.
As I take this, let the life of my Lord Jesus Christ, let it flow through me.
Let every iniquity, every addiction, any kind of bondage, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let any demonic attack, any demonic affiliation, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let it be broken.
By your blood, I have overcome every work of the enemy.
Sorcery, witchcraft, occultic powers, I have overcome because of the blood of the Lamb.
The blood of Jesus has liberated me, it has cleansed me, it has purified me.
And the blood of Jesus speaks on my behalf.
Because of your blood I am redeemed, and because of your blood redemption is my portion.
As I partake of this, I am entering into a new life.
Lord, as I partake of this, I am established in the work of the cross.
As I partake of this cup, I am walking in victory.
Let it be so now, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: When I Fast
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I look to you because you are my strength.
My strength comes from you, the power within me comes from you.
Father, give me the grace to be strengthened throughout this fast.
Father, that your grace will sustain me all the way to the last day.
I will not fall off in the middle.
But I will receive every blessing that you have ordained for me to receive through this fast.
All that needs resurrection will receive resurrection because of your grace that is available for me.
Father, I receive grace for this fast.
Where I am weak, where even my body can feel weakened, Father, I receive grace.
Father, for where I am weak, your strength is mine, where I am weak, your strength sustains me.
Father, let pride be removed from me, that I may receive your blessing.
Anywhere I have been deceived in false humility, today I come out of that false humility.
Father, let me humble myself in truth and in spirit.
I submit myself under your mighty hand, that you would lift me up.
Oh Lord my God, do unto your servant as you desire.
You are the potter and I am the clay.
I surrender myself in your hands, I give myself to you.
Lord Jesus, I want to know you, so that I may know me.
I want to know what you call me.
Father, help me today by your spirit.
Father, I receive more grace today, I receive new mercies today.
May your mercy speak for me, oh Lord Jesus.
I thank you that this petition is granted.
I thank you that you have enlarged me and you have kept me from grief.
Father, as I have begun with you, Father, I will finish with you.
I will finish strong because of grace, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Activating My Gifts and Calling
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, stir up my spirit once again.
Father, as I receive the anointing, let there be an activation, let there be a manifestation of the gifting that is within me.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, may I see through my gift.
May I walk through my gift, may I speak through my gift.
Everything that I do, may it be connected to my destiny and to the manifestation of my gift.
Remove every unbelief in me, remove every doubt in me.
May I see as you see me.
Father, I stir up the gifts that are within me, I stir up the gifts that you put inside of me.
Awaken the vision in my heart, awaken the vision in my heart, awaken that dream today, God.
Everywhere that it has been frustrated, everywhere it has been shut down, everywhere it has been quenched, Father, today let it stand back into place.
Father, you have called me to be a solution, you have called me to be an answer.
You have called me to be the expression of your glory, you have called me to be the expression of your voice, you have called me to be the expression of your power.
Every word that is lying dormant, oh God, that you spoke unto me, God, let it be activated.
Lord, remove the things that have quenched my spirit.
Father, let rivers of living waters break forth from my spirit.
Any kind of barrier in my mind, in my heart, that is holding me back from total surrender to you, Father, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
Father, I receive the gift of faith.
Where there was fear, let faith arise.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the activation.
From today I will walk in my gift, I will walk in my calling, I will walk in my purpose.
I will no longer walk according to my own understanding.
Father, may you empower me, may you equip me, may you activate me, oh God.
Continually uplift me by your spirit, that everything I do will be driven by purpose.
Those giftings will transform the life of my family, those giftings will transform the life of my friends, those giftings will transform the life of my children.
Father, from today I will no longer look to the left or to the right in comparison.
But Lord, I would hold fast to the gift in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Grace
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I realize today that your love for me is too great, that it is beyond my understanding.
Father, I understand today that my success is not based on my strength, is not based on my ability, but it is based on you who gives grace.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, transform my heart, change the posture of my heart, that I may learn how to honor, that I may grow in grace.
Unless I am humble, unless I walk in humility, I can never grow beyond where I am.
I choose the place of humility, that you may glorify yourself by pouring more grace on me.
Father, I desire more grace, not for my benefit, but for your glory.
My Lord and my God, I present myself before you, because it is only by your grace, by your power, that I am able to become all that you have ordained for me to be.
Father, in the name of Jesus, increase my vessel today, let grace upon my life multiply.
Expand me beyond my understanding, that I may be able to carry more of you.
I receive the grace that was upon the apostles, and I receive the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The multiplicity of grace is upon me, and I will never be the same.
Father, in the name of Jesus, more grace upon me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for an abundance of grace, that even when I fail, because of your grace it will spring me back into your will.
May your grace be my clothing, may your grace be my covering.
Father, I cannot grow beyond the grace that you have placed in me.
Lord, I surrender myself to that grace, may your grace in me grow.
May I walk in the grace that you have bestowed upon me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive fresh grace, grace to see you, grace to walk with you, grace to know you, grace to go higher in you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive grace for the impossible.
I receive grace for the impossible concerning my family, I receive grace for the impossible concerning my children, I receive grace for the impossible for the call on my life.
Father, may your grace travel with me today, Father, may your grace travel with me in every endeavor that I will ever have.
Father, may your grace work for me.
Fresh grace upon my head, fresh oil upon my head, fresh anointing upon my head.
Wherever I go, grace will follow me, grace is my portion.
Grace and mercy shall follow me, because it is my portion, in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For an Obedient Heart
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I submit myself to your will.
I submit myself to your wisdom, I submit myself to you, because you are the anchor of my life.
Holy Spirit, lead me, guide me, show me the way, I surrender to your lordship.
Father, I surrender my ways.
Father, I relinquish my ways, I relinquish my understanding.
Father, help me to hear your voice.
Father, today I correct disobedience in my life.
I correct disobedience in my bloodline.
Let every disobedience be corrected today.
May the spirit of obedience come upon me.
Father, remove a stony heart from me.
Father, give me a new heart, and put a new spirit within me, and fill me with your spirit, that I may do of your good pleasure.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, may I be purified.
Every carnality in my life, I surrender it to you.
May I receive the mind of Christ, that I may be obedient to your law, that I may follow your instructions.
I reject carnality, I reject stubbornness, I reject rebellion.
I reject it in the name of Jesus.
Father, I am choosing today to lay myself down before you, that whatsoever you will require of me, whatsoever you will demand of me, I will do it.
I will not resist you, I will not fight against your will.
Let your thoughts become my thoughts, and let your ways become my ways.
Finish your work in me, oh Lord.
I will no longer stand in the way, Lord.
Do your will in my life, manifest your will in my life.
I will serve you all the days of my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For the Fear of the Lord
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I humble myself before you.
May the spirit of the fear of the Lord be upon me.
That I may know you, that I may walk with you, that I may experience you.
May the awe of God come upon me.
May the fear of God come upon me.
Father, stimulate my inner man with revelations of heaven, that, Lord, I may receive of you what you predestinated for me.
Father, have mercy on me, forgive me of my sins, sanctify me, purify me, restore me according to your desires.
Forgive me where I failed you, forgive me where I walked against you.
Father, I love you, you are holy and you are beautiful, there is none like you.
Oh Father, I lift my hands in adoration to you.
Remove all impurities from me, every hurt and pain that is within me, Father, take it away from me today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, purify my mind, purify my soul, purify my body.
Lord Jesus, I want to please you, teach me how to please you.
Father, I want to have good intentions, I want to have a good heart, I want to have an attitude that is pleasing unto you.
Father, help me to walk in purity, Holy Spirit, help me to walk in purity.
Father, help me now to walk in the fear of the Lord.
Father, your spirit, may it take charge of me, take charge of my entire being.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I need wisdom today, because I want to know you.
I want to walk on your path, reveal your ancient paths to me.
I want to know you, I want to fear you.
Lord my God, I want to see you, I want to walk with you.
Father, in the name of Jesus, all glory and honor belongs to you.
My Lord and my God, I set my eyes on you, Lord Jesus.
The fear of God is upon me.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Against Pride
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I choose today to walk in humility.
I realize today truthfully and genuinely that I have gone the wrong way.
Father, in the name of Jesus, today I strip myself of everything that is of self, any selfish ambition in me, the ones that I can see and the ones that I cannot.
Father, lift me up today, I choose to humble myself, I choose to be of service, I choose to be a servant, I choose to be an instrument, I choose to be a vessel.
Father, help me to examine my heart, cause me to know my heart, that I may do right before you.
May your sword, which is your word, help me to discern my own heart, that I may see myself genuinely and see what I need to let go of.
Father, remove the desire to have glory and fame and fortune, remove the desire for me to be a show-off, to show that I am used by God.
Father, I don't want any kind of vain glory, I don't want that, I only want to please you.
Father, remove out of me everything that is not pleasing to you, everything that is of self.
Restore me in my spiritual journey when it was pleasing to you, before I added to myself what did not come from you.
Father, help me today to be equally yoked with you, help me, oh Lord my God, to take upon myself your yoke.
I make a decision to be humble, help me, give me the grace to do it.
I am before your grace, I humble myself before your mercy.
May your light reveal all the false doctrines that have been in my mind, that, Lord, I may walk uprightly before you.
I want to mirror your son, Jesus.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, make me a true servant.
Lord Jesus, I give myself totally unto you.
I accept the changes that you will bring, because it's to make me better, I accept your chastisement, I accept your correction.
Give me meekness today, give me humility today.
Lord, I position myself today in the place of humility, that you may increase the grace over my life.
I choose the place of humility, I make myself of no reputation.
Father, position me in the place of humility, that I may grow in grace.
Help me, Father, to be clothed and dressed in humility.
I want to be in a posture, in a position of humility.
I choose to walk in divine humility.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For Angelic Help
segments: Father, thank you for the ministering spirits that you have made available to my life.
Thank you, Father, for the angels that you have surrounded me with.
Thank you for every angel that has gone before me, that has protected me when I didn't know.
Lord, I thank you for this great privilege, I thank you for this great grace, this amazing mercy, that you have sent your angels to minister to me in this year.
Father, I thank you for the banner of the angelic that is around me.
Father, cause me to be sensitive today, sensitive to the angels that you have assigned me.
Help me to be sensitive, Father, to the angels that you have placed in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus, the angels of my assignments, may they go ahead of me, that I may fulfill what you want me to do this year.
May my path be made straight.
Lord, send your angels ahead of me in every area of my life.
Father, send your angels unto me and strengthen me.
Father, let your angels minister unto me.
I pray for the grace that you will hold me by the hands of your angels.
May I walk in the realm of angels.
In the name of Jesus, I activate the angels of favor in every area of my life.
Angels of grace, in the mighty name of Jesus, I activate you now.
I activate the angels of mercy.
Wherever I am going to stumble, may the angels of mercy lift me up.
I activate the angels of goodness, may goodness follow me.
Anything intended for evil, may goodness prevail.
The angels of God are activated in my life, they are activated in my family.
I am secure in Jesus Christ.
Angels will meet me at home, angels will meet me in my place of work.
Whatsoever I do, the angels of God will go ahead of me.
No evil shall befall me, me and my family are protected in the name of Jesus.
I am heavenly defended, I am heavenly protected.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: By Reason of the Blood
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for your blood.
That was for the remission of my sins, that was for my cleansing, and that is for my purification.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the blood of Jesus, because it was spilled for my sake.
I thank you, oh Father, that your blood has been sprinkled in heaven, above all heavens.
Father, I thank you, I am secured by the blood of Jesus.
I was bought by a price, Jesus bought me, Jesus is my Lord, Jesus is my savior.
I announce it before heaven, the earth, the visible and the invisible, I am bought by Jesus, I belong to Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the precious blood of Jesus that is speaking on my behalf right now.
Because of the blood of Jesus, curses are broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, by reason of the power of the blood, I am purified from every sin.
I am sanctified from every deed, I am redeemed from every dead work.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, every demonic covenant has been cancelled.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, the power of witchcraft is broken.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, demons have been silenced.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, generational curses are broken.
Father, in the name of Jesus, by reason of the blood of Jesus, let every satanic covenant, let every demonic attachment, let every demonic covenant, let every demonic union, let it lose its power.
Let it be nullified, let it be cancelled, let it be dissolved in the name of Jesus.
Because of the blood of Jesus, witchcraft will never work on me.
Because of the blood of Jesus, demons have no place in me.
Demons have no place around my family.
All my children are in the blood of Jesus.
Anything and everything connected to me is in the blood of Jesus.
Because of the blood of Jesus, my family is covered.
There is no claim over my life, no claim over my children, no claim over my bloodline.
I have been redeemed by the blood of Jesus.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, I am free, I am redeemed.
Because of the blood of Jesus, victory is mine.
Father, this is the word of my testimony, in Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For a Young Person
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I call upon your name.
Lord, I give you my life.
Fill me with the Holy Spirit.
Lord, help me, that I may be useful in your hands.
Father, use me for your glory.
Father, in the name of Jesus, my strength will fail, my skills can fail.
Father, I understand today that my success is not based on my strength.
It is not based on my ability, but it is based on you who gives grace.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I pray for an abundance of grace.
Even when I fail, because of your grace, it will spring me back into your will.
May your grace be my clothing, may your grace be my covering.
Cause me to go after the dream you place within me, oh Lord.
Father, give me a new beginning with a new life.
Bless me and increase me, never to be in the wrong place again.
You unclean spirit, you have brought addiction into me, you have distorted my life, I am speaking to you by the authority of the Holy Spirit, never come back.
Every evil confession from my lips, let it be cancelled now.
I cancel those negative words and their effects in the mighty name of Jesus.
I am not defeated.
I am not broken, I am not confused, I am not stagnant.
My lips are the pen of a ready writer.
Whatever I declare today is established concerning my life.
I am blessed, I shall succeed.
I decree and declare, my strength shall increase.
I shall not be weak anymore.
In the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For a Student
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you for the activation.
I thank you because of the anointing that from today I will walk in my gift.
I will walk in my calling, I will walk in my purpose, I will no longer walk according to my own understanding.
But Father, I would hold fast to your vision, to your gift that you have given me, the things that you have revealed to me.
Father, as I receive the anointing, let there be an activation, let there be a manifestation of the gifting that is within me.
Father, I pray in the name of Jesus, may I see through my gift.
May I walk through my gift.
May I speak through my gift.
Everything that I do in my studies, may it be connected to my destiny and to the manifestation of my gift.
Remove every unbelief in me.
Remove every doubt in me.
May I see as you see me.
Father, give me the spirit of understanding.
Father, in the powerful name of Jesus, every spirit of bondage, everything that has bound my family, everything that has bound my life, and has put me in the place of debt, may that chain be broken.
Every limitation that I have faced in my studies shall be broken.
May school loans be cancelled.
Father, you called me not to owe anyone anything.
You called me to be free, you chose me to be free, in the mighty name of Jesus.
I break free in the name of Jesus.
I will not repeat the suffering of my ancestors.
The altars of my family are broken.
My doors will be open.
I am already lifted out of the cage the enemy thought he can put me in.
The time for struggle is over, the time for tears is over, the time of limitation is over.
Manifest your glory today, in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For a New Marriage
segments: Father, I thank you in Jesus' name.
Father, thank you for securing me and covering me and blessing this family in the name of Jesus.
The test of my family, the test of my marriage, the test of anything that can be around me is a picture of the blessing that is to come.
Father, make this family wealthy.
Bless this family with wealth, bless them with wisdom, bless them with strength.
May money never be a problem for me.
May my path be made straight.
Whatever has been holding my family, may it be broken.
May what has been holding my destiny be broken.
May what has been holding my finances be broken.
May your angels go before me.
The spirit of anti-marriage struggle is also breaking today in the name of Jesus.
I release the blessing that prospers upon my marriage.
May my roots flourish from today.
May God elevate me to heights I have never been.
May I know his goodness and his kindness in everything that I do.
May the Lord go ahead of me.
May I be strong in every season because everything is working for my good in the mighty name of Jesus.
Today the Lord has lifted up my shame.
The Lord Jesus is giving me a new beginning in my marriage.
I receive a new beginning today.
My doors are already open, my family is restored.
That witchcraft is broken, that enchantment has been dismantled.
I have already entered into the center of the will of Almighty God for my life.
Let it be so in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For My Newborn Child
segments: Father, as I dedicate this child to you today, I thank you for preservation of their life, of their destiny, of their purpose in you, God.
Father, I thank you that you are establishing a covering over my child.
I set this one apart for your kingdom.
I set this one apart, Father, for the purpose that you have already ordained from the beginning.
May my child forever stand in your presence.
May my child forever be secure, may my child forever be preserved.
May my child always find their way to you even when they lose it.
May my child never get into anything that they cannot come out of.
Father, rescue my child, secure my child, hide my child's life in Christ and in you in the mighty name of Jesus.
May my child always have the utterance of the name of Jesus upon their lips.
May angels ascend and descend upon my child.
Give me all that I need to raise this child, give me wealth, give me spiritual understanding.
Give me the mantle of prayer, that I be prayerful.
Every intention of the enemy against this child, let it be reversed now.
I decree and declare by the spirit of the living God, whatsoever the condition is, I reverse it in the name of Jesus.
No demon in any form will appear to me or my child ever again.
Anything that would hold my family back, I break it in the name of Jesus.
I decree and declare good health of my baby.
May healing and restoration be my child's portion.
Sickness and disease is not my child's end.
Sickness and disease is not my child's story.
God does not give me things so that they die.
My child will never know the sufferings I went through, the troubles I went through.
My child will be divinely covered and protected.
Let it be established in the mighty name of Jesus. Amen.

title: For Parents of Teenagers
segments: Father, thank you for my family.
Oh my Lord and my God, you are the God who chose me, who hears me.
I can't save my children, I can't do anything for them, but you, oh Lord, who called them, who chose them, you know everything about them.
Father, help my young ones.
Protect them and guard their life, Lord, in Jesus' name.
Father, protect my young ones, preserve their life.
Cause them, Father, to be planted in your will, that they will not be taken by the waves of the world.
That their lives will be hidden, that they will not waste time, but actually become everything you have called them to be in Jesus' name.
Father, may my young ones be preserved for your glory.
Father, touch my young ones, touch my young ones.
Give them continual clarity, and let this fog leave their minds in Jesus' name.
Father, remove depression and oppression from my children.
In this hour and this moment, I arrest every demonic power, every demon, every devil of sickness, of anxiety, of witchcraft over my children.
May your yokes be broken over me, may it be broken over the adults, may it be broken over the young ones.
May no sorcery prevail in the name of Jesus.
Every altar connected to my children, let it be scattered where it came from, let it catch fire and be destroyed in the name of Jesus.

The powers of witchcraft and sorcery that have held my children from a father's side, from a mother's side, from a father's side, from a mother's side, you evil and bad spirits, you are arrested, you are bound.
Addiction, smoking, let it be broken over this house in Jesus' name.
Every demonic spirit, every demonic power over my children, be thou broken.
Leave my life now, leave my children now, leave my house now, in the mighty name of Jesus.
Whatever is not of God, let it come out of my children in Jesus' name.
Whatever is not born of God, let it come out in Jesus' name.
In the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost, free from self-hate, free from suicidal thoughts, free from failure, in Jesus' name.
Father, touch everyone that is involved in my family, grace them all, let death be far from them in Jesus' name.
Father, help them to be great, send them places, send them all places.
Use my young ones that are willing to be instruments of salvation for many.
All the issues of my family are over.
Thank you, Holy Spirit, in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: For a Turning Point in My Life
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, let today be the day that there is a shift in my mind.
That there is a shift in my soul, that there is a shift in everything that has to do with me.
Father, I want to receive your best, you have ordained the best for me.
Father, I am ready for your best.
Father, I am ready for the shift that you are bringing into my life.
My spirit is ready, my soul is ready.
Father, help me in my season of transition.
Father, help me as I restart, Father, help me as I march forth with what you have given unto me.
Give me grace, Father, give me the courage to restart.
Father, in the name of Jesus, shift me from where I am, take me to another place, a place I have never been.
That I may attain the promise that you have destined for me.
Father, help me to let go of things that are not profitable.
Father, I let go of the old, I let go of the old mind.
Every thought of defeat, I leave it behind, every thought of failure, I leave it behind.
I break the cycle of struggle over my family, I break the cycle of limitation over my family.
Father, every place where there was delay, every place where there was limitation, every place where there was struggle, Father, today I thank you for the shift.
Father, every resistance is broken, every resistance is removed.
Father, let every tide begin to change, let every tide begin to turn in the mighty name of Jesus.
The tide of sickness, the tide of poverty, the tide of confusion, the tide of limitations, let it begin to turn in the name of Jesus.
From today in the name of Jesus, I declare a new beginning, I declare a new path.
I am ready to cross over, out of poverty, out of anxiety, out of limitations.
Father, in the name of Jesus, it is my season for my own shift to come to pass.
It is time for my own turnaround.
In the name of Jesus, my hour has come.
My hour of being shifted has come, my hour of being lifted has come, my hour of being changed has come.
Today is my day of redemption, today is my day of restoration, today is my day of visitation.
From today, my life is changed, from today, my life is shifting.
Nothing in my life will remain the same after today.
Father, with you I cannot fail, Father, with you I have overcome, Father, with you all things are possible, Father, in you I am established.
I am changed, I am transformed, in Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For Strength in Old Age
segments: Father, thank you for long life.
Thank you, Father, for life and life more abundantly.
Thank you, Father, for rejuvenating my body.
Thank you, Father, that strength comes to me now, thank you that my spirit is revived.
Father, in the name of Jesus, revive my spiritual life, revive my physical life.
Wake me up from my slumber today, that I may fulfill what you called me to do.
Father, I receive long life, may I accomplish what you sent me to do.
Give me my heart's desire, that I may see my children's children's children.
Father, use me, Father, use me for your glory.
I cancel every appointment with death, I cancel every assignment of death.
Father, I cancel the spirit of death, this spirit that has been taking people before their time, let it be destroyed in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, today I arrest the power of witchcraft, I arrest the power of sorcery, and I declare freedom and liberty.
No witch can kill me, no sorcery can kill me, no accident will kill me.
Let this death that is looming over me be taken from me in Jesus' name.
Every desire of the enemy will never be accomplished.
I shall live and not die.
I shall not perish, I will not die, I will lay down my life, I will let go of the ghost in God's time.
Long life is my portion, long life is my portion.
The assignment of death over my life is canceled, I will live until my assignment is fulfilled.
The Lord will satisfy me with long life.
I declare life and I declare life in abundance, I declare long life in the mighty name of Jesus.
I will have long life, everything I do will have longevity.
My children will have long life, everything they do will have longevity.
I shall live long in the presence and glory of God.
My hour for rest has come, long life but with rest.
I thank you that today is the beginning of a new life, today is the beginning of destiny, the beginning of new purpose in the name of Jesus.
Father, I decree and declare long life, yes, long life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For a New Land and My Papers
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, my Lord and my God, you destined me for freedom.
It has never been your desire for me to be bound, to be in limitation and frustration.
I am but the seed of my family, I am not only representing myself, I am representing everybody that is connected to me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, have mercy on me.
Jesus Christ, son of David, have mercy on me.
I receive your mercy, I receive your grace.
I receive grace to get to the destination that you have set for me before the beginning of time.
Father, in the name of Jesus, strengthen me today.
I pray for the grace that you will hold me by the hands of your angels.
Father, strengthen my faith, that my faith will not fail.
By the blood of Jesus, every diabolical covenant will be broken today.
By reason of the blood of Jesus, there will be a separation between me and every evil spirit.
You evil spirit, from where you come from, I bind you, I bind you, I bind you.
In the name of Jesus Christ, what you have put upon me, may it be broken now.
Every evil scent around me, let it be removed in the name of Jesus.
I end delay over my papers, as the wind flows, so shall I also, in Jesus' name.
Curse, be broken, break.
Let doors be open that were never opened in my family in the name of Jesus.
Today I receive every benefit, the benefit of my citizenship, I receive it today.
Today is a shift for me, because whatsoever I shall lay my hands on shall prosper.
Things are being rearranged for me right now concerning my papers.
Visas for my family have been released.
The curse is broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Thank you God, I have my papers, it is done.
Everything in my life is going to shift, everything in my life is going to change.
Whatever is of hell will never prevail over my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: For My New Home
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, give me the spirit of revelation, that I may arrive in the perfect place.
Lord, I receive that new house.
Father, I receive this thing for free, because you paid a full price for it and it is mine.
You prepared the land for me, now I am ready to possess it.
Father, in the name of Jesus, strengthen me today for the battles at hand.
Wherever the soles of my feet shall touch, I shall possess it.
In the name of Jesus, every giant will fall, every giant is falling.
I break that curse over my life.
I break that thing over my life.
May where that charm is, may where that witchcraft is, may where those spells were cursed, may it catch fire in the name of Jesus.
May it be destroyed in the name of Jesus.
Father, any link, any attention, any connection that is calling my name for evil, that is calling my name for injustice, that is calling my name for oppression, I disconnect in the name of Jesus.
May that stubborn mortgage be cancelled.
May that rent be cancelled.
Father, you called me not to owe anyone anything.
My family is free in the name of Jesus, and it begins with me.
Freedom for the whole house in the name of Jesus.
God is with me and God is with my house.
I am planted.
May God establish me in the land.
I possess my possession.
My life is defended, and my life is protected, and all that I love is secure in the mighty name of Jesus.
I will see the goodness of God in the land of the living.
My family will see the goodness of God in the land of the living.
There will be nothing missing, there will be nothing lacking.
I receive it in Jesus' mighty name, Amen.

title: For a New Beginning at Work
segments: Father, I thank you for your favor and your grace.
Promotion is coming to me, a new job is coming to me.
I will be established in a new job.
By the anointing that has caused me to recover time, I decree and declare speed in the name of Jesus.
Father, I am ready for everything that you have ordained for me.
Father, I am ready to receive it.
In the name of Jesus, limitation is the thing of the past.
Father, I am ready for the next level, take me to that place now, in the name of Jesus.
Father, in the name of Jesus, a new beginning has begun for me.
I am receiving a new job.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every impurity in my way, every imperfection in my way, in my career and my destiny, in my family, I remove it in the name of Jesus.
Mentally, whatever is holding me back, let it be broken in the name of Jesus.
May the spirit of hardship be broken over my life.
In the mighty name of Jesus, every door in my life, may it be open now.
I remove every gatekeeper.
I remove every gatekeeper that is contending.
These open doors are before me now in the mighty name of Jesus.
In the mighty name of Jesus, doors are opening for me.
I command my doors to be open.
I prophesy my career.
My career is blessed, my destiny is secure.
In the name of Jesus, my territory is being expanded.
In the mighty name of Jesus, my hands are anointed.
Whatever I touch will flourish.
I will never be brought down.
Father, in the name of Jesus, everywhere I set my feet, from today, I possess it, from today, I will succeed in it.
Whatsoever I will declare, let it come to pass in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: Thanksgiving and Gratitude
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus, I thank you with everything that is in me.
Father, I am grateful, Father, I am thankful.
Forgive me, Lord God, for forgetting.
I thank you for your goodness and your mercy.
I thank you for your everlasting love, for your unwavering commitment to me.
Father, I thank you for your grace and your mercy, Father, I thank you for your goodness and your kindness.
Father, I thank you for your eternal deliverance.
Thank you, Father, for the sacrifice of your son Jesus upon the cross for my restoration into relationship with you.
Father, I thank you that you did not spare any expense for my redemption.
Thank you, Father, for the gift of salvation.
Thank you, Father, for the gift of eternal life.
Thank you, Father, for life, I thank you for the breath of life today.
Father, I thank you for preserving my life today, I thank you for covering me today.
I thank you, Father, for where you have brought me from.
I thank you for loving me, God, I thank you for keeping me.
I thank you, Father, for snatching me from the enemy's hand.
Father, thank you that the work of the enemy has been finished in my life, is terminated in my life.
I thank you for every shortcoming, because I know you are in the details.
I understand, oh Lord, that all things work for my good, even when I don't understand it.
Father, you have been good to me, Father, you have shown me your mercy.
Because of the Lord Jesus, I have life, because of the Lord Jesus, I have healing, because of the Lord Jesus, I have deliverance.
Because of the Lord Jesus, I am covered, because of the Lord Jesus, I am going higher, because of the Lord Jesus, I am healed, because of the Lord Jesus, I am blessed.
Father, I thank you that you have answered me.
I thank you for being my God, there's no God like you.
Your praises will always be upon my lips, I cannot stop praising you.
Be glorified now and eternally in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Morning Prayer
segments: Father, I thank you in the name of Jesus for this beautiful morning.
I thank you for your blessing that is upon me, I thank you for your mercy that covers me.
I thank you for your blood that sanctifies and purifies me.
Father, I thank you that today is a new day for me.
You have shown me mercy again, you visited me this morning.
Your word says your mercy is new every morning.
Cleanse me of all unrighteousness and uncleanness.
Take away my sin and iniquity today.
May my yesterday be put away, and give me a new beginning today.
Father, every time I have the breath of life, you have given me another lease to life.
Father, as I present myself before you, I pray that your will will be done today.
Father, do with me a new thing today, do in me a new thing today.
Show me your grace, show me your mercy, set my feet on solid ground.
May your wonders and your works manifest in my life today.
Father, may my heart hear your voice, that I may receive of you.
I thank you that your goodness will go ahead of me.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive this day as the day you have ordained for me.
I receive the best that is in it, because you prepared this day for me.
I thank you above all, Father, that every work of the enemy in my life shall be broken.
Thank you, oh Lord, that the devil is under my feet.
Father, I thank you that you're good, I thank you that today I will be healed, I will be delivered, I will be blessed.
Father, I receive your goodness and your mercy.
I declare your mercy over my life.
This is my day, thank you for my day, thank you for my day, Father.
Today is the day that victory will reign in my life in the mighty name of Jesus, Amen.

title: A Night Prayer
segments: Father, I thank you for your mercy, for your compassion, for your goodness, for your kindness.
I thank you that you never change, you remain the same.
Father, I receive mercy for this evening.
Cleanse me, purify me of every unrighteousness and uncleanness, oh Lord.
Forgive me, Father, where I have missed it.
Father, I am tired, I am weary, I have carried so many burdens, but only you can give me rest.
Father, every burden that I have come with, I cast it on you.
Lord, today I move my heart from worry, I move my heart from anxiety, I keep my eyes on you.
Today I give you all my burdens, today I give you all my struggles, today I give you all my difficulties.
Today I give you all my hardships, today I give you all my confusion, today I give you all my battles.
Father, today I leave everything in your hand.
Bring my soul to the place of rest that is in you.
Let my tears be wiped away, let every conflict even within me be resolved.
Father, restore my soul, may I find peace again.
Father, in the name of Jesus, whatever the enemy is trying to do, even at night when I sleep, let it be cancelled in the name of Jesus.
Everything the enemy is trying to do over my life, over my family, every night while I sleep, I cancel it.
Every charm, every witch, every altar against my life, be broken in the mighty name of Jesus.
Father, I possess the night, I take control of the night, because night and light are the same to you.
I take charge of the darkness the same way I reign in the light.
That same light will shine in the darkness.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I want to enter into your rest.
Lord Jesus, give me a calm spirit, a spirit that understands you, that you have your hand upon me.
No fear shall touch my life, no anxiety shall touch my life.
I rest in you today, I rest in your love, I rest in your grace, I rest in your peace, I rest in you today, Father.
When it comes to my family, when it comes to my destiny, when it comes to my children, when it comes to everything, Father, I look to you.
I receive your rest today.
I declare that tonight is my night of restoration.
I take my sleep in Jesus' name, Amen.

title: Tearing Down a Stronghold
note:
“Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” — John 8:32

Built from the eleven steps taught in part 4 of a teaching series on strongholds, in the series’ own words where it scripts them. The series says to use this method against every stronghold: pray it first, then the prayer for the stronghold you recognise.

Where the prayer names something — the stronghold, what it makes you do, the root it grew from, the people you forgive, the truth that replaces the lie — say it in your own words, or make a copy of this prayer and write the names in. The verse in it is 1 John 1:9.

If you have OCD or unwanted intrusive thoughts, do not turn the daily pushing away or speaking out of thoughts into a ritual; that can feed the compulsion. Pray once, leave it with God, and follow your treatment.

Step 10 says to cut off harmful contacts, even with close family, and to change jobs if needed; with family, boundaries and honour go together, and where there is abuse, safety comes first.

If you have thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life, call 112 (EU), 911 (US) or your local emergency number now. In Poland you can also call 116 123 (24/7); in the US, call or text 988.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I come to You in the name of Jesus.
I will not pretend there is no problem.
I name it before You: this is a stronghold in my life.
Where I have sinned in this, I call it what it is: sin, a twisting of Your truth.
I confess it to You, and I receive Your forgiveness, because You are faithful and just to forgive me and to cleanse me.
In the name of Jesus I drive out, one by one, every evil spirit connected with this stronghold.
I do not let them come back, and I will push them away every day until my way of thinking has changed.
Father, I see the fruit of this stronghold in my life.
In the name of Jesus I curse this fruit; I stop its growth.
I see the root it grew from.
In the name of Jesus I curse this root too, and in faith I command both the behaviour and its root to go.
But Father, I am wounded in these areas.
I bring them to You now, and by faith I receive healing in the name of Jesus.
I forgive everyone who had a part in planting this root.
I release them to You.
Father, in place of every lie I take Your truth.
Draw me into a deep, close relationship with You.
I will say this truth aloud every day, because life and death are in the power of the tongue.
I will live it out at the pace of my faith, without rushing and without delay.
When the old way of thinking knocks again, I will not give up.
If I fall, I will get up, be washed in the blood of Jesus, throw the old thought out by what I say, and confess the right one.
Give me courage to change whatever keeps feeding this stronghold, and to ask for help when I need it.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Freedom from Evil Spirits
note:
“Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.” — James 4:7

Built from the steps taught in part 1 of a teaching series on strongholds for being set free and keeping freedom. Pray it, or “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, before the prayer for the stronghold you recognise.

Where the prayer names something — your problem, your sins, the patterns of sin in your family, each form of the occult, the people you forgive — say it in your own words, or make a copy of this prayer and write the names in. The verse in it is 1 Peter 5:8-9.

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I humble myself before You.
I will be honest with You and name my problem.
I confess my faith in Jesus Christ: He is my Lord, He died for my sins, and You raised Him from the dead.
I confess to You every sin I know of.
I name the patterns of sin in my family, and today I decide to break with them and with my own sin.
I renounce every form of the occult, naming each one before You.
I forgive every person who has hurt me.
I submit myself to You, Father.
Your truth is the final word on who You are, who I am in You, and what I have and can do in You.
And I resist the devil: in the name of Jesus he must flee from me.
Keep me sober, awake and firm in faith.
Keep Jesus at the centre of everything in my life.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: To Receive the Teaching on Strongholds
note:
“Be sober-minded and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour. Resist him, standing firm in your faith.” — 1 Peter 5:8-9

From part 1 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. In the series it is prayed over the listeners at the end of the teaching on Satan and demons; pray it before you read or listen to teaching on strongholds. You ask to receive God’s word, and you test what you hear by Scripture (1 Thessalonians 5:21).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, thank You for Your word.
I bring to You all that I am learning about tearing down strongholds.
In the name of Jesus, help me to receive from it what is Your word.
Let these things be tools put into my hands.
Let every piece of it be processed by my spirit, born again of You.
Arm it with Your power, and let it be a weapon against the demonic forces in my life.
I open my heart to receive a firm foothold of freedom.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Rejection
note:
“He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.” — Isaiah 53:3

From part 2 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

The little foxes that ruin the vineyard are from Song of Songs 2:15.

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: God, my Father, thank You that You love me.
Thank You for Jesus, who died for me, carried all my sin, paid my debt and took away my sense of rejection.
Because I come to You through Jesus, I am not rejected, not unwanted, not on the margins.
I know that You really love me and care about me; I am Your child, and You are my Father.
Lord Jesus, You were rejected so that I could be accepted.
I believe it, even before I feel it.
I repent now of the fruit of rejection in my life, and I forgive every person who rejected me, betrayed me or let me down.
I believe that You have forgiven me, and I believe that You accept me.
I am Your workmanship, so I accept myself.
Father, thank You that You are bringing me to a place where rejection has no influence at all on my life.
Thank You that I am accepted by You, and that all of this comes through Jesus Christ.
He is my power and my strength; in Him I can tear down every work of the enemy in my life.
Catch every little fox that ruins the vineyard, even the smallest fruit of rejection.
Open my eyes to see what has been destroying me.
Holy Spirit, in the name of Jesus I take authority over every demonic force of rejection, over every fruit of rejection, and over every spirit that has produced that fruit.
Spirit of rejection, I bind you and I plunder you; you have no authority over this area of my life, because Christ was rejected so that I would be accepted into God's family.
I do not allow rejection to grow or bear fruit in me.
In the name of Jesus I declare personal freedom from every form of rejection.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: For Light on My Strongholds
note:
“Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ On its return, it finds the house vacant, swept clean, and put in order.” — Matthew 12:44

From part 3 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. In the series it is prayed at the end of the teaching on what demonic strongholds are; pray it when you want to see your own situation clearly.

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, thank You for these words, and that I can hear them.
In the name of Jesus, let the light of Your Holy Spirit fill me now.
I want a deep, clear view of my situation: let me see what a stronghold is, and let it be drawn clearly in me.
From this moment, let Your light shine on me in this.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: For the Word That Sets Me Free
note:
“Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” — John 8:32

From part 4 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. In the series it is prayed at the end of the teaching on how to tear down a stronghold. The method itself is the prayer “Tearing Down a Stronghold”.

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, thank You for this word.
In the name of Jesus, let it reach the depths of my heart and go right through me.
Thank You that it is reaching me now.
In the name of Jesus I declare that no one will destroy what has been spoken to me: it will not be uprooted, but firmly grounded in me.
This word is a weapon; Father, let it serve me.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Strongholds of Instability
note:
“He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.” — James 1:8

From part 5 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

This part’s checklist for the “borderland” closely follows borderline personality disorder, and includes threats of self-harm or suicide. If that is you, tell someone today and contact a doctor or a crisis line. This condition responds well to specialist therapy.

If you have thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life, call 112 (EU), 911 (US) or your local emergency number now. In Poland you can also call 116 123 (24/7); in the US, call or text 988.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I come to You in faith.
I do not agree with any stronghold of instability working in my life, whether the stronghold of impulsiveness or the stronghold of the borderland.
In the name of Jesus I curse every stronghold of instability in me.
Let not one stone of it be left on another; let it be uprooted and torn out.
Let the rejection it lives on be exposed and thrown out of my life.
Holy Spirit, in Your mighty power I decide now to break every stronghold of instability.
Father, I worship You: You are with me, and You have given me complete victory.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Self-Admiration
note:
“Your heart grew proud of your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom because of your splendor; so I cast you to the earth; I made you a spectacle before kings.” — Ezekiel 28:17

From part 6 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

The original line that “there is no ‘I’ left” is replaced here by Galatians 2:20 as written. “You always hear me” borrows Jesus’ words (John 11:42); a believer prays them with the confidence of 1 John 5:14.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, thank You that You always hear me.
Let me see clearly and plainly every sign of self-admiration in my life.
Help me to act and begin tearing this stronghold down.
I stand now against every demonic force of self-admiration.
In the name of Jesus I curse the demonic forces of self-admiration.
I uproot this stronghold in me, and I bind the spirits that are in it.
I do not agree with self-admiration in my life.
I declare: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me.
My old self is no longer on the throne, and I will worship no one but God.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against Perfectionism and Compulsions
note:
“the slander and murmuring of my assailants against me all day long.” — Lamentations 3:62

From part 7 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

The original prayer stops after the opening thanks; the rest is completed from this part, which names fear, law and control among the forces of this stronghold.

If unwanted thoughts — blasphemous, violent or sexual — keep coming and horrify you, that is a well-known symptom of OCD, not proof of a demon, and it responds well to treatment. Pray this prayer once and leave it with God; repeating a prayer again and again to “undo” a thought can feed the compulsion.

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Good Father, thank You for this word, and thank You for this revelation.
Where perfectionism or compulsions have a hold on me, I bring them to You.
I do not have to earn Your love or keep everything under control; Jesus has finished the work.
In the name of Jesus I refuse the fear, the control and the law of earning that this stronghold lives on, and I put my trust in You.
Give me Your peace in place of checking and repeating, and lead me to the help I need.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Paranoia
note:
“A rich man’s wealth is his fortified city; it is like a high wall in his imagination.” — Proverbs 18:11

From part 8 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

This part says a person with this stronghold finds it very hard to see it alone, so ask someone you trust to help. Strong, fixed suspicion or beliefs that others cannot shake can be signs of a treatable condition; see a doctor.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Dear Father, thank You that these words could be spoken to me.
Father, I pray now in the name of Jesus, before Your throne: I curse every stronghold of paranoia in my life.
In the name of Jesus I undermine this stronghold, and I bind the demonic beings that are in it.
In the name of Jesus Christ I am set free from the influence of the stronghold of paranoia.
Holy Spirit, let these words go right through me.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Antisocial Stronghold
note:
“For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.” — Psalm 36:2

From part 9 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

Where you have harmed or cheated others, confess it, make it right and accept the consequences (Luke 19:8). If you fear you may hurt someone, get help today. This part also names damage to the nervous system as one possible cause, which needs a doctor.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, thank You for Your word; help me to receive it.
Father, I pray now in the name of Jesus: let the power of Your Holy Spirit go right through me.
Thank You that You always hear me.
Where I recognise the antisocial stronghold in myself, I strike it with all the power of Your Holy Spirit.
Father, I curse the antisocial stronghold in my life.
Protect me, so that the demonic forces of aggression and lies do not lead me astray or bring me to destruction.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Dependence
note:
“This is what the LORD says: ‘Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes the flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.’” — Jeremiah 17:5

From part 10 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

This part separates gentleness and self-denial, which are good, from a dependence that buries every need and fears every disagreement. The verse that follows is the promise: “But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him” (Jeremiah 17:7). If you depend on someone who controls or abuses you, your safety comes first.

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I pray in the name of Jesus: let the power of Your Holy Spirit go right through me.
Holy Spirit, let Your presence fill me now.
Help me to see, and to judge my situation clearly.
Where I recognise the stronghold of rejection or the stronghold of dependence in myself, I stand against it with all the strength of the Holy Spirit who is in me, and I break it down.
Make me bold to stand against it.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Acting
note:
“So Amnon lay down and feigned illness.” — 2 Samuel 13:6

From part 11 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Dear Father, thank You for these words.
Thank You for wisdom and understanding, and that You are a God who reveals mighty things to me.
Father, where I live under the influence of the stronghold of acting, I curse it.
I do not agree with this kind of stronghold working in my life or in Your church.
In the name of Jesus I uproot it.
Holy Spirit, stir me up to receive revelation from You, to take hold of Your power and to break these demonic forces in the name of Jesus. Amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Isolation
note:
“He who isolates himself pursues selfish desires; he rebels against all sound judgment.” — Proverbs 18:1

From part 12 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

One word about the demons is lost in the recording; “I come against” fills the gap. Quietness and introversion are not a stronghold; Jesus often withdrew to pray (Luke 5:16).

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, in the name of Jesus I expose the stronghold of isolation in my life.
In the name of Jesus Christ I declare that isolation is a cursed work of darkness, and I come against the demons in this stronghold.
Father, in the name of Jesus, I receive Your truth and Your deliverance.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Humiliation
note:
“He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.” — Luke 1:52

From part 13 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

This part lists depression among the forces of this stronghold. Depression is treatable; see a doctor as well as praying.

If you have thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life, call 112 (EU), 911 (US) or your local emergency number now. In Poland you can also call 116 123 (24/7); in the US, call or text 988.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I pray in the name of Jesus: let these words reach the depths of my soul.
Father, in the name of Jesus I curse all humiliation in me.
I discredit the work of the demonic, and I undermine this stronghold.
I say now to every demonic force gathered in the stronghold of humiliation: get away from me now.
I curse you, demonic stronghold of humiliation; and all you demons in it, you must leave now, in the name of Jesus.
Father, help me to receive Your word; let the power of Your Holy Spirit go right through me.
Thank You, Lord, that You always hear me.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Strongholds of Manipulation
note:
“in order that Satan should not outwit us. For we are not unaware of his schemes.” — 2 Corinthians 2:11

From part 14 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

The opening reading is the commandment “You shall not steal” (Exodus 20:15), read as taking another person captive; the verse above is the one the original prayer stands on, and the words are Paul’s, not Jesus’. Where the original releases wisdom and light over the listeners, you receive them.

This part names two strongholds: active manipulation, called witchcraft — authority, guilt, fear, pity or pain used to bend another person’s will — and passive manipulation, called allusion: hints, sulking, sarcasm and silence instead of saying things plainly. If someone controls or manipulates you, talk to someone you trust; where there is abuse, safety comes first.

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I thank You in the name of Jesus for this teaching.
Help me to receive it as a word that helps me recognise the devil.
Your word says that we are not unaware of the enemy's schemes.
I stand on that word now, and I declare in the name of Jesus that this knowledge will help me recognise the enemy in my life.
In the name of Jesus Christ I curse every demonic stronghold of manipulation in my life, active or passive.
I receive Your wisdom and Your light into my life now.
Holy Spirit, inspire me, teach me and lead me into all truth.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Immaturity
note:
“Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.” — 1 Corinthians 14:20

From part 15 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.

Where the original commands angels, you ask the Father, who sends them to serve those who will inherit salvation (Hebrews 1:14).

“Curse” here means what part 4 of the series teaches: stopping the growth of a pattern (Amos 2:9; Luke 17:6; compare the fig tree, Mark 11:14, 20-21). It is aimed at strongholds and evil spirits, never at a person (Romans 12:14).

Pray this alongside medical, psychological and pastoral help, never instead of it.
segments: Father, I pray now in the name of Jesus.
Thank You for showing me the stronghold of childishness in my life.
Father, in the name of Jesus I curse the demonic forces in this stronghold.
In the name of Jesus I bind them, and I do not allow them to act in me; I come to this in faith.
Help me also to take the right stance toward people around me who live under this stronghold, so that these forces cannot touch me, and perhaps so that I can help them.
Father, thank You for Your word, for Your anointing, and for the angels You send to serve those who will inherit salvation.
In Jesus' name, amen.

title: Against the Stronghold of Pessimism
note:
“But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.” — Isaiah 40:31

From part 16 of a teaching series on strongholds, rewritten so that you pray it for yourself. Start with “Tearing Down a Stronghold”, then pray this one.
